translation: [美俚]价值低的股票；杂物；（下雨）猛烈地；大量地

meaning: n. 目录；（美）大学情况一览; v. 把…编入目录
example: Their full catalogue costs $5, redeemable against a first order.
translation: 他们的完整目录售价5美元，第一次订购时可返还这5美元。

meaning: n. 大灾难；大祸；惨败
example: They suffered an electoral catastrophe, winning a paltry 3 seats.
translation: 他们在选举中惨败，仅获得微不足道的3个席位。

meaning: v. 赶上；抓住；感染；了解; n. 捕捉；捕获物；窗钩
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: n. 种类，分类；[数] 范畴
example: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in.
translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

meaning: v. 投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务; n. (Cater)人名；(英)凯特
example: The chef is pleased to cater for vegetarian diets.
translation: 厨师非常乐意为客人做素食。

meaning: n. 大教堂
example: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
translation: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

meaning: adj. 天主教的；宽宏大量的; n. 天主教徒；罗马天主教
example: It presented in satirical terms points made in earnest by Catholic writers.
translation: 它用讽刺的语言呈现了天主教作家郑重其事表明的观点。

meaning: n. 牛；牲畜（骂人的话）；家畜；无价值的人
example: The old stone cattle trough still sits by the main entrance.
translation: 陈旧的石制牛食槽仍然放在大门口。

meaning: n. 原因；事业；目标; v. 引起；使遭受
example: His misunderstanding of language was the primary cause of his other problems.
translation: 他对语言的误解是引起其他问题的主要原因。

meaning: n. 小心，谨慎；警告，警示; v. 警告
example: Television broadcasters were warned to exercise caution over depicting scenes of violence.
translation: 电视台受到警告，要求对暴力场面的描绘采取谨慎态度。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；十分小心的
example: Australia, put in to bat, made a cautious start.
translation: 轮到澳大利亚队出场击球，他们开始打得很谨慎。

meaning: v. 使凹陷，使塌落；在…挖洞穴; n. 洞穴，窑洞
example: But in some respects cave dwellers were far cleverer than us.
translation: 但是在某些方面穴居人要比我们聪明得多。

meaning: abbr. 光盘，激光唱片（Compact Disc）；呼叫设备（Calling Device）；中央地区（Central District）；商务部（Commerce Department）
example: You can store your entire CD collection on the computer's hard drive.
translation: 你可以将收藏的全部CD保存在电脑硬盘上。

meaning: n. 天花板；上限
example: Flavell had accidentally discharged a pistol, firing it into the ceiling.
translation: 弗拉维尔不小心扳动了一把手枪的扳机，子弹射入了天花板。

meaning: v. 庆祝；举行；赞美；祝贺；宣告
example: The banks have had precious little to celebrate recently.
translation: 银行最近没几件值得庆贺的事。

meaning: n. 庆典，庆祝会；庆祝；颂扬
example: Then it was back to the house for a quiet celebration.
translation: 然后就回到房子里悄悄地庆祝一番。

meaning: n. 细胞；电池；蜂房的巢室；单人小室; vi. 住在牢房或小室中
example: Three prisoners were sharing one small cell 3 metres by 2 metres.
translation: 3个囚犯关在一个3米长2米宽的小牢房里。

meaning: n. 地窖；酒窖；地下室; vt. 把…藏入地窖
example: He then dismembered her, hiding parts of her body in the cellar.
translation: 他接着将她肢解，将部分尸体藏在了地窖里。

meaning: n. 分；一分的硬币；森特（等于半音程的百分之一）
example: By 1973 the government deficit equalled thirty per cent of GNP.
translation: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。

meaning: adj. 摄氏的；[仪] 摄氏温度的；百分度的
example: The number at the bottom is the recommended water temperature in Centigrade.
translation: 底部的数字就是推荐的摄氏水温。

meaning: n. 厘米；公分
example: The snails are no larger than one centimetre across.
translation: 这些蜗牛体宽不超过1厘米。

meaning: adj. 中心的；主要的；中枢的; n. 电话总机
example: The central heating's been turned off. I've turned it on again.
translation: 中央供暖系统已经关上。我又将它打开了。

meaning: v. 以…为中心; n. 中心; adj. 中央的
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: n. 世纪，百年；（板球）一百分
example: The first British attempt to colonize Ireland was in the twelfth century.
translation: 英国最早尝试在爱尔兰开拓殖民地是在12世纪。

meaning: n. 典礼，仪式；礼节，礼仪；客套，虚礼
example: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
translation: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

meaning: adj. 某一；必然的；确信；无疑的；有把握的; pron. 某些；某几个; n. (Certain)人名；(葡)塞尔塔因；(法)塞尔坦
example: There is a certain impatience among some of the soldiers.
translation: 有些士兵有点儿不耐烦。

meaning: adv. 当然；行（用于回答）；必定
example: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements.
translation: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。

meaning: v. 发给证明书；以证书形式授权给…；用证书批准; n. 证书；执照，文凭
example: Wives will have to bring along their marriage certificate.
translation: 已婚妇女必须携带结婚证。

meaning: n. 链；束缚；枷锁; v. 束缚；囚禁；用铁链锁住
example: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
translation: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

meaning: n. 椅子；讲座；（会议的）主席位；大学教授的职位; v. 担任（会议的）主席；使…入座；使就任要职
example: He sat penitently in his chair by the window.
translation: 他懊悔地坐在靠窗的椅子上。

meaning: n. 主席，会长；董事长
example: When the chairman of Campbell's retired, McGovern was named as his successor.
translation: 坎贝尔公司的总裁退休后，麦戈文被选定为继任者。

meaning: n. 女主席；女议长
example: The chairwoman is up against the greatest challenge to her position.
translation: 女主席正面临职位上的最大挑战。

meaning: v. 用粉笔写；用白垩粉擦；记录；规划; n. 粉笔；白垩；用粉笔划的记号; adj. 用粉笔写的
example: The two places, he insists, are as different as chalk and cheese.
translation: 他坚持说那两个地方有天壤之别。

meaning: n. 挑战；怀疑; v. 向…挑战；对…质疑
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

meaning: adj. 挑战的；引起挑战性兴趣的; v. 要求；质疑；反对；向…挑战；盘问（challenge的ing形式）
example: meet the challenge
translation: 迎接挑战；满足要求

meaning: n. 冠军；拥护者；战士; v. 支持；拥护; adj. 优胜的；第一流的
example: The heavyweight champion will be given a shot at Holyfield's world title.
translation: 这名重量级拳击冠军将尝试挑战霍利菲尔德的世界冠军头衔。

meaning: n. 机会，际遇；运气，侥幸；可能性; v. 偶然发生；冒……的险
example: They had met by chance at university and finished up getting married.
translation: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。

meaning: v. 改变；交换; n. 变化；找回的零钱
example: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
translation: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

meaning: adj. 无常的；可改变的；易变的；不定的
example: The forecast is for changeable weather.
translation: 预报针对的是变化无常的天气。

meaning: v. 引导，开导；形成河道; n. 通道；频道；海峡
example: The series goes out at 10.30pm, Fridays, on Channel 4.
translation: 这部连续剧每周五晚上10点30分在第4频道播出。

meaning: n. 圣歌；赞美诗; v. 唱；诵扬
example: He was greeted by the chant of "Judas! Judas!".
translation: 人们看见他就反复不停地喊：“犹大！犹大！”

meaning: n. 混沌，混乱
example: Whatever troubles arise, we'll have peace of mind amidst seeming chaos.
translation: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

meaning: n. 章，回；（俱乐部、协会等的）分会；人生或历史上的重要时期; vt. 把…分成章节
example: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer.
translation: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

meaning: n. 性格，品质；特性；角色；[计] 字符; v. 印，刻；使具有特征
example: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.
translation: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。

meaning: adj. 典型的；特有的；表示特性的; n. 特征；特性；特色
example: With characteristic impetuosity, he announced he was leaving school.
translation: 一贯性急冲动的他又宣布要退学了。

meaning: n. 费用；电荷；掌管；控告；命令；负载; v. 使充电；使承担；指责；装载；对…索费；向…冲去
example: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
translation: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

meaning: n. 图表；海图；图纸；排行榜; v. 绘制…的图表；在海图上标出；详细计划；记录；记述；跟踪（进展或发展
example: The chart can then display the links connecting these groups.
translation: 这张图就会显示出这些群体之间的关联。

meaning: v. 聊天；闲谈; n. 聊天；闲谈
example: You can chat to other people who are online.
translation: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

meaning: adj. 便宜的；小气的；不值钱的; adv. 便宜地
example: We will end up living in a society where life is cheap.
translation: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。

meaning: v. 欺骗；骗取; n. 欺骗，作弊；骗子
example: I know it sounds unbelievable but I never wanted to cheat.
translation: 我知道听上去难以置信，但我从不想撒谎。

meaning: v. 检查，核对；制止，抑制；在…上打勾; n. <美>支票；制止，抑制；检验，核对
example: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly.
translation: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

meaning: n. 面颊，脸颊；臀部; v. 无礼地向…讲话，对…大胆无礼
example: She knelt and brushed her lips softly across Michael's cheek.
translation: 她跪了下来，轻吻迈克尔的脸颊。

meaning: v. 欢呼；使高兴；为…加油; n. 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事
example: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
translation: 士兵对上校报以震天的欢呼声。

meaning: adj. 快乐的；愉快的；高兴的
example: There is little evidence to support many of Mr Will's cheerful assumptions.
translation: 没有多少证据能支持威尔先生的那些乐观设想。

meaning: v. 感谢；谢谢；再见
example: Her dancing brought loud cheers, wolf whistles and applause.
translation: 她的舞蹈赢来震耳的欢呼声、口哨声和掌声。

meaning: n. [食品] 奶酪；干酪；要人; v. 停止; adj. 叛变的；胆小的
example: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
translation: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。

meaning: n. 厨师，大师傅
example: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
translation: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

meaning: n. 化学制品，化学药品; adj. 化学的
example: Some of the companies illegally sent the wherewithal for making chemical weapons.
translation: 有些公司非法为制造化学武器提供所需的资金和设备等。

meaning: n. 化学家；化学工作者；药剂师；炼金术士
example: She worked as a research chemist.
translation: 她曾经是化学研究员。

meaning: n. 化学；化学过程
example: The Oxford Chemistry Primers aim to cover important topics in organic chemistry.
translation: 《牛津化学初级读本》丛书旨在论述有机化学中的重要问题。

meaning: n. 支票
example: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
translation: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

meaning: n. 国际象棋，西洋棋
example: "Do you play chess?" he asked, looking askance at Miguel.
translation: “你会下棋吗？”他斜睨着米格尔问道。

meaning: n. 胸，胸部；衣柜；箱子；金库
example: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
translation: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

meaning: n. 咀嚼；咀嚼物; v. 嚼碎，咀嚼
example: He tends to chew things over too much in his mind.
translation: 他这个人就爱在心里反复琢磨事儿。

meaning: n. 小鸡；小鸟；少妇; adj. 胆小的；懦弱的
example: Boil the chick peas, add garlic and lemon juice.
translation: 把鹰嘴豆放在开水中煮，并加入大蒜和柠檬汁。

meaning: n. 鸡肉；小鸡；胆小鬼，懦夫; adj. 鸡肉的；胆怯的；幼小的
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: n. 首领；酋长；主要部分; adj. 首席的；主要的；主任的; adv. 主要地；首要地
example: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
translation: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

meaning: n. 儿童，小孩，孩子；产物；子孙；幼稚的人；弟子
example: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
translation: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

meaning: n. 童年时期；幼年时代
example: His parents' obsession with keeping up appearances haunted his childhood.
translation: 父母过于爱面子的做法在他儿时一直困扰着他。

meaning: n. 烟囱
example: A thin twist of smoke curled from the cottage's single chimney.
translation: 一缕盘旋的轻烟从农舍唯一的烟囱里缭绕升起。

meaning: n. 中国; adj. 中国的；中国制造的
example: China enters a new five-year plan period next year.
translation: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。

meaning: n. 中文，汉语；中国人; adj. 中国的，中国人的；中国话的
example: Chinese waiters stood in a cluster, sharing a private joke.
translation: 华人服务生们站在一起，讲着只有他们自己才懂的笑话。

meaning: n. [食品] 炸土豆条；小木片；（作赌注用的）圆形筹码；缺口（chip的复数形式）
example: fish and chips
translation: 炸鱼和土豆片

meaning: n. 巧克力，巧克力糖；巧克力色; adj. 巧克力色的；巧克力口味的
example: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
translation: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

meaning: n. 选择；选择权；精选品; adj. 精选的；仔细推敲的
example: Helen's choice of lipstick was a good match for her skin-tone.
translation: 海伦选择的唇膏很适合她的肤色。

meaning: n. 唱诗班；合唱队；舞蹈队; v. 合唱
example: He drills the choir to a high standard.
translation: 他将合唱团训练到了一个高水平。

meaning: v. 呛；使窒息；阻塞；抑制；扑灭; n. 窒息；噎；[动力] 阻气门
example: It's enough to make them choke with apoplectic rage.
translation: 足以气得让他们说不出话来。

meaning: v. 选择，决定
example: For added protection choose a lipstick with a sun screen.
translation: 选择防晒护唇膏来增强保护。

meaning: n. 筷子
example: He's not very skilful with his chopsticks [ at using chopsticks ] .
translation: 他用 筷子 不大熟练.

meaning: n. 合唱队；齐声；歌舞队; v. 合唱；异口同声地说
example: "All the best," called the other typists in chorus.
translation: “祝万事如意，”其他打字员齐声喊道。

meaning: n. 基督徒，信徒; adj. 基督教的；信基督教的
example: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
translation: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

meaning: n. 圣诞节；圣诞节期间
example: "Prices are down 40 per cent since Christmas," he lamented.
translation: “圣诞节以来物价降了4成，”他悲叹道。

meaning: n. 教堂；礼拜；教派; adj. 教会的；礼拜的; v. 领…到教堂接受宗教仪式
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: n. 雪茄
n. 香烟；纸烟
example: Over coffee, she lit a cigarette, her eyes daring him to comment.
translation: 喝咖啡时，她点燃了一支烟，用挑衅的眼神看着他，谅他也不敢吭声。

meaning: n. 电影；电影院；电影业，电影制作术
example: Working with Ford closely, I fell in love with the cinema.
translation: 与福特的密切合作开始令我爱上了电影。

meaning: n. 循环，周期；圆；圈子；圆形物; v. 盘旋，旋转；环行
example: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral.
translation: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

meaning: n. [电子] 电路，回路；巡回；一圈；环道; v. 环行
example: He was just starting to become known on the cabaret circuit.
translation: 他在卡巴莱歌舞表演圈中刚刚开始有点名气。

meaning: v. 传播，流传；循环；流通
example: Merchandise can now circulate freely among the EU countries.
translation: 商品现在可以在欧盟各国自由流通。

meaning: n. 环境，情况；事件；境遇
example: You might say that we've been victims of circumstance.
translation: 你可以说我们一直不走运吧。

meaning: n. 马戏；马戏团
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: n. 公民；市民；老百姓
example: I invite every citizen to carefully study the document.
translation: 我请每位市民都仔细研读该文件。

meaning: n. 城市，都市; adj. 城市的；都会的
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: adj. 公民的；民间的；文职的；有礼貌的；根据民法的; n. (Civil)人名；(土)吉维尔；(法)西维尔
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: adj. 民用的；百姓的，平民的; n. 平民，百姓
example: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission.
translation: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。

meaning: n. 文明；文化
example: I think we can date the decline of Western Civilization quite precisely.
translation: 我认为我们可以相当准确地确定西方文明开始衰落的年代。

meaning: v. 鼓掌，拍手；啪地关上; n. 鼓掌；拍手声
example: Let's give the children a big clap.
translation: 让我们为孩子们热烈鼓掌.

meaning: v. 澄清；阐明
example: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.
translation: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。

meaning: n. 阶级；班级；种类；班；等级; v. 分类；把…分等级；把…归入某等级，把…看作（或分类、归类）；把…编入某一班级; adj. 极好的；很好的，优秀的，出色的
example: The price includes two economy class airfares from Brisbane to Los Angeles.
translation: 这一价格包括两张从布里斯班到洛杉矶的经济舱机票。

meaning: adj. 经典的；古典的，传统的；最优秀的; n. 名著；经典著作；大艺术家
example: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
translation: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

meaning: adj. 古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的; n. 古典音乐
example: The images were Gothic or Byzantine rather than classical.
translation: 这些形象属哥特式或者拜占庭式而非古典式。

meaning: v. 分类；分等
example: It is necessary initially to classify the headaches into certain types.
translation: 首先，必须将头痛分为几个类型。

meaning: n. 同班同学
example: He made a profession of friendship to his classmate Mary.
translation: 他向他的同学玛丽表白了他的友情.

meaning: n. 教室
example: The classroom teacher must be sensitive to a child'sneeds.
translation: 班主任必须对小学生的需求体察入微。

meaning: n. 爪；螯，钳；爪形器具; v. 用爪抓（或挖）
example: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
translation: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

meaning: n. [土壤] 粘土；泥土；肉体；似黏土的东西; vt. 用黏土处理
example: As the wheel turned, the potter shaped the clay.
translation: 轮子一边转动，制陶工人一边拉坯。

meaning: adj. 清洁的，干净的；清白的; v. 使干净; adv. 完全地; n. 打扫
example: They were more concerned about the dogs' welfare than a clean getaway.
translation: 他们更加关心那些狗的安危，而非自己如何干净利落地脱身。

meaning: n. [化工] 清洁剂；清洁工；干洗店；干洗商；洗洁器
example: The Marshal stepped over the vacuum-cleaner and stumped out of the room.
translation: 元帅迈过真空吸尘器，脚步沉重地走出了房间。

meaning: adj. 清楚的；清澈的；晴朗的；无罪的; v. 通过；清除；使干净；跳过; adv. 清晰地；完全地; n. 清除；空隙
example: It was clear Cohen didn't understand what Millard was driving at.
translation: 看得出科恩并不明白米勒德想说什么。

meaning: adv. 清晰地；明显地；无疑地；明净地
example: I clearly empathize with the people who live in those neighborhoods.
translation: 我非常同情生活在那些地方的人们。

meaning: n. 职员，办事员；店员；书记；记账员；<古>牧师，教士; v. 当销售员，当店员；当职员
example: A stupid medical clerk had slipped the wrong tab on his X-ray.
translation: 一个蠢笨的医护人员一不留神在他的X光片上贴错了标签。

meaning: adj. 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的
example: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
translation: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

meaning: v. 点击；使发咔哒声; n. 单击；滴答声
example: There was a metallic click and the gates swung open.
translation: 随着一声金属碰击的咔嗒声，大门打开了。

meaning: n. 气候；风气；思潮；风土
example: If climate changes continue, we will suffer the consequences.
translation: 如果气候变化继续下去，我们将自食其果。

meaning: v. 爬；攀登；上升; n. 爬；攀登
example: In an embarrassing climb-down, the Home Secretary lifted the deportation threat.
translation: 内务大臣尴尬地作出让步，解除了将其驱逐出境的威胁。

meaning: n. 临床；诊所
example: Charles was at the clinic recovering from an operation on his arm.
translation: 查尔斯的胳膊动了手术，正在这家诊所进行康复治疗。

meaning: n. 时钟；计时器; v. 记录；记时
example: It was just gone 7 o'clock this evening when I finished.
translation: 今晚我做完的时候刚过7点。

meaning: n. 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物; v. 无性繁殖，复制
example: Tom was in some ways a younger clone of his handsome father.
translation: 汤姆某些地方长得和他那帅气的父亲一模一样，只是年轻一些。

meaning: adj. 紧密的；亲密的；亲近的; v. 关；结束；使靠近; adv. 紧密地; n. 结束
example: Three mortar shells had landed close to a crowd of people.
translation: 3枚迫击炮弹落在人群旁。

meaning: n. 布；织物；桌布; adj. 布制的
example: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
translation: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

meaning: n. 衣服
example: Her bed was crisply made, her clothes put away.
translation: 她的床收拾得很整洁，衣服也收起来了。

meaning: n. （总称）[服装] 服装；帆装; v. 覆盖（clothe的ing形式）；给…穿衣
example: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
translation: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。

meaning: n. 云；阴云；云状物；一大群；黑斑; v. 使混乱；以云遮敝；使忧郁；玷污
example: The powdery dust rose in a cloud around him.
translation: 一团粉尘在他周围扬起。

meaning: adj. 多云的；阴天的；愁容满面的
example: a grey, cloudy day
translation: 灰暗多云的天空

meaning: n. 俱乐部，社团；夜总会；棍棒；（扑克牌中的）梅花; v. 用棍棒打；募集; adj. 俱乐部的
example: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

meaning: adj. 笨拙的
example: The action seemed a clumsy attempt to topple the Janata Dal government.
translation: 这一试图推翻人民党政府的行动似乎缺乏策略。

meaning: n. 教练；旅客车厢；长途公车；四轮大马车; v. 训练；指导
example: head coach
translation: 主教练；总教练

meaning: v. 上煤；加煤; n. 煤；煤块；木炭
example: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
translation: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

meaning: v. 滑行；沿岸航行; n. 海岸；滑坡
example: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
translation: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

meaning: n. 外套; v. 覆盖…的表面
example: He cleaned the flakes away with his coat sleeve.
translation: 他用大衣袖子把碎屑掸掉。

meaning: n. 公鸡；龙头；雄鸟；头目; v. 使竖起；使耸立；使朝上
example: His hands were too weak to cock his revolver.
translation: 他的手没劲儿，扳不动左轮手枪的扳机。

meaning: n. 可可粉；可可豆；可可饮料；深褐色
example: My wife was tucked up in bed with her cup of cocoa.
translation: 我老婆端着一杯热可可窝在床上。

meaning: n. 咖啡；咖啡豆；咖啡色
v. 铸造（货币）；杜撰，创造; n. 硬币，钱币
example: I pulled a coin from my pocket and flipped it.
translation: 我从口袋里掏出一个硬币，把它弹向空中。

meaning: n. 巧合；一致；同时发生
example: Does coincidence come under the umbrella of the paranormal?
translation: 巧合属于超自然现象吗？

meaning: n. 焦炭；可卡因；可口可乐（Coca-Cola）; v. 焦化
example: "Steve, what do you want?" — "Coke, Pepsi, it doesn't matter."
translation: “史蒂夫，你要喝点什么？”——“可口可乐，百事，随便啦。”

meaning: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的，不热情的；失去知觉的; n. 寒冷；感冒; adv. 完全地
example: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face.
translation: 雾蒙蒙的寒冷空气使他脸上感觉很舒爽。

meaning: n. 衣领；颈圈; v. 抓住；给…上领子；给…套上颈圈
example: white collar
translation: 白领阶层；白领工人

meaning: n. 同事，同僚
example: He was fired from his job after roughing up a colleague.
translation: 他因为对一位同事动粗而被开除了。

meaning: v. 收集；募捐; adv. 由收件人付款地; adj. 由收件人付款的; n. (Collect)人名；(英)科莱克特
example: Methane gas does collect in the mines around here.
translation: 周围的矿井里的确有沼气聚积。

meaning: n. 采集，聚集；[税收] 征收；收藏品；募捐
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: n. 大学；学院；学会
example: I've had the hots for him ever since he came to college.
translation: 自从他来上大学后，我就对他春心萌动。

meaning: n. 碰撞；冲突；（意见，看法）的抵触；（政党等的）倾轧
example: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision.
translation: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

meaning: v. 把…涂颜色，粉饰；歪曲；使脸红; n. 颜色；风格；气色，面色；外貌
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 梳子；蜂巢；鸡冠; v. 梳头发；梳毛
example: We went over that area with a fine-tooth comb.
translation: 我们对那个地区进行了彻底的搜查。

meaning: v. 使化合；使联合，使结合; n. 联合收割机；联合企业
example: I am partial to desserts that combine fresh fruit with fine pastry.
translation: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

meaning: v. 来；开始；出现；发生；变成；到达; int. 嗨！; n. (Come)人名；(英)科姆；(阿尔巴)乔梅
example: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
translation: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

meaning: n. 喜剧；喜剧性；有趣的事情
example: Paul is a thoroughly likeable man with an unerring sense of comedy.
translation: 保罗十分讨人喜欢，开玩笑时很有分寸。

meaning: n. 安慰；舒适；安慰者; v. 安慰；使（痛苦等）缓和
example: He began to comfort me with such unaccustomed gentleness.
translation: 他开始以那种少有的温柔安慰我。

meaning: adj. 舒适的，舒服的; n. 盖被
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: n. 逗号；停顿
example: Not a comma was left out.
translation: 一个逗号也没漏掉.

meaning: v. 命令，指挥；控制; n. 指挥，控制；命令；司令部
example: He had authorisation from the military command to retaliate.
translation: 他得到军事指挥部授权，准备反击。

meaning: n. 评论；意见；批评; v. 发表评论；发表意见
example: It was just a passing comment, he didn't go on about it.
translation: 那只是一笔带过的评论，他没有继续论述。

meaning: adj. 商业的；营利的；靠广告收入的; n. 商业广告
example: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

meaning: v. 犯罪，做错事；把交托给；指派…作战；使…承担义务
example: He should not commit American troops without the full consent of Congress.
translation: 没有国会的完全同意，他不应该调遣美国军队。

meaning: n. 承诺，保证；委托；承担义务；献身
example: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?
translation: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

meaning: n. 委员会
example: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

meaning: adj. 共同的；普通的；一般的；通常的; n. 普通；平民；公有地
example: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
translation: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

meaning: v. 通讯，传达；相通；交流；感染
example: Family therapy showed us how to communicate with each other.
translation: 家庭疗法指导我们彼此之间的沟通交流。

meaning: n. 通讯，[通信] 通信；交流；信函
example: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
translation: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

meaning: n. 共产主义
example: He was a politically conscious fighter for communism.
translation: 在政治上,他是个自觉的共产主义战士.

meaning: n. 共产党员；共产主义者; adj. 共产主义的
example: The North has been under Communist rule since 1954.
translation: 北方自1954年起就一直处于共产党的统治之下。

meaning: n. 同伴；朋友；指南；手册; v. 陪伴
example: He has been her constant companion for the last four months.
translation: 4个月来，他一直陪伴在她身边。

meaning: n. 公司；陪伴，同伴；连队; v. 交往
example: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
translation: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

meaning: n. 比较; v. 比拟，喻为；[语]构成
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: n. 指南针，罗盘；圆规; v. 包围
example: You can go anywhere and still the compass points north or south.
translation: 无论走到哪里，罗盘仍然指向北或南。

meaning: v. 补偿，赔偿；抵消
example: The hospital staff were very apologetic but that couldn't really compensate.
translation: 医院的工作人员深表歉意，但这真的于事无补。

meaning: v. 竞争；比赛；对抗
example: They are now trying to compete on an equal footing.
translation: 他们现在想要公平竞争。

meaning: n. 能力，胜任；权限；作证能力；足以过舒适生活的收入
example: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
translation: 选拔过程是基于对能力和经验的严格测试。

meaning: n. 竞争；比赛，竞赛
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: n. 竞争者，对手
example: She was the only British competitor apart from Richard Meade.
translation: 她是除了理查德·米德之外唯一的英国参赛者。

meaning: adj. 完整的；完全的；彻底的; v. 完成
example: It'll be two years before the process is complete.
translation: 这个过程需要两年才能完成。

meaning: adj. 复杂的；合成的; n. 复合体；综合设施
example: I had a persecution complex and thought people were conspiring against me.
translation: 我有过被害情结，认为大家都在密谋暗算我。

meaning: adj. 组成的，构成的; n. 成分；组件；[电子] 元件
example: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.
translation: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。

meaning: n. 作文，作曲，作品；[材] 构成；合成物；成分
example: The course is designed to help students with colour and composition.
translation: 设置这门课程是为了指导学生如何运用色彩和构图。

meaning: n. 理解；包含
example: It's a devastating and barbaric act that defies all comprehension.
translation: 这种行为野蛮凶残、令人震惊，简直是不可理喻。

meaning: v. 妥协；危害; n. 妥协，和解；折衷
example: Mr Clarke has shown himself to be resolutely opposed to compromise.
translation: 克拉克先生已表示自己坚决反对妥协。

meaning: adj. 义务的；必修的；被强制的; n. （花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: n. 计算机；电脑；电子计算机
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: n. 同志；伙伴
example: Mr Meridor's father was a comrade-in-arms of the party's founder.
translation: 梅里多先生的父亲是该党创始人的战友。

meaning: v. 集中；浓缩；全神贯注；聚集; n. 浓缩，精选；浓缩液
example: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
translation: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

meaning: n. 观念，概念
example: The snowcoach concept in Yellowstone provides low-impact, low-pollution access.
translation: 在黄石公园里使用雪车这一想法，为人们提供了一种对环境低影响、低污染的游览方式。

meaning: v. 涉及，关系到；使担心; n. 关系；关心；关心的事；忧虑
example: Issues such as these were not really his concern.
translation: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

meaning: n. 音乐会；一致；和谐; v. 使协调；协同安排; adj. 音乐会用的；在音乐会上演出的
example: He wants to act in concert with other nations.
translation: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。

meaning: v. 推断；决定，作结论；结束
example: If the clubs cannot conclude a deal, an independent tribunal will decide.
translation: 如果俱乐部之间无法达成协议，将由一个独立的仲裁委员会来裁定。

meaning: n. 结论；结局；推论
example: It's almost a foregone conclusion that you'll get what you want.
translation: 你将得到你想要的，这几乎是确定无疑的。

meaning: adj. 混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的; v. 凝结; n. 具体物；凝结物
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: v. 谴责；判刑，定罪；声讨
example: Bankers are quick to condemn retrospective tax legislation.
translation: 银行家们立即声讨有追溯效力的税收立法。

meaning: n. 条件；情况；环境；身份; v. 决定；使适应；使健康；以…为条件
example: He was concerned with the enhancement of the human condition.
translation: 他关心人类生存环境的改善。

meaning: v. 导电；带领; n. 进行；行为；实施
example: The evaluation of conduct involves some amount of generalization.
translation: 对操行的评价会含有一些泛泛之论。

meaning: n. 导体；售票员；领导者；管理人
example: The conductor's eyes darted to Wilfred, then fixed on Michael again.
translation: 乐队指挥飞快地扫了威尔弗雷德一眼，然后视线又落回到迈克尔身上。

meaning: n. 会议；讨论；协商；联盟；（正式）讨论会；[工会、工党用语]（每年的）大会; vi. 举行或参加（系列）会议
example: At a later news conference, he said differences should not be dramatized.
translation: 在后来的新闻发布会上，他说不应夸大分歧。

meaning: adj. 自信的；确信的
example: He was confident the allies would make good on their pledges.
translation: 他相信盟友们会履行他们的承诺。

meaning: adj. 机密的；表示信任的；获信任的
example: National security is the stock excuse for keeping things confidential.
translation: 国家安全常被用作对一些事情保密的挡箭牌。

meaning: v. 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固
example: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.
translation: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。

meaning: n. 冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执; v. 冲突，抵触；争执；战斗
example: The ethnic populations are so intermingled that there's bound to be conflict.
translation: 各民族人口如此杂居，肯定会发生冲突。

meaning: v. 使混乱；使困惑
example: I think it's a serious mistake to confuse books with life.
translation: 我认为把书本同生活混为一谈是大错特错。

meaning: v. 祝贺；恭喜；庆贺
example: He was generous enough to congratulate his successor on his decision.
translation: 他十分大度地祝贺他的继任者做出了决定。

meaning: n. 祝贺；贺辞
example: This is not a matter for self-congratulation.
translation: 你不应该为此事沾沾自喜。

meaning: v. 连接；联合；关连
example: Two cables connect to each corner of the plate.
translation: 两条电缆连到金属板的每个角上。

meaning: n. 连接；关系；人脉；连接件
example: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
translation: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

meaning: n. 道德心，良心
example: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
translation: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

meaning: n. 一致；舆论；合意
example: I realize there's no consensus on what are male or female values.
translation: 我意识到人们对什么是男性价值观和什么是女性价值观并无共识。

meaning: n. 结果；重要性；推论
example: as a consequence
translation: 因此，结果

meaning: n. 保存，保持；保护
example: In time these new excavations will require conservation.
translation: 这些刚发掘出来的物品需要及时保护。

meaning: adj. 保守的; n. 保守派，守旧者
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: v. 考虑；认为；考虑到；细想
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: adj. 体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的
example: The patient has the right to considerate and respectful care.
translation: 病人有权得到周到而礼貌的照顾。

meaning: n. 考虑；原因；关心；报酬
example: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

meaning: v. 由…组成；在于；符合
example: The division will consist of two tank companies and one infantry company.
translation: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

meaning: adj. 始终如一的，一致的；坚持的
example: consistent with
translation: 符合；与…一致

meaning: adj. 不变的；恒定的；经常的; n. [数] 常数；恒量
example: There was constant jeering and interruption from the floor.
translation: 议员席上不断有人在嘲讽和打岔.

meaning: n. 宪法；体制；章程；构造；建立，组成；体格
example: chemical constitution
translation: 化学结构；化学组成

meaning: v. 建造，构造；创立; n. 构想，概念
example: Any attempt to construct an ideal society is foredoomed to failure.
translation: 任何构建理想社会的努力都注定要失败。

meaning: n. 建设；建筑物；解释；造句
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: v. 查阅；商量；向…请教
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: n. 顾问；咨询者；会诊医生
example: Shirley's brother is now a consultant heart surgeon in Sweden.
translation: 雪利的兄弟现在在瑞典做心脏外科高级顾问医师。

meaning: v. 消耗，消费；使…著迷；挥霍
example: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.
translation: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。

meaning: v. 包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）
example: Our range of herbal teas contain no preservatives, colourings or artificial flavourings.
translation: 我们这一系列的药草茶不含防腐剂、色素以及人工调味品。

meaning: n. 集装箱；容器
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n. 同时代的人；同时期的东西; adj. 当代的；同时代的；属于同一时期的
n. 内容，目录；满足；容量; adj. 满意的; v. 使满足
example: There are reports of widespread dis-content in the capital.
translation: 有报道称首都弥漫着不满的情绪。

meaning: n. 大陆，洲，陆地; adj. 自制的，克制的
example: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.
translation: 其店铺跻身欧陆最时尚的店铺之列。

meaning: v. 继续，延续；仍旧，连续
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: v. 反驳；否定；与…矛盾；与…抵触
example: The result seems to contradict a major U.S. study reported last November.
translation: 这一结果似乎和去年11月美国研究人员发表的一项重要成果相矛盾。

meaning: adj. 矛盾的；反对的；反驳的；抗辩的; n. 对立物；矛盾因素
adj. 相反的；对立的; adv. 相反地; n. 相反；反面
example: Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.
translation: 几个在场的人，包括温博格，所掌握的信息截然不同。

meaning: v. 贡献，出力；投稿；捐献
example: Heat, cold, tactile and other sensations contribute to flavour.
translation: 热、冷、触觉和其他感觉构成了食物风味的一部分。

meaning: n. 贡献；捐献；投稿
example: His contribution is immeasurable.
translation: 他居功至伟。

meaning: n. 控制；管理；抑制；操纵装置; v. 控制；管理；抑制
example: The volume of scheduled flights is straining the air traffic control system.
translation: 定期航班的数量正让空中交通指挥系统不堪重负。

meaning: adj. 有争议的；有争论的
example: The committee backtracked by scrapping the controversial bonus system.
translation: 委员会改变主意，放弃了有争议的奖金制度。

meaning: n. 便利；厕所；便利的事物
example: Like working women anywhere, Asian women are buying convenience foods.
translation: 像其他地方的职业女性一样，亚洲女性也购买方便食品。

meaning: adj. 方便的；[废语]适当的；[口语]近便的；实用的
example: There wasn't even a convenient place for students to assemble between classes.
translation: 在课间，学生们连一个方便凑在一起的地方都没有。

meaning: adj. 符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的
example: He hates the wheeling and dealing associated with conventional political life.
translation: 他对传统政治生活中的权术钻营深恶痛绝。

meaning: n. 交谈，会话；社交；交往，交际；会谈；（人与计算机的）人机对话
example: He finished his conversation and stood up, looking straight at me.
translation: 他说完话站起来，直视着我。

meaning: v. 传达；运输；让与
example: Euclid was trying to convey his idea of a geometrical point.
translation: 欧几里得试图表达他的一个几何学观点。

meaning: v. 说服；使确信，使信服
example: I'm not going to believe it myself, never mind convince anyone else.
translation: 我自己都不会相信，更别提说服别人了。

meaning: v. 烹调，煮; n. 厨师，厨子
example: Captain Cook safely navigated his ship without accident for 100 voyages.
translation: 库克船长驾驶的船安全出航100次无事故。

meaning: n. 炊具；烹饪用水果；窜改者
example: induction cooker
translation: n. 电磁炉

meaning: n. 饼干；小甜点
example: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.
translation: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。

meaning: adj. 凉爽的；冷静的；出色的; v. 使…冷却；使…平静下来; n. 凉爽；凉爽的空气; adv. 冷静地
example: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
translation: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

meaning: v. 复制；复印；抄袭; n. 副本；一册；摹仿
example: I autographed a copy of one of my books.
translation: 我在自己的一本书上签了名。

meaning: n. 珊瑚；珊瑚虫; adj. 珊瑚的；珊瑚色的
example: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
translation: 珊瑚虽然看上去坚固，实际上非常易碎。

meaning: n. 不用电线的; adj. 无线的（副词cordlessly）
example: The waitress approached Picone with a cordless phone.
translation: 女服务员拿着无绳电话向皮科内走来。

meaning: n. （美）玉米；（英）谷物；[皮肤] 鸡眼; v. 腌；使成颗粒
example: They are offering farmers $2.15 a bushel for corn.
translation: 他们向农民出价每蒲式耳2.15美元收购玉米。

meaning: n. 角落，拐角处；地区，偏僻处；困境，窘境; v. 囤积；相交成角
example: Claire stared after him until he disappeared around a corner.
translation: 克莱尔一直注视着他，直到他消失在拐角。

meaning: n. 公司；法人（团体）；社团；大腹便便；市政当局
example: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
translation: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

meaning: v. 改正；告诫; adj. 正确的；恰当的；端正的
example: "That is correct, Meg," he answered in his cold, dead voice.
translation: “没错，梅格。”他用冰冷、阴沉的声音答道。

meaning: n. 改正，修正
example: Once the plaster was dry there was no room for correction.
translation: 一旦灰泥一干，就没有机会修改了。

meaning: v. 符合，一致；相应；通信
example: Her expression is concerned but her body-language does not correspond.
translation: 她满脸关切之情，但她的肢体语言并非如此。

meaning: adj. 腐败的，贪污的；堕落的; v. 使腐烂；使堕落，使恶化
example: He has been scathing in his denunciation of corrupt and incompetent politicians.
translation: 他抨击起那些腐败无能的政客来一直都很尖刻犀利。

meaning: v. 花费；使付出；使花许多钱; n. 费用，代价，成本；损失
example: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
translation: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

meaning: adj. 舒适的；惬意的; n. 保温罩
example: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
translation: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

meaning: n. 小屋；村舍；（农舍式的）小别墅
example: The studio is midway between his aunt's old home and his cottage.
translation: 工作室就在从他姑姑的老宅到他的小屋的中途。

meaning: n. 棉花；棉布；棉线; v. 一致；理解；和谐；亲近; adj. 棉的；棉制的
example: Some of the food crops failed. However, the cotton did quite well.
translation: 有些粮食作物歉收。但棉花的收成仍相当不错。

meaning: n. 咳嗽，咳嗽声；咳嗽病; v. 咳出
example: Will this be enough to persuade Congress to cough up?
translation: 这能说服国会掏钱吗？

meaning: aux. 能够; v. 能（can的过去式）
example: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
translation: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

meaning: v. 计算；认为; n. 计数；计算；伯爵
n. 柜台；对立面；计数器；（某些棋盘游戏的）筹码; v. 反击，还击；反向移动，对着干；反驳，回答; adj. 相反的; adv. 反方向地；背道而驰地
example: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
translation: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

meaning: n. 国家，国土；国民；乡下，农村；乡村；故乡; adj. 祖国的，故乡的；地方的，乡村的；国家的；粗鲁的；乡村音乐的
example: in the country
translation: 在乡下

meaning: n. 农村，乡下；乡下的全体居民
example: They will be in raptures over the French countryside.
translation: 他们会深深爱上法国的乡村。

meaning: n. 对；夫妇；数个; v. 结合；成婚
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: n. 勇气；胆量
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 科目；课程；过程；进程；道路；路线，航向；一道菜; v. 追赶；跑过
example: She'd half expected him to withdraw from the course.
translation: 她多少已经预料到他会中途就退出这门课程。

meaning: n. 法院；球场；朝廷；奉承; v. 招致（失败、危险等）；向…献殷勤；设法获得
n. 庭院，院子；天井
example: Dena took them into the courtyard to sit in the sun.
translation: 德娜带他们到院子里晒太阳。

meaning: n. 堂兄弟姊妹；表兄弟姊妹
example: I tried again to get ahold of my cousin Joan.
translation: 我再次尝试联系我的表妹琼。

meaning: v. 包括；采访，报导；涉及; n. 封面，封皮；盖子；掩蔽物;幌子，借口
example: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.
translation: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。

meaning: n. 奶牛，母牛；母兽; v. 威胁，恐吓
example: Switzerland isn't all cow bells and yodelling, you know.
translation: 你知道，瑞士不仅仅只有牛铃声和约德尔调歌声。

meaning: n. 牛仔；牧童；莽撞的人
example: He had sought work as a cowboy, rounding up cattle.
translation: 他找了一份放牛的差事，负责把牛赶到一起。

meaning: n. 撞碎；坠毁；破产；轰隆声；睡觉; v. 摔碎；坠落；发出隆隆声；(金融企业等)破产
example: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.
translation: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。

meaning: n. 蜡笔，有色粉笔; v. 以蜡笔作画，用颜色粉笔画
example: The mother sponged crayon marks off.
translation: 母亲用湿海绵擦去了痕迹.

meaning: adj. 疯狂的；狂热的，着迷的
example: "That's crazy," I said. "Isn't it just?" he said.
translation: “那简直是疯了，”我说。“谁说不是呢？”他说。

meaning: n. 奶油，乳脂；精华；面霜；乳酪
example: ice cream
translation: 冰淇淋

meaning: v. 创造，创作；造成
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: n. 动物，生物；人；创造物
example: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
translation: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

meaning: n. 信用，信誉；[金融] 贷款；学分；信任；声望; v. 相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂
example: Make a note of credit card numbers and check expiry dates.
translation: 记下信用卡卡号，核对有效期限。

meaning: n. 队，组；全体人员，全体船员; v. 一起工作
example: The ship's crew were now exhausted and utterly demoralized.
translation: 这艘船上的船员现在都已精疲力竭，彻底丧失了信心。

meaning: n. 罪行，犯罪；罪恶；犯罪活动; vt. 控告……违反纪律
example: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.
translation: 这是间谍罪，应判死刑。

meaning: n. 罪犯; adj. 刑事的；犯罪的；罪恶的
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: n. （批评判断的）标准；准则；规范；准据
example: Senior managers stipulated work-life balance as their main criterion when choosing jobs.
translation: 高级经理人把工作与生活的平衡作为择业的主要标准。

meaning: n. 产量；农作物；庄稼；平头; v. 种植；收割；修剪；剪短
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: n. 交叉，十字；十字架，十字形物; v. 交叉；杂交；横过; adj. 交叉的，相反的；乖戾的；生气的
example: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
translation: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

meaning: n. 十字路口；杂交；横渡；横道; v. 横越（cross的现在分词）
example: Our reporter spent the night crossing the border from Austria into Slovenia.
translation: 我们的记者用了一夜时间，穿过奥地利边境进入斯洛文尼亚。

meaning: n. 十字路口；交叉路口；聚会的中心地点（crossroad的复数形式）
example: at the crossroads
translation: 在十字路口

meaning: n. 群众,一伙;一堆,许多,大众; v. 拥挤,挤满,挤进
example: The crowd in Robinson's Coffee-House was thinning, but only by degrees.
translation: 鲁宾逊咖啡屋里的人正在变少，但也只是渐少而已。

meaning: adj. 拥挤的；塞满的; v. 拥挤（crowd的过去分词）
example: Thousands of refugees are packed into over-crowded towns and villages.
translation: 成千上万的难民涌入拥挤不堪的城镇和村庄。

meaning: adj. 残酷的，残忍的；使人痛苦的，让人受难的；无情的，严酷的
example: He is still the butt of cruel jokes about his humble origins.
translation: 他仍然因出身低微而被人无情嘲笑。

meaning: v. 叫喊；哭出；大声说; n. 叫喊；叫声；口号；呼叫
n. 立方；立方体；骰子; v. 使成立方形；使自乘二次；量…的体积
example: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly.
translation: 她吸了块冰块到嘴里，嘎嘣嘎嘣地大声嚼着。

meaning: adj. 立方体的，立方的; n. (Cubic)人名；(罗)库比克
example: The average flow of the river is 200 cubic metres per second.
translation: 这条河平均流量为每秒二百立方米.

meaning: n. 烹饪，烹调法
example: Elizabeth David enthuses about the taste, fragrance and character of Provencal cuisine.
translation: 伊丽莎白·戴维对普罗旺斯菜肴的色香味津津乐道。

meaning: n. 文化，文明；修养；栽培; v. [细胞][微] 培养（等于cultivate）
example: The city of Memphis is promoting a populist approach to culture.
translation: 孟菲斯市在推行文化的民粹主义道路。

meaning: n. 杯子；奖杯；酒杯; v. 使成杯状；为…拔火罐
example: My wife was tucked up in bed with her cup of cocoa.
translation: 我老婆端着一杯热可可窝在床上。

meaning: n. 碗柜；食橱
example: There's an extra blanket in the bottom drawer of the cupboard.
translation: 壁橱最下面的抽屉里还有一条多余的毯子。

meaning: v. 治疗；治愈；使硫化；加工处理; n. 治疗；治愈；[临床] 疗法
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: adj. 好奇的，有求知欲的；古怪的；爱挑剔的
example: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
translation: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

meaning: n. 货币；通货
example: You need hard currency to get anything halfway decent.
translation: 你得有硬通货才能买到还算不错的东西。

meaning: n. 课程
example: The national curriculum must be a guide, not a straitjacket.
translation: 国家课程设置必须是指导性的，而不是约束性的。

meaning: n. 幕；窗帘; v. 遮蔽；装上门帘
example: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
translation: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

meaning: n. 垫子；起缓解作用之物；（猪等的）臀肉；银行储蓄; v. 给…安上垫子；把…安置在垫子上；缓和…的冲击
example: Lie face upwards with a cushion under your head.
translation: 头枕垫子仰卧。

meaning: n. 习惯，惯例；风俗；海关，关税；经常光顾；[总称]（经常性的）顾客; adj. （衣服等）定做的，定制的
example: It was his invariable custom to have one whisky before his supper.
translation: 晚饭前来杯威士忌，这是他一直以来的习惯。

meaning: n. 顾客；家伙
example: In some stores we were undermanned and customer service was suffering.
translation: 有些店我们人手不足，对顾客照顾不周。

meaning: n. 海关；风俗（custom的复数）；习惯；关税
example: customs clearance
translation: 海关放行；结关

meaning: n. 伤口；切口；削减；（服装等的）式样；削球；切入; v. [机] 切割；削减；缩短；刺痛; adj. 割下的；雕过的；缩减的
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: n. 循环；周期；自行车；整套；一段时间; v. 使循环；使轮转
example: Eddie parked his cycle against a lamp post and padlocked it.
translation: 埃迪把他的自行车靠在路灯柱上，用挂锁锁好。

meaning: n. 骑自行车的人
example: I narrowly missed a cyclist who wobbled into my path.
translation: 我险些被一个摇摇晃晃迎面而来的骑车人撞倒。

meaning: n. 爸爸；爹爹
example: There's always tons of scrap paper in Dad's office.
translation: 爸爸的办公室里总有大量的废纸。

meaning: adj. 日常的；每日的; n. 日报；朝来夜去的女佣; adv. 日常地；每日；天天
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: v. 控制；筑坝; n. [水利] 水坝；障碍
example: Breaking the dam could submerge downstream cities such as Wuhan.
translation: 摧毁大坝可能会淹没下游城市，比如武汉。

meaning: n. 损害；损毁；赔偿金; v. 损害；损毁
example: It's a fair guess to say that the damage will be extensive.
translation: 说损失会很严重想必猜得不错。

meaning: v. 使潮湿；使阻尼；使沮丧，抑制; n. 潮湿，湿气; adj. 潮湿的
example: They all walked barefoot across the damp sand to the water's edge.
translation: 他们全都光着脚走过潮湿的沙地来到水边。

meaning: n. 舞蹈；舞会；舞曲; v. 跳舞；跳跃；飘扬; adj. 舞蹈的；用于跳舞的
example: It's really an amazing dance. It just always brings the house down.
translation: 这真是一段精彩绝伦的舞蹈表演，每次总是博得全场喝彩。

meaning: n. 危险；危险物，威胁
example: Subconsciously I had known that I would not be in personal danger.
translation: 我潜意识里已经知道我不会有人身危险。

meaning: adj. 危险的
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: n. 挑战；挑动; v. 敢冒；不惧
example: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
translation: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

meaning: adj. 黑暗的，深色的；模糊的；无知的；忧郁的; n. 黑暗；夜；黄昏；模糊
example: In the dark my sense of hearing becomes so acute.
translation: 黑暗中我的听觉变得异常灵敏。

meaning: n. 黑暗；模糊；无知；阴郁
example: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
translation: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

meaning: n. 破折号；冲撞; v. 使…破灭；猛撞；泼溅
example: The Prince was driving with great fire and dash.
translation: 王子潇洒威猛地驱车而行。

meaning: n. 数据（datum的复数）；资料
example: If they value these data, let them pay for them.
translation: 他们要是看重这些数据，就让他们出钱买。

meaning: n. 数据库，资料库
n. 日期；约会；年代；枣椰子; v. 过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期）
example: The Labour government has to date resisted all supplications.
translation: 到目前为止工党政府回绝了所有的请愿求情。

meaning: n. 女儿；[遗][农学] 子代; adj. 女儿的；子代的
example: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: n. 黎明；开端; v. 破晓；出现；被领悟
example: At dawn I woke him up and said we were leaving.
translation: 黎明时分，我把他叫醒，告诉他我们要走了。

meaning: n. 一天；时期；白昼; adv. 每天；经常在白天地; adj. 日间的；逐日的
example: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
translation: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

meaning: n. 白天；日光；黎明；公开
adj. 无生命的；呆板的；废弃了的; adv. 完全地; n. 死者
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: n. 截止期限，最后期限
example: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

meaning: adj. 聋的
example: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears.
translation: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。

meaning: v. 处理；给予；分配；发牌; n. 交易；（美）政策；待遇；份量
adj. 亲爱的；尊敬的；昂贵的; adv. 高价地；疼爱地; int. 哎呀; n. 亲爱的人
example: Outside, Bruce glanced at his watch: "Dear me, nearly oneo'clock."
translation: 出了门，布鲁斯瞥了一眼自己的手表，“天哪，快一点了。”

meaning: n. 死；死亡；死神；毁灭
example: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.
translation: 这是间谍罪，应判死刑。

meaning: v. 辩论，争论，讨论; n. 辩论；辩论会
example: There needs to be a properly informed public debate.
translation: 有必要让公众在充分知情的状况下展开辩论。

meaning: n. 债务；借款；罪过
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: n. 十年，十年期；十
example: These developments were foreseen in embryo more than a decade ago.
translation: 这些发展早在十多年前的萌芽阶段就已预见到。

meaning: n. 十二月
example: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
translation: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

meaning: v. 决定；解决；判决
example: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

meaning: n. 决定，决心；决议
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: v. 宣布，声明；断言，宣称
example: declare oneself
translation: 显露身分；发表意见

meaning: n. 下降；衰退；斜面; v. 下降；衰落；谢绝
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: v. 装饰；布置；授勋给
example: Use shells to decorate boxes, trays, mirrors or even pots.
translation: 用贝壳来装点盒子、托盘、镜子甚至是花盆。

meaning: n. 装饰，装潢；装饰品；奖章
example: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
translation: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

meaning: n. 减少，减小；减少量; v. 减少，减小
example: If the egg is not fertilised oestrogen and progesterone decrease.
translation: 如果卵细胞没有受精，雌激素和黄体荷尔蒙就会下降。

meaning: n. 行动；功绩；证书；[法] 契据; vt. 立契转让
example: The perpetrators of this evil deed must be brought to justice.
translation: 必须将参与这一恶行的凶手绳之以法。

meaning: n. 深处；深渊; adj. 深的；低沉的；深奥的; adv. 深入地；深深地；迟
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: adv. 深刻地；浓浓地；在深处
example: The Republicans were deeply split between progressives and conservatives.
translation: 共和党的革新派和保守派之间存在严重的分裂。

meaning: n. 鹿
example: red deer
translation: n. [动]马鹿；欧亚洲的赤鹿

meaning: v. 击败，战胜；挫败；使…失败; n. 失败的事实；击败的行为
example: After the pain of defeat passes, England have some thinking to do.
translation: 失败的痛苦过去以后，英国人应该认真反思一下。

meaning: v. 辩护；防护
example: Those people who took up weapons to defend themselves are political prisoners.
translation: 那些拿起武器自卫的人是些政治犯。

meaning: n. 防卫，防护；防御措施；防守; vt. 谋划抵御
example: national defense
translation: 国防

meaning: v. 延期；耽搁; n. 延期；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间
example: How much delay should we build into the plan?
translation: 我们应该为这个计划预留多少富余的时间？

meaning: v. 删除
example: We will be pleased to delete the charge from the original invoice.
translation: 我们决定将这笔费用从原始发票上删去。

meaning: adv. 故意地；谨慎地；慎重地
example: It looks as if the blaze was started deliberately.
translation: 看起来似乎是有人蓄意纵火。

meaning: adj. 微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；易碎的；纤弱的；清淡可口的
example: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
translation: 珊瑚虽然看上去坚固，实际上非常易碎。

meaning: adj. 美味的；可口的
example: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
translation: 这种稍加变化的可口煎蛋卷做起来又快又容易。

meaning: n. 高兴; v. 高兴
example: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success.
translation: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。

meaning: adj. 高兴的；欣喜的; v. 使…兴高采烈；感到快乐（delight的过去分词）
example: "You must come to Tinsley's graduation party." — "I'd be delighted."
translation: “你一定要来参加廷斯利的毕业聚会。”——“我很乐意。”

meaning: v. 交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生; n. 投球
example: I have orders to deliver it to Mr Demiris personally.
translation: 我奉命要把它送给德米里斯先生本人。

meaning: v. 要求；需要；查询; n. [经] 需求；要求；需要
example: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: n. 牙科医生
example: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

meaning: n. 部；部门；系；科；局
example: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department.
translation: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

meaning: n. 离开；出发；违背
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: v. 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖
example: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
translation: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

meaning: n. 存款；押金；订金；保证金；沉淀物; v. 使沉积；存放
example: This is more like a downpayment, or a deposit, if you like.
translation: 这更像是首付，也可以说是定金。

meaning: n. [海洋] 深度；深奥
example: Mr Gibson is clearly intellectually out of his depth.
translation: 吉布森先生显然才智不逮。

meaning: v. 描述，形容；描绘
example: describe as
translation: v. 描述为

meaning: n. 描述，描写；类型；说明书
example: We were in a disaster situation that defies description.
translation: 我们陷入了难以言表的糟糕处境。

meaning: v. 遗弃；放弃；逃跑; n. 沙漠；荒原；应得的赏罚; adj. 沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的
example: The vehicles have been modified to suit conditions in the desert.
translation: 车辆已改装过以适应沙漠的环境。

meaning: v. 应受，应得
example: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
translation: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

meaning: v. 设计；计划；构思; n. 设计；图案
example: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
translation: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

meaning: n. 欲望；要求，心愿；性欲; v. 想要；要求；希望得到…
example: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
translation: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

meaning: adj. 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的
example: Car firms are desperate to achieve economies of scale.
translation: 汽车厂商拼命想要实现规模经济。

meaning: n. 餐后甜点；甜点心
example: Scott was obviously inebriated by the time the dessert was served.
translation: 到了上甜点的时候，斯科特显然已经喝醉了。

meaning: n. 目的地，终点
example: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
translation: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

meaning: v. 破坏；消灭；毁坏
example: They can't destroy truth without destroying each and every one of us.
translation: 除非他们将我们赶尽杀绝，否则真理不灭。

meaning: adj. 侦探的; n. 侦探
example: "Once a detective, always a detective," he said lightly.
translation: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

meaning: n. 决心；果断；测定
example: It must have reinforced my determination to blend into my surroundings.
translation: 这势必让我更加下定决心融入周围环境。

meaning: v. （使）下决心，（使）做出决定
example: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
translation: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

meaning: v. 开发；进步；使成长；使显影
example: She won a grant to develop her own business.
translation: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

meaning: n. 发展；开发；发育；住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）；[摄] 显影
example: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
translation: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

meaning: v. 致力于；奉献
example: Faculty members devote most of their time to scholarly research.
translation: 全院教师大部分时间都用来从事学术研究。

meaning: n. 献身，奉献；忠诚；热爱
example: He was kneeling by his bed in an attitude of devotion.
translation: 他虔诚地跪在床边。

meaning: n. 图表；图解; v. 用图解法表示
example: Like any such diagram, it is a simplification.
translation: 像其他这种表格一样，这是简化了的。

meaning: n. 转盘；刻度盘；钟面; v. 拨号
example: Simply dial the number and tell us your area.
translation: 只需拨这个号码告诉我们你在什么地方。

meaning: n. 对话；意见交换; vi. 对话; vt. 用对话表达
example: The consulate will carryon a political dialogue with Indonesia.
translation: 领事馆将和印度尼西亚举行政治对话。

meaning: n. 钻石，金刚石；菱形；方块牌; adj. 菱形的；金刚钻的
example: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
translation: 钻石切割靠的是工匠的技艺。

meaning: n. 日志，日记；日记簿
example: In his diary of 1944 he proclaims unswerving loyalty to the monarchy.
translation: 他在1944年的日记里声称对君主忠贞不贰。

meaning: n. 听写；口述；命令
example: She is transcribing, from his dictation, the diaries of Simon Forman.
translation: 她正根据他的口述记录西蒙·福曼的日记。

meaning: n. 字典；词典
example: The dictionary is a vast treasure trove of information.
translation: 那本词典是个巨大的信息宝库。

meaning: v. 死亡；凋零；熄灭; n. 冲模，钢模；骰子
example: He won his first Derby on the aptly named "Never Say Die".
translation: 他驾驭着这匹名副其实的“永不言败”夺得了他的第一个德比马赛冠军。

meaning: n. 饮食；食物；规定饮食; v. 节食
example: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

meaning: v. 使…相异；使…不同; n. (Differ)人名；(法)迪费
example: That is where we differ.
translation: 那就是我俩看法不一的地方。

meaning: n. 差异；不同；争执
example: The difference between who you are and who you want to be is what you do.
translation: 你是什么样的人和你想成为什么样的之间的差距就是，你做了什么。

meaning: adj. 不同的；个别的，与众不同的
example: Things might have been different if I'd talked a bit more.
translation: 如果当时我再多说一点的话，结果或许会不一样。

meaning: adj. 困难的；不随和的；执拗的
example: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
translation: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

meaning: n. 困难，困境
example: He was going red in the face and breathing with difficulty.
translation: 他涨红了脸，费力地喘着气。

meaning: v. 挖，掘；探究; n. 戳，刺；挖苦
example: Dig a largish hole and bang the stake in first.
translation: 挖一个大点儿的洞，先把木桩敲进去。

meaning: v. 消化；吸收；融会贯通; n. 文摘；摘要
example: The organization publishes a regular digest of environmental statistics.
translation: 该组织定期出版一份环境统计数据摘要。

meaning: adj. 数字的；手指的; n. 数字；键
example: The BBC has just successfully demonstrated a new digital radio transmission system.
translation: 英国广播公司刚刚成功地演示了一套新的数字无线电传输系统。

meaning: n. 尊严；高贵
example: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
translation: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

meaning: n. 困境；进退两难；两刀论法
example: Public policy on the family presents liberals with a dilemma.
translation: 有关家庭的公共政策使自由主义者陷入了进退两难的境地。

meaning: n. 方面;[数] 维；尺寸；次元；容积 vt标出尺寸; adj. 规格的
example: There was undeniably a strong theoretical dimension to his thinking.
translation: 不可否认，他的思想很有理论深度。

meaning: v. 进餐，用餐; n. (Dine)人名；(意、葡)迪内；(英)戴恩；(法)迪纳
example: They used to enjoy going out to dine.
translation: 他们以前很喜欢出去吃饭。

meaning: n. 晚餐，晚宴；宴会；正餐
example: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight.
translation: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。

meaning: n. 恐龙；过时、落伍的人或事物
example: The fossils at Dinosaur Cove are embedded in hard sandstones.
translation: 恐龙峡谷中的化石都嵌在坚硬的砂岩中。

meaning: n. 二氧化物
example: The two principal combustion products are water vapor and carbon dioxide.
translation: 两种主要的燃烧产物是水蒸气和二氧化碳。

meaning: v. 浸，泡，蘸；舀取；把伸入; n. 下沉，下降；倾斜；浸渍，蘸湿
example: hot dip
translation: 热浸镀

meaning: n. 毕业证书，学位证书；公文，文书；奖状; vt. 发给…毕业文凭
example: a BTEC Higher National Diploma in Public Service Studies
translation: BTEC公共服务科高等国家证书

meaning: adj. 直接的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的; v. 管理；指挥；导演；指向; adv. 直接地；正好；按直系关系
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: n. 主任，主管；导演；人事助理
example: He was hauled before the managing director and fired.
translation: 他被叫去见总裁，然后就被解雇了。

meaning: n. [计] 目录；工商名录；姓名地址录; adj. 指导的；咨询的
example: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.
translation: 雅虎是最早且最知名的因特网目录服务网站。

meaning: n. 污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话
example: He claims Pasolini overtook and tackled him, pushing him into the dirt.
translation: 他声称帕索利尼追上去打他，把他推倒在烂泥里。

meaning: adj. 下流的，卑鄙的；肮脏的；恶劣的；暗淡的; v. 弄脏
example: Michael gave him a dirty look and walked out.
translation: 迈克尔狠狠地瞪了他一眼然后走开了。

meaning: n. 残疾；无能；无资格；不利条件
example: This public acknowledgment of Ted's disability pained my mother.
translation: 这一下大家都知道了特德的残疾，这让母亲非常痛苦。

meaning: adj. 残废的，有缺陷的; v. 使…失去能力（disable的过去分词）
example: The gym can be used by both able-bodied and disabled people.
translation: 这家健身房健全和残障人士都可使用。

meaning: n. 缺点；不利条件；损失
example: Depression is the third thing that works to my patients' disadvantage.
translation: 抑郁是威胁我的病人健康的第三大杀手。

meaning: v. 不同意；不一致；争执；不适宜
example: You and I are going to have to agree to disagree then.
translation: 那你我只能各自保留不同意见了。

meaning: n. 不一致；争论；意见不同
example: Britain and France have expressed some disagreement with the proposal.
translation: 英国和法国对这项提案已经发表了一些反对意见。

meaning: v. 消失；失踪；不复存在
example: She stood watching the car's tail-lights disappear down the drive.
translation: 她站在那儿，望着小汽车的尾灯消失在车道尽头。

meaning: v. 使失望
example: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
translation: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

meaning: n. 失望；沮丧
example: If there was any disappointment it was probably temporary.
translation: 即便有点儿失望，也肯定是暂时的。

meaning: n. 灾难，灾祸；不幸
example: An airliner came close to disaster while approaching Heathrow Airport.
translation: 一架大型客机在飞近希思罗机场时差点儿发生空难。

meaning: n. 折扣；贴现率; v. 贴现；打折扣出售商品
example: I'll sell at a discount in return for a speedy sale.
translation: 为了尽快售出，我会打折销售。

meaning: v. 阻止；使气馁
example: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
translation: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

meaning: v. 发现；发觉
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: n. 发现，发觉；被发现的事物
example: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
translation: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

meaning: n. 歧视；区别，辨别；识别力
v. 讨论；论述，辩论
example: The Politburo has been meeting in Peking to discuss the situation.
translation: 政治局已在北京召开会议讨论形势。

meaning: n. 讨论，议论
example: She does like to have the last word in any discussion.
translation: 她确实喜欢商量什么事都最终自己说了算。

meaning: n. 病，[医] 疾病；弊病; vt. 传染；使…有病
example: The conditions are ripe for the spread of disease.
translation: 这种疾病传播的条件已经成熟。

meaning: adj. 令人厌恶的
example: It's disgusting that the taxpayer is subsidising this project.
translation: 由纳税人来资助这一项目实在是说不过去。

meaning: n. 盘；餐具；一盘食物；外貌有吸引力的人; v. 盛于碟盘中；分发；使某人的希望破灭；说（某人）的闲话
example: The coded signal is received by satellite dish aerials.
translation: 编码信号由碟形卫星天线接收。

meaning: n. [计] 磁盘，磁碟片；圆盘，盘状物；唱片
example: These files have been zipped up to take up less disk space.
translation: 这些文档已经进行了压缩，以节省磁盘空间。

meaning: v. 不喜欢，厌恶; n. 嫌恶，反感，不喜爱
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
translation: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: v. 解散；解雇；开除；让离开；不予理会、不予考虑
example: The Prime Minister has the power to dismiss and appoint senior ministers.
translation: 首相有权任免高级部长。

meaning: v. 违反；不服从
example: I recommend you not to disobey your officers.
translation: 我劝你不要不服从你的长官.

meaning: n. 距离；远方；疏远；间隔; v. 疏远；把…远远甩在后面
example: Jay had always tended to keep his girlfriends at a distance.
translation: 杰伊一贯和他的女朋友们保持距离。

meaning: adj. 遥远的；冷漠的；远隔的；不友好的，冷淡的
example: From somewhere distant he heard the clatter of a typewriter.
translation: 他听见从远处什么地方传来打字机的嗒嗒声。

meaning: n. 区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章
example: Lewis emerges as a composer of distinction and sensitivity.
translation: 刘易斯作为一位悟性很高的优秀作曲家崭露头角。

meaning: v. 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出
example: It is common to distinguish between personal and social ethics.
translation: 个人道德准则和社会道德准则常常不一致。

meaning: v. 分配；散布；分开；把…分类
example: We didn't understand how difficult it was to distribute a national paper.
translation: 我们不了解分销一份全国发行的报纸有多难。

meaning: n. 区域；地方；行政区
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: v. 打扰；妨碍；使不安；弄乱；使恼怒
example: The pictures were sensationalist and could seriously disturb younger readers.
translation: 这些图片大肆渲染，会让一些比较年轻的读者们惶恐不安。

meaning: adj. 令人不安的；烦扰的; v. 干扰；打断（disturb的ing形式）
example: Guy Powell, defending, told magistrates: "It's a sad and disturbing case."
translation: 盖伊·鲍威尔在进行辩护时对地方法官说道：“这是一件非常不幸、令人不安的案子。”

meaning: v. 潜水；跳水；俯冲；急剧下降; n. 潜水；跳水；俯冲；扑
example: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
translation: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

meaning: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；变化多的
example: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

meaning: v. 划分；除；分开；使产生分歧; n. [地理] 分水岭，分水线
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. [数] 除法；部门；分配；分割；师（军队）；赛区
example: Villa had just been relegated from the First Division.
translation: 维拉队刚刚从甲级联赛中降级。

meaning: adj. 晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的; v. 使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然; n. (Dizzy)人名；(英)迪齐
example: The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.
translation: 这类人可能会莫名其妙地感到头晕。

meaning: v. 修理；篡改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位; n. 医生；博士
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: n. 文件，公文；[计] 文档；证件; v. 用文件证明
example: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
translation: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

meaning: n. 狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；(俚)朋友; v. 跟踪；尾随
example: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
translation: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

meaning: n. 洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人; v. 把…打扮得花枝招展
example: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
translation: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

meaning: n. 美元
example: In early trading in Tokyo, the dollar fell sharply against the yen.
translation: 在东京市场早市开盘时，美元对日元的比价急剧下跌。

meaning: n. 门；家，户；门口；通道
example: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

meaning: n. 宿舍，学生宿舍; adj. 住宅区的
example: The students have barricaded themselves into their dormitory building.
translation: 学生们把自己关在了宿舍楼里。

meaning: n. 点，圆点；嫁妆; v. 打上点
example: He started for Dot's bedroom and Myrtle held him back.
translation: 他正要去多特的卧室，被默特尔拦住了。

meaning: n. 两倍；双精度型; adj. 双重的；两倍的; v. 加倍，加倍努力；快步走; adv. 双重地；两倍地；弓身地
example: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
translation: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

meaning: n. 怀疑；疑问；疑惑; v. 怀疑；不信；恐怕；拿不准
example: There can be little doubt that he will offend again.
translation: 毋庸置疑他还会再犯的。

meaning: adv. 向下，下去；在下面; adj. 向下的; n. 软毛，绒毛；[地质] 开阔的高地; prep. 沿着，往下; v. 打倒，击败
example: She dusted herself down and left to build her own career.
translation: 她重振旗鼓去开创自己的事业了。

meaning: v. [计] 下载
example: Users can download their material to a desktop PC.
translation: 用户可以把资料下载到台式机上。

meaning: adv. 在楼下; adj. 楼下的; n. 楼下
example: Sounds of voices and commotion could be heard downstairs now.
translation: 现在能听见楼下人声鼎沸。

meaning: adv. 往闹市区；在市区; adj. 市中心的; n. 市中心区；三分线以外
example: There is heavy traffic in the downtown area tonight.
translation: 今夜闹市区交通繁忙。

meaning: adj. 向下的，下降的; adv. 向下
example: His adult life mirrored the downward course of his father's life.
translation: 他成年后的生活反映出了他父亲的生活在走下坡路。

meaning: n. 十二个，一打; adj. 一打的
example: Ernest Brown lives about a dozen blocks from where the riots began.
translation: 欧内斯特·布朗住在离骚乱发生处几个街区远的地方。

meaning: abbr. 速度三角形定位法（dead reckoning）；数据记录器（Data Recorder）
example: Dr. Johnson and I have been trying to build him up physically.
translation: 约翰逊医生和我一直试图增强他的体质。

meaning: n. 汇票；草稿；选派；（尤指房间、烟囱、炉子等供暖系统中的）（小股）气流; v. 起草；制定；征募; adj. 初步画出或（写出）的；（设计、草图、提纲或版本）正在起草中的，草拟的；以草稿形式的；草图的
example: Officials have now been delegated to start work on a draft settlement.
translation: 现在已经委派官员着手起草解决方案。

meaning: v. 拖累；拖拉；缓慢而吃力地行进; n. 拖；拖累
example: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
translation: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

meaning: v. 画；拉；吸引; n. 平局；抽签
example: He was waving his arms to draw their attention.
translation: 他正挥手以引起他们的注意。

meaning: n. 缺点，不利条件；退税
example: The main drawback to it is the cost.
translation: 它的主要缺点是成本高。

meaning: n. 抽屉；开票人；出票人；起草者；酒馆侍
example: He folded the papers and stuck them in his desk drawer.
translation: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。

meaning: n. 图画；牵引；素描术; v. 绘画；吸引（draw的ing形式）；拖曳
example: He is moving ever closer to drawing his pension.
translation: 他就要领取养老金了。

meaning: v. 梦想；做梦，梦见；想到; n. 梦想，愿望；梦; adj. 梦的；理想的；不切实际的
example: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
translation: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

meaning: v. 给…穿衣; n. 连衣裙；女装
example: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
translation: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

meaning: n. 干燥机；干燥剂；吹风机
example: The soil is firming up now that the weather is drier.
translation: 天气干燥了,土壤也变得坚硬起来.

meaning: n. 训练；钻孔机；钻子；播种机; v. 钻孔；训练
example: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
translation: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

meaning: v. 喝，饮；吸收；举杯庆贺; n. 酒，饮料；喝酒
example: They drink bitter on draught in the local bar.
translation: 他们在当地的酒吧里喝桶装的苦啤酒。

meaning: v. 开车；猛击；飞跑; n. 驱动器；驾车；[心理] 内驱力，推进力；快车道
example: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless.
translation: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。

meaning: n. 驾驶员；驱动程序；起子；传动器
example: The lorry driver escaped unhurt, but a pedestrian was injured.
translation: 卡车司机安然脱险，但有一位行人受了伤。

meaning: v. 滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出; n. 滴；落下；空投；微量；滴剂
example: Drop the dough onto a baking sheet with a teaspoon.
translation: 用茶匙把生面团舀到烤盘上。

meaning: v. 淹没；把…淹死; n. (Drown)人名；(英)德朗
example: He tried to recollect things and drown himself in them.
translation: 他极力回想过去的事情而沉浸于回忆之中.

meaning: n. 药；毒品；麻醉药；滞销货; v. 使服麻醉药；使服毒品；掺麻醉药于
example: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
translation: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

meaning: v. 击鼓；大力争取; n. 鼓；鼓声
example: As he sang he kept time on a small drum.
translation: 他边唱边和着节拍敲一个小鼓。

meaning: v. 喝酒（drink的过去分词）; adj. 喝醉了的
example: "Tired and emotional" is a code word for being drunk.
translation: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

meaning: adj. 干的；口渴的；枯燥无味的；禁酒的; v. 把…弄干; n. 干涸
example: Investment could dry up and that could cause the economy to falter.
translation: 投资可能会中断，而这会引起经济衰退。

meaning: n. 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分; v. 闪避；没入水中
example: Drizzle the remaining dressing over the duck and salad.
translation: 将剩下的调料淋在鸭肉和色拉上。

meaning: adj. 到期的；预期的；应付的；应得的; n. 应付款；应得之物; adv. 正（置于方位词前）
example: Council members are due to have informal discussions later on today.
translation: 委员会成员定于今日晚些时候进行非正式讨论。

meaning: adj. 钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的; v. 使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和; n. (Dull)人名；(罗、匈)杜尔；(柬)杜；(英)达尔
example: The evidence was read out to the court in a dull monotone.
translation: 证据被当庭呆板地宣读了一遍。

meaning: n. 饺子，汤团；面团布丁
example: He is a dumpling.
translation: 他是一个矮胖的人.

meaning: prep. 在…的时候，在…的期间; n. (During)人名；(法)迪兰；(瑞典、利比)杜林
n. 黄昏，薄暮；幽暗，昏暗; adj. 微暗的; v. 使变微暗
example: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
translation: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

meaning: n. 灰尘；尘埃；尘土; v. 撒；拂去灰尘
example: Lights reflected off dust-covered walls creating a ghostly luminescence.
translation: 灯光照在满是灰尘的墙上，反射回苍白的冷光。

meaning: n. 垃圾箱；吃货
example: I kicked a dustbin very hard and broke my toe.
translation: 我狠狠地踢了一脚垃圾箱，结果脚趾骨折了。

meaning: adj. 落满灰尘的
example: They started strolling down the dusty road in the moonlight.
translation: 在月光下他们开始沿着满是尘土的路漫步。

meaning: n. 责任；[税收] 关税；职务
example: They clocked off duty and left at ten to three.
translation: 他们打卡下班，于2点50分离开。

meaning: abbr. 数字化视频光盘（Digital Video Disk）
example: Is it available on DVD yet?
translation: 这个现在有DVD版了吗？

meaning: adj. 动态的；动力的；动力学的；有活力的; n. 动态；动力
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: n. 王朝，朝代
example: The Seljuk dynasty of Syria was founded in 1094.
translation: 叙利亚的塞尔柱王朝始建于1094年。

meaning: adj. 每；各自的; adv. 每个；各自; pron. 每个；各自
example: His voice was harsh as he enunciated each word carefully.
translation: 他一字一顿，听上去很生硬。

meaning: adj. 渴望的；热切的；热心的; n. (Eager)人名；(英)伊格
example: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
translation: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

meaning: n. 鹰；鹰状标饰
example: Three cannabis plants were found by eagle-eyed police officers.
translation: 火眼金睛的警官发现了3株大麻。

meaning: n. 耳朵；穗；听觉；倾听; vi. （美俚）听见；抽穗
example: Her ear, shoulder and hip are in a straight line.
translation: 她的耳朵、肩膀和髋部呈一条直线。

meaning: adj. 早期的；早熟的; adv. 提早；在初期; n. (Early)人名；(英)厄尔利
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: v. 赚，赚得；获得，挣得；使得到；博得; n. (Earn)人名；(泰)炎
example: Ray will earn his keep on local farms while studying.
translation: 雷求学期间会在当地的农场干活赚取生活费。

meaning: n. 地球；地表，陆地；土地，土壤；尘事，俗事；兽穴; v. 把（电线）[电] 接地；盖（土）；追赶入洞穴
example: I was shocked, brought down to earth by this revelation.
translation: 真相的披露让我深感震惊，我被带回了现实。

meaning: n. 地震；大动荡
example: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

meaning: v. 减轻，缓和；使安心; n. 轻松，舒适；安逸，悠闲
example: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
translation: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

meaning: adv. 容易地；无疑地
example: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
translation: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

meaning: n. 东方；东风；东方国家; adj. 东方的；向东的；从东方来的; adv. 向东方，在东方
example: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
translation: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

meaning: n. 复活节
example: The word Easter derives from Eostre, the pagan goddess of spring.
translation: Easter（复活节）一词由Eostre（多神教的春天女神）衍生而来。

meaning: adj. 东方的；朝东的；东洋的; n. 东方人；（美国）东部地区的人
example: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
translation: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

meaning: adv. 向东方地; adj. 向东方的
example: They were pressing on eastwards towards the city's small airfield.
translation: 他们继续向东朝该市的小机场推进。

meaning: adj. 容易的；舒适的; adv. 不费力地，从容地; vi. 停止划桨; vt. 发出停划命令
example: It is easy to appreciate the craftsmanship of Armani.
translation: 阿玛尼的精致工艺很容易博得人们的赞誉。

meaning: v. 吃，喝；腐蚀；烦扰
example: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

meaning: n. 生态学；社会生态学
example: To keep ecology in balance is our duty.
translation: 保持生态平衡是我们的职责.

meaning: n. 边缘；优势；刀刃；锋利; v. 使锐利；将…开刃；给…加上边
example: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
translation: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

meaning: n. 版本
n. 编者，编辑；社论撰写人；编辑装置
example: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: v. 教育；培养；训练
example: Ruth's parents opted to educate her intensively at home.
translation: 露丝的父母选择了在家对她进行集中教育。

meaning: n. 教育；培养；教育学
example: Sex education is also expected to help check the spread of AIDS.
translation: 人们还希望性教育有助于控制艾滋病的蔓延。

meaning: n. 教育家；教育工作者；教师
example: The television producer today has to be part news person, part educator.
translation: 今天的电视制片人必须既是新闻人，又是教育者。

meaning: n. 影响；效果；作用; v. 产生；达到目的
example: effect on
translation: 对…的作用

meaning: n. 努力；成就
example: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
translation: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

meaning: n. 蛋；卵子；家伙；鸡蛋; v. 煽动；怂恿
example: As the egg whites cook, they coagulate and rise to the surface.
translation: 蛋白一煮就会凝结，并且浮起来。

meaning: n. 茄子; adj. 深紫色的
example: Now you just alternate layers of that mixture and eggplant.
translation: 现在你只需把茄子和拌料一层层交替放好。

meaning: n. 埃及（非洲国家）
example: The American Congress has agreed to forgive Egypt's military debt.
translation: 美国国会同意免除埃及的军事债务。

meaning: adj. 埃及的；埃及人的; n. 埃及人；古代埃及语
example: Leaders from around the world eulogized the Egyptian president.
translation: 全世界的领导人都致悼词称颂那位埃及总统。

meaning: num. 八；八个；第八; adj. 八的; n. 八字形
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: n. 十八，十八个; adj. 十八个的，十八的; num. 十八
example: Their two faces were hardly more than eighteen inches apart.
translation: 他俩的脸相隔还不到18英寸。

meaning: adj. 第八的；八分之一的; num. 第八；八分之一
example: This will be his eighth title bout in 19 months.
translation: 这将是他19个月里的第8次卫冕赛。

meaning: n. 八十；八十岁；八十年代; adj. 八十的，八十个的；八十岁的; num. 八十
example: The poll canvassed the views of almost eighty economists.
translation: 民意调查征询了将近80位经济学家的意见。

meaning: adj. 两者之中任一的；两者之中每一的; prep. 任何一个; conj. 也（用于否定句或否定词组后）；根本; pron. 任一，两方，随便哪一个；两者中的一个或另一个
example: She had met both sons and did not care for either.
translation: 两个儿子她都见了，一个都不喜欢。

meaning: n. 老人；长辈；年长者；父辈; adj. 年长的；年龄较大的；资格老的
example: She made liberal use of her elder sister's make-up and clothes.
translation: 她随便把姐姐的化妆品和衣服拿来用。

meaning: adj. 选出的；当选的；卓越的; n. 被选的人；特殊阶层；上帝的选民; v. 选举；选择；推选
example: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
translation: 市政会成员应对推选他们的人负责。

meaning: adj. 电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的; n. 电；电气车辆；带电体
example: All Dreamland's electric blankets are guaranteed for three years.
translation: 所有的梦乡牌电热毯质保3年。

meaning: adj. 有关电的；电气科学的
example: This degree programme is fully accredited by the Institution of Electrical Engineers.
translation: 这门学位课程经电气工程师学院鉴定完全合格。

meaning: n. 电力；电流；强烈的紧张情绪
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: adj. 电子的; n. 电子电路；电子器件
example: All the royal cars are fitted with electronic homing devices.
translation: 所有的皇家轿车都装有电子自导引装置。

meaning: adj. 高雅的，优雅的；讲究的；简炼的；简洁的
example: She produces elegant wedding gowns in a variety of sumptuous fabrics.
translation: 她用各种华贵的布料制作高雅的婚纱。

meaning: n. 象；大号图画纸
example: The pavilion has become a £4 million steel and glass white elephant.
translation: 这个耗资400万英镑、用钢与玻璃所构筑起的亭子已经成了一个华而不实的摆设。

meaning: n. 十一；十一个; adj. 十一的；十一个的; num. 十一；十一个
example: The Appeal Court has quashed the convictions of all eleven people.
translation: 上诉法庭已经撤销对所有11人的判决。

meaning: adv. 其他；否则；另外; adj. 别的；其他的; n. (Else)人名；(英)埃尔斯；(德)埃尔泽；(芬、丹)埃尔塞
example: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

meaning: v. 使局促不安；使困窘；阻碍
example: I did not embarrass her with my effusions.
translation: 我并没有太过热情而让她为难。

meaning: n. 大使馆；大使馆全体人员
example: Embassy security personnel refused to admit him or his wife.
translation: 使馆保安人员不允许他和夫人进入。

meaning: n. 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻; adj. 紧急的；备用的
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: n. 皇帝，君主
example: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

meaning: n. 帝国；帝王统治，君权
example: The Roman Empire was divided in the fourth century AD.
translation: 罗马帝国于公元4世纪分裂。

meaning: v. 使用，采用；雇用；使忙于，使从事于; n. 使用；雇用
example: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.
translation: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。

meaning: adj. 空的；无意义的；无知的；徒劳的; v. 使失去；使…成为空的; n. 空车；空的东西
example: Empty the contents of the pan into the sieve.
translation: 将锅里的东西倒到筛子上。

meaning: v. 鼓励，怂恿；激励；支持
example: The idea is to encourage people to get to know their neighbours.
translation: 其目的是促使人们结识邻居。

meaning: n. 鼓励
example: The encouragement of a friend spurred Chris into switching jobs.
translation: 在一位朋友的鼓励下，克理斯换了工作。

meaning: n. 结束；目标；尽头；末端；死亡; v. 结束，终止；终结
example: The agreement has raised hopes that the war may end soon.
translation: 那项协议使人们感到战争有望很快结束。

meaning: n. 结局；结尾
example: I nearly died when I learned where I was ending up.
translation: 得知自己到了哪里时，我简直要晕过去了。

meaning: adj. 无止境的；连续的；环状的；漫无目的的
example: We hear endless injunctions to build a sense of community among staff.
translation: 我们听到上面没完没了地讲要在员工中培养一种集体归属感。

meaning: n. 敌人，仇敌；敌军; adj. 敌人的，敌方的
example: The President spoke of the treacherous intentions of the enemy.
translation: 总统谈及了敌人的奸诈用心。

meaning: adj. 精力充沛的；积极的；有力的
example: We look for applicants who are numerate, computer-literate and energetic self-starters.
translation: 我们对求职者的要求是具备运算能力，熟练使用电脑，精力充沛而且工作积极主动。

meaning: n. [物] 能量；精力；活力；精神
n. 引擎，发动机；机车，火车头；工具
example: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
translation: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

meaning: n. 工程师；工兵；火车司机; v. 设计；策划；精明地处理
example: The RAF recognized him as an out-standingly able engineer.
translation: 英国皇家空军表彰他是一名非常能干的机械师。

meaning: n. 英格兰
example: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

meaning: adj. 英国人的；英国的；英文的; n. 英语；英国人；英文；英格兰人; vt. 把…译成英语
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: v. 欣赏，享受；喜爱；使过得快活
example: I enjoy pleasure as much as the next person.
translation: 我和别人一样愉快。

meaning: adj. 快乐的；有乐趣的；令人愉快的
example: It is always important to choose enjoyable, nutritious foods.
translation: 选择好吃的、营养价值高的食物总是很重要。

meaning: v. 扩大；放大；详述
example: Workmen were hired to remodel and enlarge the farm buildings.
translation: 雇用了工人来改造和扩建农场建筑。

meaning: adv. 足够地，充足地; n. 很多；充足; adj. 充足的; int. 够了！
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: n. [计] 询问，[贸易] 询盘
example: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
translation: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

meaning: v. 进入；开始；参加; n. [计] 输入；回车
example: Two men answer-ing the description of the suspects tried to enter Switzerland.
translation: 与描述的疑犯样子相符的两名男子试图进入瑞士。

meaning: n. 企业；事业；进取心；事业心
example: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention.
translation: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。

meaning: n. 娱乐；消遣；款待
example: Crudeness is on the rise in all fields of entertainment.
translation: 所有娱乐领域都日益粗俗化。

meaning: adj. 热情的；热心的；狂热的
example: Bob Dole seemed less than enthusiastic about the proposed move.
translation: 鲍勃·多尔似乎对提议的这项行动不太感兴趣。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的；全体的; n. (Entire)人名；(英)恩泰尔
example: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.
translation: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。

meaning: n. 入口；进入; v. 使出神，使入迷
example: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

meaning: n. 进入；入口；条目；登记；报关手续；对土地的侵占
example: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
translation: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

meaning: n. 信封，封皮；包膜；[天] 包层；包迹
example: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
translation: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

meaning: n. 环境，外界
example: Outside the protected environment of institutional care he could not survive.
translation: 离开福利机构的照顾，离开这种受保护的环境，他将难以生存下去。

meaning: n. 嫉妒，妒忌；羡慕; v. 嫉妒，妒忌；羡慕
example: Unconscious envy manifests itself very often as this kind of arrogance.
translation: 潜意识里的嫉妒常表现为这种傲慢自大。

meaning: adj. 平等的；相等的；胜任的; v. 等于；比得上; n. 对手；匹敌；同辈；相等的事物
example: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
translation: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

meaning: n. 平等；相等；[数] 等式
example: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
translation: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

meaning: v. 装备，配备
example: Owners of restaurants would have to equip them to admit disabled people.
translation: 餐厅老板将必须在餐厅里配备能够接纳残疾人的设施。

meaning: n. 设备，装备；器材
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: n. 橡皮；擦除器；[计] 清除器
example: Rub out chalk marks with an eraser.
translation: 用黑板擦擦掉粉笔字迹.

meaning: n. 误差；错误；过失
example: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
translation: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

meaning: v. 爆发；喷出；发疹；长牙
example: He says it's like a volcano ready to erupt.
translation: 他说这就像一座即将喷发的火山。

meaning: v. 逃避，避开，避免；被忘掉；被忽视; n. 逃跑；逃亡；逃走；逃跑工具或方法；野生种；泄漏
example: No detail was too small to escape her attention.
translation: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

meaning: adv. 特别；尤其；格外
example: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

meaning: n. 散文；试图；随笔; v. 尝试；对…做试验
example: essay test
translation: n. 申论方式测验

meaning: n. 欧洲
example: Kaspar had spoken know-ledgeably about the state of agriculture in Europe.
translation: 卡斯帕对欧洲农业状况发表了一番颇有见地的见解。

meaning: adj. 欧洲的；欧洲人的; n. 欧洲人
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: v. 评价；估价；求…的值
example: Our research attempts to evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
translation: 我们的研究试图对不同药物的疗效进行评估。

meaning: adj. [数] 偶数的；平坦的；相等的; adv. 甚至；即使；还；实际上; v. 使平坦；使相等; n. (Even)人名；(法)埃旺；(德)埃文；(英)埃文
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n. 晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期; adj. 在晚上的；为晚上的；晚上用的; int. 晚上好（等于good evening）
