example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: n. 事件，大事；项目；结果
example: The birth of a live healthy baby is a truly blessed event.
translation: 一个健康活泼的婴儿的出生真是一件可喜的事情。

meaning: adv. 最后，终于
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: adv. 永远；曾经；究竟; n. (Ever)人名；(英)埃弗；(俄)叶韦尔；(西、法)埃韦尔
example: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

meaning: adj. 每一的，每个的；每隔…的; n. (Every)人名；(英)埃夫里
example: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
translation: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

meaning: pron. 每个人；人人
example: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
translation: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

meaning: adj. 每天的，日常的; n. 平时；寻常日子
example: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics.
translation: 1/5的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。

meaning: pron. 每个人；人人; n. 每个人
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: pron. 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切；万事
example: You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest. And if you do, if you stay positive, then you have a shot at a silver lining.
translation: 你需要尽你所能，最大限度地去努力。只要你这么做，只要你能保持乐观，你就会看见乌云背后的幸福线。

meaning: adv. 到处; n. 每个地方
example: Stars appeared everywhere, spinning round and round, faster and faster.
translation: 满眼金星乱转，而且越转越快。

meaning: n. 证据，证明；迹象；明显; v. 证明
example: He found evidence of mutated forms of the gene.
translation: 他找到了该基因出现了变异形式的证据。

meaning: adj. 明显的；明白的
example: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
translation: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

meaning: n. 演变；进化论；进展
example: the evolution of the human species
translation: 人类的进化

meaning: adj. 准确的，精密的；精确的; v. 要求；强求；急需
example: The exact locations are being kept secret for reasons of security.
translation: 确切地点因为安全原因要保密。

meaning: adv. 恰好地；正是；精确地；正确地
example: They found their computers producing different results from exactly the same calculation.
translation: 他们发现他们的计算机进行完全相同的计算会得出不同的结果。

meaning: n. 考试；测验
example: Schools were told their exam information had to be spot-on and accurate.
translation: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

meaning: v. 检查；调查； 检测；考试
example: I'll start with some generalities and then examine a few specific examples.
translation: 我首先进行概述，然后会分析几个实例。

meaning: n. 例子；榜样; vt. 作为…的例子；为…做出榜样; vi. 举例
example: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?
translation: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

meaning: adj. 卓越的；极好的；杰出的
example: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
translation: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

meaning: v. 不计；把…除外; prep. 除…之外; conj. 除了；要不是
example: He hadn't eaten a thing except for one forkful of salad.
translation: 除了一餐叉色拉，他什么都没吃。

meaning: n. 交换；交流；交易所；兑换; v. 交换；交易；兑换
example: This could intensify the risk of a nuclear exchange.
translation: 这可能会加剧爆发核战争的危险。

meaning: v. 激起；刺激…，使…兴奋
example: Reports of the plot of this unusual film tend to excite revulsion.
translation: 有关这部不同寻常电影的情节的报道常常令人生厌。

meaning: n. 借口；理由; v. 原谅；为…申辩；给…免去
example: He'd telephoned with some phoney excuse she didn't believe for a minute.
translation: 他找了某个她根本不会相信的借口给她打电话。

meaning: n. 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼; v. 锻炼；练习；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐
example: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks.
translation: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

meaning: n. 展览，显示；展览会；展览品
example: exhibition hall
translation: 展览厅

meaning: v. 存在；生存；生活；继续存在
example: I would have to learn, little by little, to exist alone.
translation: 我得慢慢学会独自生活。

meaning: n. 存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物
example: He had been a rock in the shifting sands of her existence.
translation: 他一直是她曲折坎坷的生活中的主心骨。

meaning: n. 出口，通道；退场; v. 退出；离去
example: Go north on I-15 to the exit just past Barstow.
translation: 沿着15号州际公路一直向北，一过巴斯托就从出口驶出。

meaning: v. 扩张；使膨胀；详述
example: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.
translation: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。

meaning: v. 期望；指望；认为；预料
example: Don't expect me to come and visit you there.
translation: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

meaning: n. 期待；预期；指望
example: The weight of expectation was getting to them.
translation: 他们逐渐感觉到了期望带来的压力。

meaning: n. 损失，代价；消费；开支; vt. 向…收取费用; vi. 被花掉
example: Owen was against it, on the grounds of expense.
translation: 欧文因费用问题对此表示反对。

meaning: adj. 昂贵的；花钱的
example: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

meaning: n. 经验；经历；体验; v. 经验；经历；体验
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: v. 尝试；进行实验; n. 实验，试验；尝试
example: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
translation: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

meaning: adj. 熟练的；内行的；老练的; n. 专家；行家；能手; vt. 当专家；在…中当行家
example: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition.
translation: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

meaning: v. 说明；解释
example: Her aggressiveness made it difficult for him to explain his own feelings.
translation: 她咄咄逼人的态度让他难以解释自己的感情。

meaning: n. 说明，解释；辩解
example: Their water was turned off weeks ago without explanation.
translation: 他们的水在几周以前就毫无理由地被切断了。

meaning: adj. 明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的
example: Criticism is hinted at, but never made explicit.
translation: 批评总是含沙射影，但从未明说。

meaning: v. 爆炸，爆发；激增
example: Catherine was ready to explode. "I think you're contemptible!"
translation: 凯瑟琳气得快要炸了。“我觉得你真是可鄙！”

meaning: v. 开发，开拓；剥削；开采; n. 勋绩；功绩
example: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways.
translation: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

meaning: v. 探索；探测；探险
example: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second-floor.
translation: 我会偷偷溜进去，轻手轻脚地查看一下二楼。

meaning: n. 探险家；勘探者；探测器；[医]探针
example: The explorer was ever awake for the dangers that surrounded him.
translation: 这个探险家时刻提防着周围的危险.

meaning: n. 输出，出口；出口商品; v. 输出物资
example: There is nothing sinister or conspiratorial about the export licensing system.
translation: 这种出口许可制度没有任何阴险或者见不得人的东西。

meaning: v. 揭露，揭发；使曝光；显示
example: When Myra told Karp she'd expose his past, he blew up.
translation: 当迈拉告诉卡普她会把他的过去全抖搂出去时，卡普大为光火。

meaning: v. 表达；快递; adj. 明确的；迅速的；专门的; n. 快车，快递，专使；捷运公司
example: He ran a newspaper stand outside the American Express office.
translation: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。

meaning: n. 表现，表示，表达；表情，脸色，态度，腔调，声调；式，符号；词句，语句，措辞，说法
example: gene expression
translation: [化]基因表达；基因表现

meaning: n. 延长；延期；扩大；伸展；电话分机
example: After a further four-month extension of her probation period, she was sacked.
translation: 在又试用了4个月后，她被开除了。

meaning: adv. 特别地，非常；另外; n. 临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品; adj. 额外的，另外收费的；特大的
example: She gave him an extra scoop of clotted cream.
translation: 她多给他加了一勺浓缩奶油。

meaning: adj. 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的
example: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
translation: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

meaning: adj. 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的; n. 极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物
example: The extreme right reared its ugly head in the 1980s.
translation: 极右势力在20世纪80年代有所抬头。

meaning: adv. 非常，极其；极端地
example: He was a stern critic but an extremely kindly man.
translation: 他是个苛刻的批评家，但却是个非常善良的人。

meaning: n. 眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点; v. 注视，看
example: He has a visual impairment in the right eye.
translation: 他右眼视力有损伤。

meaning: n. 视力；目力
example: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
translation: 他视力不好，算不上是一个出色的射手。

meaning: n. 目击者；见证人
example: An eyewitness identified him as the shooter.
translation: 一位目击者认出他就是那个开枪者。

meaning: n. 脸；表面；面子；面容；外观；威信; v. 向；朝
example: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
translation: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

meaning: adj. 面部的，表面的；脸的，面部用的; n. 美容，美颜；脸部按摩
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: n. 事实；实际；真相
n. 工厂；制造厂；代理店
example: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.
translation: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。

meaning: v. 褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失; adj. 平淡的；乏味的; n. [电影][电视] 淡出；[电影][电视] 淡入
v. 失败，不及格；破产；缺乏；衰退; n. 不及格
example: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

meaning: n. 失败；故障；失败者；破产
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: adj. 公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象] 晴朗的; adv. 公平地；直接地；清楚地; v. 转晴; n. 展览会；市集；美人
example: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
translation: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

meaning: adv. 相当地；公平地；简直; n. (Fairly)人名；(英)费尔利
example: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

meaning: n. 公平；美好；清晰；顺利性
example: It does hold you to certain standards of fairness.
translation: 它的确能让你恪守某些公平原则。

meaning: n. 信仰；信念；信任；忠实
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: v. 落下；变成；来临；减弱; n. 下降；秋天；瀑布; adj. 秋天的
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: adj. 错误的；虚伪的；伪造的; adv. 欺诈地
example: I was wearing false eyelashes and a sweater two sizes too small.
translation: 我戴着假睫毛，穿着小了两号的毛衣。

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常见的；亲近的; n. 常客；密友
example: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
translation: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

meaning: n. 家庭；亲属；家族；子女；[生]科；语族；[化]族; adj. 家庭的；家族的；适合于全家的
example: The family was often in flight, hiding out in friends' houses.
translation: 这一家人常常东躲西藏，在朋友家里避风头。

meaning: adj. 著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的
example: The chalky soil around Saumur produces the famous Anjou wines.
translation: 索米尔周围的白垩质土壤出产著名的安茹葡萄酒。

meaning: v. 煽动；刺激；吹拂; n. 迷；风扇；爱好者
example: As a boy he was a Manchester United fan.
translation: 小时候，他是曼联队的球迷。

meaning: n. 幻想；想象力；爱好; adj. 想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的; v. 想象；喜爱；设想；自负
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: adj. 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的; n. 古怪的人
example: I got a fantastic new job and my salary tripled.
translation: 我得到了一份非常好的新工作，薪水涨到了原来的3倍。

meaning: n. 幻想；白日梦；幻觉; adj. 虚幻的; v. 空想；想像
example: The film starts off realistically and then develops into a ridiculous fantasy.
translation: 电影以写实开头，然后却发展成为荒诞的幻想。

meaning: adv. 很；遥远地；久远地；到很远的距离；到很深的程度; adj. 远的；久远的; n. 远方
v. 经营；进展；遭遇；过活; n. 票价；费用；旅客；食物
example: The round-trip fare to Havana is 550 Irish punts ($673).
translation: 去哈瓦那的往返票价是550爱尔兰镑（673美元）。

meaning: v. 种田，务农；经营农场; n. 农场；农家；畜牧场
example: His most prized time, though, will be spent quietly on his farm.
translation: 不过，他最宝贵的时光将在自己的农场里平静地度过。

meaning: n. 农夫，农民
example: Mr Farmer and Mrs Jones both admitted conspiring to murder her husband.
translation: 法默先生和琼斯太太都承认密谋杀死了琼斯先生。

meaning: adj. 快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的; adv. 迅速地；紧紧地；彻底地; v. 禁食，斋戒; n. 斋戒；绝食
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: v. 使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于; n. (Fasten)人名；(英)法森
example: Builders must fasten down roofs of newly-built homes more securely.
translation: 建造工人必须把新建房屋的屋顶固定得更牢靠些。

meaning: adj. 肥的，胖的；油腻的；丰满的; n. 脂肪，肥肉; v. 养肥；在…中加入脂肪
n. 父亲，爸爸；神父；祖先；前辈; v. 发明，创立；当…的父亲
example: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

meaning: n. 故障；[地质] 断层；错误；缺点；毛病；（网球等）发球失误; v. 弄错；产生断层
example: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
translation: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

meaning: n. 偏爱；赞同；善行; v. 赞成；喜爱；有助于
example: You did us a great favour by disposing of that problem.
translation: 你解决了那个问题，可算是帮了我们一个大忙。

meaning: adj. 特别受喜爱的; n. 特别喜爱的人（或物）
example: "It's not one of my favourite forms of music." — "No."
translation: “这不是我喜欢的音乐形式。”——“对，这不是。”

meaning: v. 传真; n. 传真
example: The machine automatically downloads the required information to his or her fax.
translation: 机器能自动将需要的信息下载到传真机上。

meaning: n. 害怕；恐惧；敬畏；担心; v. 害怕；敬畏；为…担心
example: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
translation: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

meaning: v. 享受；款待，宴请; n. 筵席，宴会；节日
example: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
translation: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。

meaning: n. 羽毛; v. 用羽毛装饰
example: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
translation: 拔羽毛必须干净利落。

meaning: n. 二月
example: He was jailed in February 1992 and could be released next year.
translation: 他于1992年2月入狱，可能明年获释。

meaning: adj. 联邦的；同盟的；联邦政府的； 联邦制的; adv. 联邦政府地; n. (Federal)人名；(英)费德勒尔
example: The federal government hiked the tax on hard liquor.
translation: 联邦政府提高了烈性酒的税率。

meaning: n. 费用；酬金；小费; v. 付费给……
example: He finally corrected his misstatement and offered to reduce the fee.
translation: 他终于纠正了自己的错误说法，提出要减少费用。

meaning: v. 喂养；供给；放牧；抚养（家庭等）；靠…为生; n. 饲料；饲养；（动物或婴儿的）一餐
v. 感觉；认为；触摸；试探; n. 感觉；触摸
example: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
translation: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

meaning: n. 感觉，触觉；感情，情绪；同情; adj. 有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的; v. 感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸
example: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down.
translation: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。

meaning: n. 家伙；朋友；同事；会员; adj. 同伴的，同事的；同道的; vt. 使…与另一个对等；使…与另一个匹敌
example: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.
translation: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。

meaning: adj. 女性的；雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的; n. 女人；[动] 雌性动物
example: Valentino was virtually deified by legions of female fans.
translation: 瓦伦蒂诺几乎被众多的女性崇拜者奉若神明。

meaning: n. 栅栏；围墙；剑术; v. 防护；用篱笆围住；练习剑术
example: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
translation: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

meaning: n. 渡船；摆渡；渡口; v. （乘渡船）渡过；用渡船运送；空运
example: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

meaning: n. 节日；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐; adj. 节日的，喜庆的；快乐的
example: The Jamaica Festival is planning a series of workshops and business seminars.
translation: 牙买加节正在筹划一系列研习班和商务研讨会。

meaning: v. 取来；接来；到达；吸引; n. 取得；诡计
example: The painting is expected to fetch between two and three million pounds.
translation: 预计这幅画将售得两三百万英镑。

meaning: n. 发烧，发热；狂热; vt. 使发烧；使狂热；使患热病; vi. 发烧；狂热；患热病
example: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.
translation: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。

meaning: adj. 很少的；几乎没有的; pron. 很少; n. 很少数
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: n. 纤维；纤维制品
example: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
translation: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

meaning: n. 小说；虚构，编造；谎言
example: Fiction takes up a large slice of the publishing market.
translation: 小说在出版市场上占了很大的份额。

meaning: n. 领域；牧场；旷野；战场；运动场; v. 担任场外队员; adj. 扫描场；田赛的；野生的
example: He was the fastest thing I ever saw on a baseball field.
translation: 他是我在棒球场上见过的跑得最快的家伙。

meaning: adj. 凶猛的；猛烈的；暴躁的; n. (Fierce)人名；(英)菲尔斯
example: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months.
translation: 这一地区3个月以来不断发生激战。

meaning: n. 十五；十五个；十五人组成的橄榄球队; adj. 十五的; num. 十五
example: Fifteen-year-old Danny is on the run from a local authority home.
translation: 15岁的丹尼从地方当局的收容所逃跑了。

meaning: adj. 第五的；五分之一的; n. 第五；五分之一; num. 第五
example: He was the fifth person to be killed in sectarian violence.
translation: 他是宗派暴力中的第5个罹难者。

meaning: n. 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西; adj. 五十的；五十个的；众多的
example: The village is a settlement of just fifty houses.
translation: 这个村子里只住了50户人。

meaning: v. 打架；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案; n. 打架；战斗，斗志
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: n. 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像; v. 计算；出现；扮演角色
example: public figure
translation: 社会名人

meaning: n. 文件；档案；文件夹；锉刀; v. 提出；锉；琢磨；把…归档
example: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
translation: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

meaning: v. 装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职; n. 满足；填满的量；装填物
example: You don't need green fingers to fill your home with lush leaves.
translation: 不是园艺大师也可以把自己的家里装点得绿意盎然。

meaning: n. 电影；薄膜；胶卷；轻烟; v. 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影
example: The criticisms will not stop people flocking to see the film.
translation: 批评的声音不会阻止人们涌到影院观看这部电影。

meaning: adj. 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的; n. 决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版
example: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

meaning: n. 财政，财政学；金融; v. 负担经费，供给…经费
example: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
translation: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

meaning: v. 查找，找到；发现；认为；感到；获得; n. 发现
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: adj. 好的；优良的；细小的，精美的；健康的；晴朗的; n. 罚款; v. 罚款；澄清; adv. 很好地；精巧地
example: "I want to send a telegram." — "Fine, to whom?"
translation: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”

meaning: n. 手指；指针，指状物; v. 伸出；用手指拨弄
example: Isn't it about time that you pulled your finger out?
translation: 现在到了你该赶紧动起来的时候了吧？

meaning: n. 手指甲
example: I have the fingernail clippers.
translation: 我有指甲钳.

meaning: v. 完成；结束；用完; n. 结束；完美；回味（葡萄酒）
example: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
translation: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

meaning: n. 火；火灾；炮火；炉火；热情；激情；磨难; v. 点燃；解雇；开除；使发光；烧制；激动；放枪
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: n. 消防队员
n. 壁炉
example: He had a bed and a fireplace and everything.
translation: 他家里有一张床、一个壁炉及其他物品。

meaning: n. 柴火；木柴
example: I suggest we gather enough firewood to last the night.
translation: 我建议大家捡足够多的木柴来撑过这一晚。

meaning: n. 烟火；激烈情绪
example: firework display
translation: 放焰火；烟火

meaning: adj. 坚定的；牢固的；严格的；结实的; v. 使坚定；使牢固; adv. 稳固地; n. 公司；商号
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: adv. 坚定地，坚决地；坚固地，稳固地
example: The front door is locked and all the windows are firmly shut.
translation: 前门锁上了，所有窗户都关严了。

meaning: adv. 第一；首先；优先；宁愿; n. 第一；开始；冠军; adj. 第一的；基本的；最早的; num. 第一
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: v. 捕鱼，钓鱼；用钩捞取; n. 鱼，鱼类
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: n. 渔夫；渔人
example: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
translation: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

meaning: n. 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号; vt. 紧握；握成拳；用拳打
example: Without warning, Bardo smacked his fist into his open hand.
translation: 巴多没有任何预兆地一拳砸在自己摊开的手掌上.

meaning: v. 安装；使……适应；使……合身；与……相符; adj. 健康的；合适的；恰当的；准备好的; n. 合身；发作；痉挛
example: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
translation: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

meaning: n. 五，五个；五美元钞票; num. 五，五个; adj. 五的；五个的
example: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
translation: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

meaning: v. 使固定；修理；安装；准备; n. 困境；方位；贿赂
example: I wrote back to Meudon at once to fix up a meeting.
translation: 我马上给缪顿回信安排会面。

meaning: v. 标记；衰退；枯萎; n. 标志；旗子
example: On top of the gantry the American flag flew.
translation: 台架顶上飞舞着美国国旗。

meaning: n. 火焰；热情；光辉; v. 焚烧；泛红
example: Intense balls of flame rose up into the sky.
translation: 炽热的火球冲上天空。

meaning: adj. 燃烧的；火红的；激昂的; v. 燃烧；变亮；发光（flame的ing形式）; n. (Flaming)人名；(法)弗拉曼
example: Oh God, you get so flaming worked up about everything.
translation: 哦，天哪，你总是这么激动，真该死。

meaning: v. 使闪光；反射; n. 闪光，闪现；一瞬间; adj. 闪光的，火速的
example: She had heard the news-flash on a TV channel's news update.
translation: 她在一家电视台的新闻快讯中听到了这则简明新闻。

meaning: n. 手电筒；闪光灯
example: He took his flashlight from his jacket pocket and switched it on.
translation: 他从夹克口袋里拿出手电筒，打开开关。

meaning: adj. 平的；单调的；不景气的；干脆的；平坦的；扁平的；浅的; adv. （尤指贴着另一表面）平直地；断然地；水平地；直接地，完全地; n. 平地；公寓；平面; vt. 使变平；[音乐]使（音调）下降，尤指降半音; vi. 逐渐变平；[音乐]以降调唱（或奏）
example: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

meaning: v. 逃走；消失，消散
example: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
translation: 难民开始三五成群地陆续逃离该国。

meaning: n. 肉；肉体; v. 喂肉给…；使发胖
example: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
translation: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

meaning: adj. 灵活的；柔韧的；易弯曲的
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: n. 飞行；班机；逃走; v. 射击；使惊飞
example: She made her first and only space flight last September.
translation: 她第一次也是唯一一次宇宙飞行是在去年9月。

meaning: v. 使漂浮；实行; n. 彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍
example: A fresh egg will sink and an old egg will float.
translation: 新鲜鸡蛋会沉下去而不新鲜的会浮在上面。

meaning: v. 淹没；充满；溢出; n. 洪水；泛滥；一大批
example: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
translation: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

meaning: n. 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席; v. 铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: n. 面粉；粉状物质; v. 撒粉于；把…磨成粉
example: Just how much kneading is required depends on the sort of flour.
translation: 需要揉多久取决于用哪种面。

meaning: v. 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬; n. 流动；流量；涨潮，泛滥
example: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
translation: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

meaning: n. 花；精华；开花植物; v. 成熟，发育；开花；繁荣；旺盛
example: She now makes wonderful dried flower arrangements to order.
translation: 现在她为顾客定做漂亮的干花插花。

meaning: n. 流感
example: swine flu
translation: 猪流感

meaning: n. （语言、文章）流利；（技能）娴熟
example: His son was praised for speeches of remarkable fluency.
translation: 他儿子因为发言流畅自然而得到了表扬。

meaning: adj. 流畅的，流利的；液态的；畅流的
example: He is a fluent speaker of Hebrew.
translation: 他说一口流利的希伯来语。

meaning: v. 飞；驾驶飞机；飘扬; n. 飞行；苍蝇；两翼昆虫; adj. 敏捷的
example: His inspiration to fly came even before he joined the Army.
translation: 他想开飞机的念头在参军之前就有了。

meaning: n. 焦点；中心；清晰；焦距; v. 使集中；使聚焦
example: In the background, in soft focus, we see his smiling wife.
translation: 在背景部分，我们可以看到他妻子面带微笑的蒙影像。

meaning: n. 雾；烟雾，尘雾；迷惑; v. 使模糊；使困惑；以雾笼罩
example: His mind was in a fog when he finally got up.
translation: 他终于起床了，头脑一片混沌。

meaning: adj. 有雾的；模糊的，朦胧的
example: It was now the middle of November, cold and often foggy.
translation: 现在是11月中旬，天气寒冷而且经常有雾。

meaning: v. 折叠；合拢；抱住；笼罩; n. 折痕；信徒；羊栏
example: But as other shops fold, the march of the superstores continues.
translation: 但在其他商店纷纷关门倒闭之时，大型超市的强劲扩张势头却依旧不减。

meaning: n. 民族；人们；亲属（复数）; adj. 民间的
example: The folk-song world was another of his abiding interests.
translation: 民歌是他的另一个始终不渝的爱好。

meaning: v. 跟随；遵循；追求；密切注意，注视；注意；倾听; n. 跟随；追随
example: "Wait there!" Kathryn rose. "No, on second thought, follow me."
translation: “在那儿等着！”凯瑟琳站起身来，“不，我改主意了。跟我来。”

meaning: adj. 下面的；其次的，接着的; n. 下列事物；一批追随者; v. 跟随；沿行（follow的ing形式）
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: adj. 喜欢的；温柔的；宠爱的; n. (Fond)人名；(法)丰；(瑞典)丰德
example: He seemed fond of her in a strictly professional way.
translation: 他似乎只是出于职业缘故而喜欢她。

meaning: n. 食物；养料
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: v. 欺骗；开玩笑；戏弄; n. 傻瓜；愚人；受骗者; adj. 傻的
example: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
translation: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

meaning: adj. 愚蠢的；傻的
example: Any action on the basis of such fragmentary evidence would be foolish.
translation: 基于如此不完整的证据采取的任何行动都是愚蠢的。

meaning: n. 脚；英尺；步调；末尾; v. 步行；跳舞；总计
example: I tried to reach the foot brakes but I couldn't.
translation: 我试图去够脚刹，但是没能踩到。

meaning: n. 足球，橄榄球; vi. 踢足球；打橄榄球
example: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
translation: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

meaning: prep. 为，为了；因为；给；对于；至于；适合于; conj. 因为
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: v. 禁止；不准；不允许；〈正式〉严禁
example: Heaven forbid that he should leave because of me!
translation: 但愿他不会因为我而离开！

meaning: n. 力量；武力；军队；魄力; v. 促使，推动；强迫；强加
example: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

meaning: v. 预报，预测；预示; n. 预测，预报；预想
example: The weather forecast is for showers and overcast skies.
translation: 天气预报上说多云并伴有阵雨。

meaning: n. 额，前额
example: She has a poor complexion and pock marks on her forehead.
translation: 她满面菜色，额头上有些麻子。

meaning: adj. 外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的
example: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
translation: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

meaning: n. 外地人，外国人
example: You don't sound like a foreigner talking English.
translation: 听你讲英语，不像是外国人。

meaning: v. 预见；预知
example: We do not foresee any problems.
translation: 我们预料不会出任何问题。

meaning: v. 植树于，使成为森林; n. 森林
example: The dampness of the forest did not agree with him physically.
translation: 他的身体不能适应森林的潮湿。

meaning: adv. 永远；不断地；常常
example: Although they're expensive, they last forever and never go out of style.
translation: 尽管价格昂贵，但它们经久耐用，永不过时。

meaning: v. 忘记；忽略; n. (Forget)人名；(法)福尔热
example: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
translation: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

meaning: adj. 健忘的；不注意的；疏忽的；使遗忘的
example: My mother has become very forgetful and confused recently.
translation: 我妈妈近来变得非常健忘，糊里糊涂。

meaning: v. 原谅；免除（债务、义务等）
example: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him.
translation: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

meaning: n. 叉；餐叉；耙; v. 叉起；使成叉状
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 形式，形状；形态，外形；方式；表格; v. 构成，组成；排列，组织；产生，塑造
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: n. 格式；版式；开本; v. 使格式化；规定…的格式
example: A new format would alienate its ageing readership without attracting young readers.
translation: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

meaning: adj. 从前的，前者的；前任的; n. 模型，样板；起形成作用的人
example: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
translation: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

meaning: n. 两星期
example: in a fortnight's time
translation: 在两周的时间内

meaning: adj. 幸运的；侥幸的；吉祥的；带来幸运的
example: She is in the fortunate position of having plenty of choice.
translation: 好在她有很多选择。

meaning: n. 财富；命运；运气; vt. 给予财富; vi. 偶然发生
example: She built up her fortune by cannily playing the stock market.
translation: 她炒股有方，发了大财。

meaning: n. 四十; adj. 四十的；四十个的
example: Forty or fifty women were sitting cross-legged on the ground.
translation: 四五十个女人盘腿坐在地上。

meaning: adj. 向前的；早的；迅速的; adv. 向前地；向将来; v. 促进；转寄；运送; n. 前锋
example: The car passed over the body twice, once backward and then forward.
translation: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

meaning: v. 创立，建立；创办
example: They found a labyrinth of tunnels under the ground.
translation: 他们发现了一处迷宫似的地道。

meaning: adj. 创办的；发起的; v. [机] 铸造；建造；以…为基础（found的ing形式）; n. [机] 铸造；溶解
example: founding member
translation: 创始成员国；创办会员

meaning: n. 喷泉，泉水；源泉
example: Snape wrote a receipt with a gold fountain pen.
translation: 斯内普用金笔开了一张收据。

meaning: num. 四；四个; adj. 四的；四个的; n. (Four)人名；(西)福尔；(法)富尔
example: I went through about four years of being addicted to video games.
translation: 我大约有4年时间沉迷在电子游戏中。

meaning: num. 十四；十四个；第十四; n. 十四的记号；十四岁；十四点钟；十五世纪
example: "Fourteen minutes," Chris said, taking a peep at his watch.
translation: “14分钟,”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道.

meaning: adj. 第四的，第四个的；四分之一的; n. 第四，月的第四日；四分之一; num. 第四
example: She had been sitting with her knitting at her fourth-floor window.
translation: 她那时正坐在5楼的窗前织东西。

meaning: v. 欺骗；使变酸; n. 狐狸；狡猾的人
example: It shows a fox being disembowelled by a pack of hounds.
translation: 画面中一只狐狸正被一群猎狗撕咬得肠子外流。

meaning: adj. 脆的；易碎的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: adj. 芳香的；愉快的
example: It leaves your hair smelling deliciously fresh and fragrant.
translation: 它会让头发闻起来清新、芳香，令人愉悦。

meaning: n. 框架，骨架；结构，构架
example: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
translation: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

meaning: adj. 免费的；自由的，不受约束的；[化学] 游离的; v. 使自由，解放；释放; adv. 自由地；免费; n. (Free)人名；(英)弗里
example: I wasn't expecting you to do it for free.
translation: 我并没有指望你白干。

meaning: n. 自由，自主；直率
example: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word "freedom"
translation: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

meaning: n. 高速公路
example: Governor Deukmejian called for an inquiry into the freeway's collapse.
translation: 德克梅吉恩州长要求对高速公路塌陷事件进行调查.

meaning: v. 冻结；冷冻；僵硬; n. 冻结；凝固
example: A wage freeze was imposed on all staff earlier this month.
translation: 这个月早些时候，所有员工的工资都被冻结了。

meaning: adj. 冰冻的；严寒的；冷冻用的
example: Freezing weather in spring hampered the hens' ability to lay.
translation: 春天严寒的天气降低了母鸡的产蛋能力。

meaning: adj. 法国的；法语的；法国人的; n. 法国人；法语
example: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n. 法国人
example: The Frenchman held his own against the challenger.
translation: 这名法国人顶住了挑战者的进攻。

meaning: adj. 频繁的；时常发生的；惯常的; v. 常到，常去；时常出入于
example: Bordeaux is on the main Paris-Madrid line so there are frequent trains.
translation: 波尔多位于巴黎到马德里的铁路主干线上，来往列车频繁。

meaning: adj. 新鲜的；清新的；淡水的；无经验的; n. 开始；新生；泛滥; adv. 刚刚，才；最新地
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: n. 摩擦，[力] 摩擦力
example: The friction of the sheets against his skin was torture.
translation: 被单摩擦着他的皮肤，简直像是酷刑。

meaning: n. 星期五
example: I shall be 26 years old on Friday next.
translation: 下周五我就26岁了.

meaning: n. 电冰箱
example: The fridge door was open and food was scattered across the floor.
translation: 冰箱门开着，食物散落在地板上。

meaning: adj. 油炸的，油煎的；喝醉了的; v. 油炸（fry的过去分词）
example: I fried up the beef.
translation: 我把牛肉煎了一下。

meaning: n. 朋友；助手；赞助者
example: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
translation: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

meaning: adj. 友好的；亲切的；支持的；融洽的，和睦的; adv. 友善地；温和地; n. (Friendly)人名；(英)弗兰德利
example: The spokesman said the tone of the letter was very friendly.
translation: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。

meaning: n. 友谊；友爱；友善
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n. 惊吓；惊骇; v. 使惊恐
example: Howard wanted to be a popular singer, but stage fright crippled him.
translation: 霍华德想成为流行歌手，但因怯场而心生畏惧。

meaning: v. 使惊吓；吓唬…
example: Fairground rides are intended to frighten the life out of you.
translation: 露天游乐场的飞车就是想把人吓丢了魂儿。

meaning: n. 青蛙；[铁路] 辙叉；饰扣; v. 捕蛙
example: They arrested the men and frog-marched them to the local police station.
translation: 他们逮捕了这些人，并把他们押送到当地警察局。

meaning: n. 前面；正面；前线; v. 面对；朝向；对付; adj. 前面的；正面的; adv. 在前面；向前
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 前沿；边界；国境; adj. 边界的；开拓的
example: A "frontier-free" Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.
translation: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。

meaning: v. 结霜于；冻坏; n. 霜；冰冻，严寒；冷淡
example: The air was thin and crisp, filled with hazy sunshine and frost.
translation: 空气稀薄清新，其间日光蒙眬，寒气逼人。

meaning: n. 水果；产物; v. 结果实
example: I tend to stick to fresh fruit for pudding.
translation: 我一直坚持用新鲜水果做甜点。

meaning: n. 鱼苗；油炸食物; v. 油炸；油煎
example: Fry remaining peppers, adding a little more dressing if necessary.
translation: 用油炸一下剩下的辣椒，如果需要再加点调味汁。

meaning: v. 得到燃料; n. 燃料；刺激因素
example: His comments are bound to add fuel to the debate.
translation: 他的话必将为争论推波助澜。

meaning: adj. 完全的，完整的；满的，充满的；丰富的；完美的；丰满的；详尽的; adv. 十分，非常；完全地；整整; v. 把衣服缝得宽大; n. 全部；完整
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 乐趣；玩笑；有趣的人或事; adj. 供娱乐用的; vi. 开玩笑
example: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
translation: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

meaning: n. 功能；[数] 函数；职责；盛大的集会; v. 运行；活动；行使职责
example: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the agency's mission.
translation: 要完成该机构的使命，他的作用至关重要。

meaning: adj. 基本的，根本的; n. 基本原理；基本原则
example: Amnesty says there are fundamental flaws in their military justice system.
translation: 国际特赦组织称他们的军事司法体系存在着根本性的缺陷。

meaning: n. 葬礼；麻烦事; adj. 丧葬的，出殡的
example: Most of those attending the funeral stood silently showing little emotion.
translation: 出席葬礼的人大多都面无表情地静静站着。

meaning: adj. 有趣的，好笑的，滑稽的；（口）稀奇的，古怪的，奇异的；有病的，不舒服的；狡猾的，欺骗（性）的，可疑的，不光明; n. 滑稽人物；笑话，有趣的故事；滑稽连环漫画栏；（英）（比赛用）单人双桨小艇
example: There's a reason why women don't read this stuff; it's not funny.
translation: 女人不读这种东西是有原因的，它并不好笑。

meaning: n. 皮，皮子；毛皮；软毛; v. 用毛皮覆盖；使穿毛皮服装
example: We were amused to see how assiduously the animal groomed its fur.
translation: 看着这只动物如此认真地梳理自己的毛，我们被逗乐了。

meaning: adj. 家具，有家具的; v. 供应；装备（furnish的过去分词）
example: be furnished with
translation: 提供，备有

meaning: n. 未来；前途；期货；将来时; adj. 将来的，未来的
example: Students all over the country are facing an uncertain future.
translation: 全国各地学生前途未卜。

meaning: n. 增加；利润；收获; v. 获得；增加；赚到
example: This is a cynical manipulation of the situation for short-term political gain.
translation: 这是为了获取短期政治利益而损人利己地对局势进行操纵。

meaning: n. [气象] 大风，狂风；（突发的）一阵
example: A gale was blowing and the sea was choppy.
translation: 狂风大作，海面上波浪起伏。

meaning: n. 画廊；走廊；旁听席；地道; vt. 在…修建走廊；在…挖地道; vi. 挖地道
example: Laura landed a plum job with a smart art gallery.
translation: 劳拉在一家时尚画廊找到了份美差。

meaning: n. 加仑（容量单位）
example: The price of petrol is coming down by four pence a gallon.
translation: 汽油的价格每加仑降了4便士。

meaning: n. 游戏；比赛; adj. 勇敢的; v. 赌博
example: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
translation: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

meaning: n. 车库；汽车修理厂；飞机库; v. 把……送入车库；把（汽车）开进车库
example: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
translation: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

meaning: n. 垃圾；废物
example: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
translation: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

meaning: n. 花园；菜园; v. 栽培花木
example: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

meaning: n. 园艺；园林工人的工作
example: His only experience of gardening so far proved immensely satisfying.
translation: 到目前为止他唯一的一次园艺经历非常令人满意。

meaning: n. 大蒜；蒜头
example: Boil the chick peas, add garlic and lemon juice.
translation: 把鹰嘴豆放在开水中煮，并加入大蒜和柠檬汁。

meaning: n. 衣服，服装；外表，外观; v. 给…穿衣服
example: She stood up and began to disrobe, folding each garment neatly.
translation: 她站起来开始脱衣服，并把每件衣服叠整齐。

meaning: n. 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油；毒气; v. 加油；毒（死）
example: natural gas
translation: 天然气

meaning: n. 大门；出入口；门道; v. 给…装大门
example: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.
translation: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。

meaning: v. 收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起; n. 聚集；衣褶；收获量
example: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
translation: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

meaning: adj. 快乐的；放荡的；艳丽的; n. 同性恋者
example: Curiously, the word "gay" does not occur in the index.
translation: 奇怪的是，gay这个词没有出现在索引当中。

meaning: adj. 一般的，普通的；综合的；大体的; n. 一般；将军，上将；常规
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: n. 一代；产生；一代人；生殖
example: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.
translation: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。

meaning: adj. 慷慨的，大方的；宽宏大量的；有雅量的
example: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

meaning: adj. 温和的；文雅的; v. 使温和，使驯服; n. 蛆，饵
example: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
translation: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

meaning: n. 先生；绅士；有身份的人
example: A gentleman should always be civil, even to his inferiors.
translation: 绅士应该总是彬彬有礼,即便是对地位不及自己者.

meaning: n. 地理；地形
example: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
translation: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

meaning: n. 几何学
example: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
translation: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

meaning: adj. 德国的；德语的，德国人的; n. 德语；德国人
example: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
translation: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

meaning: n. 德国
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. 姿态；手势; v. 作手势；用动作示意
example: Their handshake appeared to be a gesture of reconciliation.
translation: 他们的握手似乎是和解的表示。

meaning: v. 使得；获得；受到；变成; n. 生殖；幼兽
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 礼物；天赋；赠品; v. 赋予；向…赠送
example: Her grandmother had the gift of making people happy.
translation: 她奶奶有逗人开心的本事。

meaning: adj. 有天赋的；有才华的; v. 给予（gift的过去分词）
example: He was witty, amusing and gifted with a sharp business brain.
translation: 他机智诙谐，具有敏锐的商业头脑。

meaning: n. 长颈鹿
example: The giraffe eats tender leaf from the tree highly.
translation: 长颈鹿从高高的树上吃掉嫩树叶子.

meaning: n. 女孩；姑娘，未婚女子；女职员，女演员；（男人的）女朋友
example: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
translation: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. 给；产生；让步；举办；授予; n. 弹性；弯曲；伸展性
example: "I can't give you an answer now," he hedged.
translation: “我现在不能回答你，”他闪避道。

meaning: adj. 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的; vt. 使高兴; n. (Glad)人名；(塞、瑞典)格拉德；(英)格莱德；(法、挪)格拉
example: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

meaning: n. 一瞥；一滑；闪光; v. 扫视，匆匆一看；反光；瞥闪，瞥见
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: n. 刺眼；耀眼的光；受公众注目; v. 瞪眼表示
example: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
translation: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

meaning: n. 玻璃；玻璃制品；镜子; v. 反映；给某物加玻璃
example: The theatre is a futuristic steel and glass structure.
translation: 这家剧院是钢筋和玻璃结构的未来派建筑。

meaning: n. 温室；暖房
example: It can become extremely hot and dry, specially in a small glasshouse.
translation: 空气会变得特别炎热干燥，特别是在一个小玻璃房里。

meaning: n. 地球；地球仪；球体; vt. 使…成球形; vi. 成球状
example: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
translation: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。

meaning: n. 光荣，荣誉；赞颂; v. 自豪，骄傲；狂喜
example: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.
translation: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。

meaning: n. 手套; vt. 给…戴手套
example: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.
translation: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。

meaning: v. 粘合；似胶般固着于; n. 胶；各种胶合物
example: Stick them on using a small amount of glue.
translation: 用少许胶水把它们贴上。

meaning: v. 走；达到；运转；趋于; n. 去；进行；尝试
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 目标；球门，得分数；终点; vi. 攻门，射门得分
example: They were still arguing the toss about the first goal.
translation: 他们仍在为第一个进球争论不休。

meaning: n. 山羊；替罪羊（美俚）；色鬼（美俚）
example: Sheep's milk is produced in much the same way as goat's milk.
translation: 绵羊奶和山羊奶的生产过程差不多。

meaning: n. 神；（大写首字母时）上帝; vt. 膜拜，崇拜
example: Thank God they're not on my manor any more.
translation: 谢天谢地，他们再也不在我的辖区里了。

meaning: n. 金，黄金；金色；金币; adj. 金的，金制的；金色的
example: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
translation: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

meaning: adj. 金色的，黄金般的；珍贵的；金制的; n. (Golden)人名；(英、法、罗、德、瑞典)戈尔登
example: Imagine long golden beaches where you can wander in solitude.
translation: 想象一下那长长的金色海滩吧，在那里你可以独自徜徉。

meaning: n. 高尔夫球；高尔夫球运动; v. 打高尔夫球
example: Walking and golf increased in popularity during the 1980s.
translation: 在20世纪80年代越来越多的人喜欢上了远足或是打高尔夫球。

meaning: adj. 好的；优良的；愉快的；虔诚的; n. 好处；善行；慷慨的行为; adv. 好
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: int. 天哪; n. 善良，优秀 ；精华，养分
example: She had an unshakeable faith in human goodness and natural honesty.
translation: 她坚信人的本性是善良诚实的。

meaning: n. 商品；动产；合意的人；真本领
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: n. 鹅；鹅肉；傻瓜；雌鹅; v. 突然加大油门；嘘骂
example: He said that what they were up to would cook Krasky's goose.
translation: 他说他们暗中进行的阴谋可能会使克拉斯基的计划流产。

meaning: v. 管理；支配；统治；控制; n. (Govern)人名；(英)戈文
example: The republics began asserting their right to govern themselves.
translation: 各加盟共和国开始要求获得自治权。

meaning: n. 政府；政体；管辖
example: He admitted that the government was in "a dreadful hole".
translation: 他承认政府目前“处境极为尴尬”。

meaning: n. 长袍，长外衣；礼服；睡袍；法衣; v. 使穿睡衣
example: She crept from the bed and fumbled for her dressing gown.
translation: 她从床上蹑手蹑脚地爬起来，摸索着自己的晨衣。

meaning: n. 年级；等级；成绩；级别；阶段; v. 评分；把…分等级
example: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: adv. 逐步地；渐渐地
example: I gradually got rather disillusioned with the whole setup of the university.
translation: 渐渐地，我对大学的整个体制感到相当失望。

meaning: v. 授予…学位；分等级；标上刻度; n. 研究生；毕业生; adj. 毕业的；研究生的
example: My first job was as a graduate trainee with a bank.
translation: 我的第一份工作是在一家银行做大学毕业实习生。

meaning: n. 毕业；毕业典礼；刻度，分度；分等级
example: "You must come to Tinsley's graduation party." — "I'd be delighted."
translation: “你一定要来参加廷斯利的毕业聚会。”——“我很乐意。”

meaning: n. 粮食；颗粒；[作物] 谷物；纹理; v. 成谷粒
example: The firemen unwrapped their hoses and began dousing the scorched grain silos.
translation: 消防员展开水龙带，开始冲着烧焦的谷仓喷水。

meaning: n. 克；鹰嘴豆（用作饲料）
example: A few twentieths of a gram can be critical.
translation: 即使重量仅有1克的二十分之几都可能是关键性的。

meaning: n. 语法；语法书
example: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: adj. 宏伟的；豪华的；极重要的; n. 大钢琴；一千美元
example: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

meaning: n. 孙子；孙女；外孙；外孙女
example: All the family attended the baptism of the first grandchild.
translation: 家庭所有成员都参加了第一个孙子的洗礼仪式.

meaning: n. 孙女；外孙女
example: Her granddaughter lives abroad.
translation: 她的孙女住在国外.

meaning: n. 奶奶；外婆
example: Unfortunately, Grandma always seems to awaken at awkward moments.
translation: 不幸的是，奶奶好像总是醒来的不是时候。

meaning: n. 爷爷；外公
example: Grandpa lies comatose on the sofa.
translation: 爷爷躺在沙发上，睡得很沉。

meaning: n. 祖父母（grandparent的复数）；外祖父母
n. 孙子；外孙
example: I hadn't been far wrong in my estimate of his grandson's capabilities.
translation: 我对他孙子的能力的判断还不算太离谱。

meaning: n. 奶奶；外婆；婆婆妈妈的人
example: Granny travelled down by train.
translation: 奶奶是乘火车过来的。

meaning: n. 葡萄；葡萄酒；葡萄树；葡萄色
example: He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.
translation: 他把一粒葡萄放入嘴里,整个吞了下去.

meaning: n. 图表；曲线图; v. 用曲线图表示
example: We plot about eight points on the graph.
translation: 我们在图表上绘制出大约8个点的曲线。

meaning: n. 抓住；理解；控制; v. 抓住；领会
example: He let the ball slip through his grasp and into the net.
translation: 球从他的掌中滑出，钻进了球门。

meaning: n. 草；草地，草坪; v. 放牧；使……长满草；使……吃草
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: adj. 感谢的；令人愉快的，宜人的
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: n. 重力，地心引力；严重性；庄严
example: Anything with strong gravity attracts other things to it.
translation: 任何有较强重力的物体都会对其他物体产生引力。

meaning: adj. 伟大的，重大的；极好的，好的；主要的; n. 大师；大人物；伟人们
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: n. 希腊（欧洲南部国家）
example: They believed ancient Greece and Rome were vital sources of learning.
translation: 他们认为古代希腊罗马是知识的重要发源地。

meaning: adj. 贪婪的；贪吃的；渴望的
example: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.
translation: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。

meaning: n. 希腊语；希腊人; adj. 希腊的；希腊人的，希腊语的
example: Latin and Greek will be squeezed out of school timetables.
translation: 拉丁语和希腊语将退出学校的课程表。

meaning: adj. 绿色的；青春的; n. 绿色；青春; v. 使…变绿色
example: Revenues from "green taxes" could then be channelled back into energy efficiency.
translation: 从“绿色税收”得来的收入便可回过头来用于提高能效。

meaning: n. 蔬菜水果商；菜贩
example: I was at the greengrocer's.
translation: 我在蔬菜水果店里.

meaning: v. 欢迎，迎接；致敬，致意；映入眼帘; n. (Greet)人名；(英)格里特
example: He looked at Livy and Mark, who had risen to greet him.
translation: 他看着站起来跟他打招呼的莉薇和马克。

meaning: n. 问候，招呼；祝贺; v. 致敬，欢迎（greet的现在分词）
example: He took her hand in greeting and asked solicitously how everything was.
translation: 他握着她的手表示问候，关切地问她一切是否都好。

meaning: adj. 灰色的；灰白的; v. 使变成灰色；使变老; n. 灰色
example: I undid the bottom two buttons of my yellow and grey shirt.
translation: 我解开了自己黄灰相间的衬衫上最下面的两个纽扣。

meaning: v. 烧，烤；; n. 烤架，铁格子；烤肉
example: Place the omelette under a gentle grill until the top is set.
translation: 将煎蛋饼放在烤架下用文火烘烤，直到表面凝固。

meaning: n. 杂货店；食品商
example: Go down to the grocer's and get some sugar.
translation: 去杂货店给我买点糖来.

meaning: n. 地面；土地；范围；战场;根据; v. 使接触地面；打基础；使搁浅; adj. 土地的；地面上的；磨碎的；磨过的
example: They found a labyrinth of tunnels under the ground.
translation: 他们发现了一处迷宫似的地道。

meaning: n. 组；团体; adj. 群的；团体的; v. 聚合
example: I thought I'd enrol you with an art group at the school.
translation: 我想我会吸收你参加学校的一个艺术团。

meaning: v. 发展；生长；渐渐变得…; n. (Grow)人名；(英)格罗
example: The mother provides the embryo with nourishment and a place to grow.
translation: 母亲为胎儿提供营养和成长的空间。

meaning: n. 增长；发展；生长；种植
example: Last year, economic growth tailed off to below four percent.
translation: 去年，经济增长率下降到4%以下。

meaning: vt. 使极度疲劳；累垮; n. 稀粥
example: We had gruel for the breakfast.
translation: 我们早餐吃的是麦片粥.

meaning: n. 守卫；警戒；护卫队；防护装置; v. 警惕
example: He rang for the guard to let him out.
translation: 他按铃叫保安放他出去。

meaning: v. 猜测；认为；推测；猜中; n. 猜测；推测
example: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight.
translation: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。

meaning: n. 客人，宾客；顾客; v. 款待，招待; adj. 客人的；特邀的，客座的
example: The duke was surprised by his wife's omission from the guest list.
translation: 公爵对他的夫人未在获邀宾客之列感到意外。

meaning: n. 指导，引导；领导
example: I went down on my knees and prayed for guidance.
translation: 我跪了下来，祈求得到指引。

meaning: n. 指南；向导；入门书; v. 引导；带领；操纵
example: This is it, folks: the best record guide in the business.
translation: 就是这个，伙计们，业内最好的唱片指南。

meaning: adj. 有罪的；内疚的
example: Striker Alan Smith was guilty of two glaring misses.
translation: 前锋艾伦·史密斯两次严重失误，将球射偏。

meaning: n. 枪支；枪状物；持枪歹徒; v. 用枪射击；加大油门快速前进
example: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
translation: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

meaning: abbr. 灰色（gray）；圭亚那（Guyana）; n. 戈瑞
n. 体操；体育；体操运动
example: Olga Korbut single-handedly turned gymnastics into a major event.
translation: 奥尔佳·科布特独自一人将体操变成了一项重要赛事。

meaning: int. 哈！（表示惊异，愉快，怀疑，胜利等）; abbr. 一种元素(hahnium,原子序105); n. (Ha)人名；(德)哈；(日)巴 (姓)
example: "Ha, ha," everyone guffawed. "It's one of Viv's shock tactics."
translation: “哈哈，”所有人都大笑起来，“这是维夫的一招出奇制胜的战术。”

meaning: n. 习惯，习性；嗜好; v. 使穿衣
example: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
translation: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

meaning: n. 头发；毛发；些微; vt. 除去…的毛发; vi. 生长毛发；形成毛状纤维; adj. 毛发的；护理毛发的；用毛发制成的
example: She walked forward and embraced him and stroked his tousled white hair.
translation: 她走上前拥抱他并轻抚他凌乱的白发。

meaning: n. 理发；发型
example: Now politics is all about the right haircut and a sharp suit.
translation: 现在政界讲究的无非是合适的发型和时髦的衣着。

meaning: n. 一半；半场；半学年; adv. 一半地；部分地; adj. 一半的；不完全的；半途的
example: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
translation: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

meaning: n. 过道，门厅，走廊；会堂；食堂；学生宿舍；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所
example: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

meaning: n. 火腿；业余无线电爱好者；蹩脚演员; v. 表演过火; adj. 过火的；做作的
example: Vacuum-packed ham slices should be unwrapped 30 minutes before serving.
translation: 真空包装的火腿片应在食用前30分钟把包装除去。

meaning: n. 汉堡包，火腿汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉
example: Avoid unhealthy foods such as hamburger and chips.
translation: 不要吃不健康食品，如汉堡和薯条。

meaning: v. 锤击；敲打；重复; n. 铁锤；链球；[解剖] 锤骨；音锤
example: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole.
translation: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。

meaning: n. 手，手艺；帮助；指针；插手; v. 传递，交给；支持；搀扶
example: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral.
translation: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。

meaning: n. 手提包
example: A crumpled scrap of paper was found in her handbag.
translation: 在她的手提包里发现了一张皱巴巴的小纸片。

meaning: n. 少数；一把；棘手事
example: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

meaning: n. 手帕；头巾，围巾
example: She balled the handkerchief up and threw it at his feet.
translation: 她把手绢揉成一团，丢在了他的脚边。

meaning: n. [建] 把手；柄；手感；口实; v. 处理；操作；运用；买卖；触摸
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: adj. （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的
example: The opposition won a handsome victory in the election.
translation: 反对党在竞选中以高票获胜。

meaning: 手推车
example: He crashed the handtruck through the doors.
translation: 他推着手推车乒乒乓乓地过了几道门.

meaning: n. 笔迹；书法；书写；手稿; v. 亲手写（handwrite的ing形式）
example: I have to admit that I have bad handwriting.
translation: 我不得不承认自己的字写得不好看。

meaning: adj. 便利的；手边的，就近的；容易取得的；敏捷的; n. (Handy)人名；(英)汉迪
example: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
translation: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

meaning: v. 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决; n. 悬挂；暂停，中止
example: The King has merely given the politicians enough rope to hang themselves.
translation: 国王只不过是给了这些政客自缚的绳子。

meaning: v. 发生；碰巧；偶然遇到
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: adv. 快乐地；幸福地；幸运地；恰当地
example: He's very forward and confident and chats happily to other people.
translation: 他很自以为是，喜欢和别人攀谈。

meaning: n. 幸福
example: for your happiness
translation: 祝你幸福；为你的幸福

meaning: adj. 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的; n. (Happy)人名；(英、瑞典、喀)哈皮
example: She has now changed into a happy, self-confident woman.
translation: 如今她已经变成一个快乐、自信的女人。

meaning: v. 藏匿；入港停泊；庇护; n. 海港（等于harbor）；避难所
example: Sewage nutrients do increase algal growth in the harbour.
translation: 污水中的营养物确实会加快港口的海藻生长。

meaning: adj. 努力的；硬的；困难的；辛苦的；确实的；严厉的；猛烈的；冷酷无情的; adv. 努力地；困难地；辛苦地；接近地；猛烈地；牢固地; n. (Hard)人名；(英、芬、瑞典)哈德
example: Talent, hard work and sheer tenacity are all crucial to career success.
translation: 事业要成功，才能、勤奋和顽强的意志都至关重要。

meaning: adv. 几乎不，简直不；刚刚
example: The ward was busy and Amy hardly had time to talk.
translation: 病房里非常忙碌，埃米几乎没有时间说话。

meaning: n. 困苦；苦难；艰难险阻
example: Many people are suffering economic hardship.
translation: 很多人正处于经济困难之中。

meaning: adj. 努力工作的；不辞辛劳的，苦干的; v. 努力工作（hardwork的ing形式）
example: He was hardworking and energetic.
translation: 他工作努力，精力充沛。

meaning: n. 伤害；损害; v. 伤害；危害；损害
example: Nudism, the council decided, was doing the resort more harm than good.
translation: 委员会认定在休闲胜地的裸体行为弊大于利。

meaning: adj. 有害的；能造成损害的
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: adj. 无害的；无恶意的
example: Industry has been working at developing harmless substitutes for these gases.
translation: 该行业一直在努力开发一些可以替代这些气体的无害物质。

meaning: n. 协调；和睦；融洽；调和
example: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again.
translation: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

meaning: n. 收获；产量；结果; v. 收割；得到
example: Comet also sired the champion foal out of Spinway Harvest.
translation: “彗星”还跟“斯平威·哈维斯特”生下了这匹出类拔萃的小马驹。

meaning: n. 帽子; v. 给……戴上帽子
example: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
translation: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

meaning: n. 孵化；舱口; v. 孵；策划
example: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
translation: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

meaning: v. 憎恨；厌恶；遗憾; n. 憎恨；反感
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: v. 有；让；拿；从事；允许; aux. 已经; n. (Have)人名；(芬)哈韦；(德)哈弗
example: You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest. And if you do, if you stay positive, then you have a shot at a silver lining.
translation: 你需要尽你所能，最大限度地去努力。只要你这么做，只要你能保持乐观，你就会看见乌云背后的幸福线。

meaning: v. 兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出; n. 鹰；鹰派成员；掠夺他人的人
example: The hawk swooped and soared away carrying something.
translation: 那只鹰向下猛冲，抓住东西后又展翅高飞了。

meaning: n. 干草; v. 把晒干
example: make hay
translation: 利用机会去赚钱

meaning: n. 男孩，男人；它（雄性动物）; pron. 他
example: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
translation: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

meaning: n. 头；头痛；上端；最前的部分；理解力; v. 前进；用头顶；作为…的首领；站在…的前头；给…加标题; adj. 头的；主要的；在顶端的
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: n. 头痛；麻烦；令人头痛之事
example: Symptoms are a slight fever, headache and loss of appetite.
translation: 症状包括低烧、头痛和食欲不振。

meaning: n. 大标题；内容提要；栏外标题；头版头条新闻; v. 给…加标题；使成为注意中心；大力宣传
example: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
translation: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

meaning: n. 校长
example: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
translation: 他是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

meaning: n. 女校长
example: The headmistress was an Oxford woman.
translation: 女校长毕业于牛津大学。

meaning: n. 中小学的校长
example: Just as the teacher plays the role of leader in the classroom, so does the headteacher play a leadership role in the school.
translation: 在课堂上老师扮演着领导者的角色，同样，在学校里校长也充当着领导者的角色。

meaning: n. 健康；卫生；保健；兴旺
example: His wife Cheryl said she had no worries about his health.
translation: 他的妻子谢里尔说她并不担心他的健康。

meaning: adj. 健康的，健全的；有益于健康的
example: The birth of a live healthy baby is a truly blessed event.
translation: 一个健康活泼的婴儿的出生真是一件可喜的事情。

meaning: n. 堆；许多；累积; v. 堆；堆积
example: Clothes were thrown in the luggage in an untidy heap.
translation: 衣服被乱糟糟地扔进旅行箱里。

meaning: v. 听到，听；听说；审理
example: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

meaning: n. 听力；审讯，听讯; v. 听见（hear的ing形式）
example: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
translation: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

meaning: n. 心脏；感情；勇气；心形；要点; vt. 鼓励；铭记; vi. 结心
example: Bob died of a heart attack, brought on by his lifestyle.
translation: 鲍勃死于由他的生活方式引起的心脏病突发。

meaning: n. 高温；压力；热度；热烈; v. 使激动；把…加热
example: heat transfer
translation: 热传递，传热

meaning: n. 天堂；天空；极乐
example: They would move heaven and earth to stop me if they could.
translation: 可能的话，他们会千方百计地阻止我。

meaning: adv. 沉重地；猛烈地；沉闷地
example: Nuclear weapons plants across the country are heavily contaminated with toxic wastes.
translation: 全国的核武器工厂均受到了有毒废弃物的严重污染。

meaning: adj. 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的; n. 重物；严肃角色; adv. 大量地；笨重地
example: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
translation: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

meaning: n. 脚后跟；踵; v. 倾侧
example: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
translation: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

meaning: n. 高地；高度；身高；顶点
example: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.
translation: 突然上升的高度让她晕头转向，她抓得紧紧的。

meaning: n. [航] 直升飞机; vi. [航] 乘直升飞机; vt. 由直升机运送
example: A helicopter crashed in a fiery explosion in Vallejo.
translation: 一架直升机在瓦列霍爆炸起火并坠毁。

meaning: int. 喂；哈罗; n. 表示问候， 惊奇或唤起注意时的用语
example: I answered the phone and this voice went, "Hello? Is that Alison?"
translation: 我拿起电话，就听到这个声音：“喂？是艾利森吗？”

meaning: n. 钢盔，头盔
example: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike.
translation: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

meaning: v. 帮助；促进；治疗；补救; n. 帮助；补救办法；帮忙者；有益的东西
example: Ellery's return will help to chase away some of the gloom.
translation: 埃勒里的归来可以驱散一些抑郁的情绪。

meaning: adj. 有帮助的；有益的
example: Having the right equipment at hand will be enormously helpful.
translation: 手头上有合适的设备将会帮上大忙。

meaning: n. 母鸡；女人；雌禽
example: The pheasant is a close relative of the Guinea hen.
translation: 雉与珍珠鸡有很近的亲缘关系。

meaning: pron. 她（she的宾格）；她的（she的所有格）；她（指某个国家；一艘船）; n. （法）埃尔（人名）
example: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career.
translation: 卡琳设法达到了其职业的要求。

meaning: n. 香草，药草
example: The herb has been used for centuries to curdle milk.
translation: 那种香草几个世纪以来都被用来制作酸乳。

meaning: adv. 在这里；此时; int. 嘿！；喂！; n. 这里
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: n. 英雄；男主角，男主人公
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: n. 女主角；女英雄；女杰出人物
example: The film concludes with the heroine's death.
translation: 影片以女主角之死结束.

meaning: pron. 她的（所有格）; n. (Hers)人名；(法)埃尔
example: Hers was a minor part, but she played it with gusto.
translation: 她演的是个小角色，但是演得很投入。

meaning: pron. 她自己（she的反身代词）；她亲自
example: She dusted herself down and left to build her own career.
translation: 她重振旗鼓去开创自己的事业了。

meaning: int. 喂！（引起注意等）；你好！（表示问候）; n. 干草（等于hay）
example: "Hey, I don't know what you're talking about," Russo objected.
translation: “喂，我不知道你在说些什么，”拉索反驳道。

meaning: int. 嗨！（表示问候或用以唤起注意）; n. (Hi)人名；(柬)希
example: All this equipment has received international acclaim from the specialist hi-fi press.
translation: 这套设备受到全球高保真音响专业报刊的赞誉。

meaning: v. 过冬；（动物）冬眠；（人等）避寒
example: Bears often hibernate in caves.
translation: 熊常在山洞里冬眠.

meaning: n. 冬眠；过冬；避寒
example: Bears wake up in the spring after a winter of hibernation.
translation: 熊经过一个冬天的冬眠后在春季苏醒.

meaning: v. 隐藏；隐瞒；鞭打; n. 躲藏；兽皮；躲藏处
example: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

meaning: adj. 高的；高级的；崇高的；高音调的; n. 高水平；天空；由麻醉品引起的快感；高压地带; adv. 高；奢侈地
example: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions.
translation: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

meaning: n. 公路，大路；捷径
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: n. 小山；丘陵；斜坡；山冈
example: A girl in a red smock tripped down the hill.
translation: 一个身穿红色罩衫的女孩迈着轻快的步子下山。

meaning: n. 山坡，山腹；山腰
example: A gust of breeze moved down the hillside, ruffling the grass.
translation: 一阵微风吹下山坡，使青草如波浪起伏。

meaning: adj. 丘陵的；陡的；多小山的；多坡的; n. (Hilly)人名；(阿拉伯)希利
example: In 1978, the farm's hilly orchards increased by 300 mu.
translation: 1978年, 这个农场新增山地果园300亩.

meaning: pron. 他（宾格）; n. (Him)人名；(东南亚国家华语)欣；(柬)亨；(中)谦(广东话·威妥玛)
example: She studied him for the longest time, looking wryly amused.
translation: 她面带苦笑，盯着他看了很长时间。

meaning: pron. 他自己；他亲自，他本人
example: He sees himself going right to the top of the tree.
translation: 他预见自己在同行中将无人可及。

meaning: n. 雇用，租用；租金，工钱; v. 雇用；出租
example: Child car seats only cost about £10 a week to hire.
translation: 儿童汽车坐椅一周的租金才10英镑。

meaning: pron. 他的; n. (His)人名；(法)伊斯
example: His hands were too weak to cock his revolver.
translation: 他的手没劲儿，扳不动左轮手枪的扳机。

meaning: n. 历史，历史学；历史记录；来历
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: v. 打击；袭击；碰撞；偶然发现；伤…的感情; n. 打；打击；（演出等）成功；讽刺
example: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: v. 群居；入蜂房；生活在蜂房中; n. 蜂房，蜂巢；热闹的场所；熙攘喧闹的人群
example: A dark cloud of bees comes swarming out of the hive.
translation: 黑压压的一大群蜜蜂从蜂巢中飞出来。

meaning: n. 嗜好；业余爱好
example: It is only a hobby, not a life or death struggle.
translation: 这只是一项爱好，不需要拼死拼活地努力。

meaning: v. 持有；拥有；保存；拘留；约束或控制; n. 控制；保留
example: He struggled to hold the bike down on the banked corners.
translation: 拐过斜弯时他竭力将自行车把稳。

meaning: n. 洞，孔；洞穴，穴；突破口; v. 凿洞，穿孔；（高尔夫球等）进洞
example: He admitted that the government was in "a dreadful hole".
translation: 他承认政府目前“处境极为尴尬”。

meaning: n. 假日；节日；休息日; v. 外出度假
example: People are having to think hard about their holiday plans.
translation: 人们现在得仔细地琢磨自己的度假计划。

meaning: adj. 圣洁的，神圣的；至善的; n. 神圣的东西
example: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
translation: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

meaning: n. 家，住宅；产地；家乡；避难所; adv. 在家，回家；深入地; adj. 国内的，家庭的；有效的; v. 归巢，回家
example: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
translation: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

meaning: n. 祖国；故乡
example: The exiles had been cut off from all contact with their homeland.
translation: 流亡者被切断了与家乡的所有联系。

meaning: n. 家乡；故乡
example: The houses in my hometown were chiefly composed of wood.
translation: 我家乡的房子过去多由木料制成.

meaning: n. 家庭作业，课外作业
example: Tom admits that playing video games sometimes distracts him from his homework.
translation: 汤姆承认玩电子游戏有时会使他无心做作业。

meaning: adj. 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的
example: To be honest the house is not quite our style.
translation: 说实话，这所房子不太适合我们。

meaning: n. 蜂蜜；宝贝；甜蜜; adj. 甘美的；蜂蜜似的; v. 对…说甜言蜜语；加蜜使甜
example: Add more honey if you have a sweet tooth.
translation: 如果你喜欢吃甜的就多加点蜂蜜。

meaning: n. 荣誉；尊敬；勋章; v. 尊敬；[金融] 承兑；承兑远期票据
example: I impressed on him what a huge honour he was being offered.
translation: 我让他铭记他当时被授予了多么大的荣誉。

meaning: n. 挂钩，吊钩; v. 钩住；引上钩
example: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.
translation: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。

meaning: vi. 呼万岁; vt. 呼万岁; n. 万岁; int. 万岁
example: Three cheers for the winner — hip, hip, hooray!
translation: 为胜利者欢呼三声——嗨, 嗨, 万岁!

meaning: n. 希望；期望；信心; v. 希望；期望
example: The arteries are diseased and a transplant is the only hope.
translation: 动脉已经发生病变，移植是唯一的希望。

meaning: adj. 有希望的；有前途的; n. 有希望成功的人
example: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion.
translation: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。

meaning: adj. 可怕的；极讨厌的
example: They made sure that he died a horrible death.
translation: 他们让他死得很惨。

meaning: n. 马；骑兵；脚架；海洛因; v. 使骑马；系马于；捉弄
example: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

meaning: n. 医院
example: You are welcome to visit the hospital at any time.
translation: 你可以随时来医院。

meaning: n. [计] 主机；主人；主持人；许多; v. 主持；当主人招待
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: n. 女主人，女老板；女服务员；舞女；女房东
example: An air hostess was arrested and charged with drug smuggling.
translation: 一名空姐被捕，并被控以走私毒品的罪名。

meaning: adj. 热的；辣的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的; adv. 热；紧迫地; v. 变热; n. (Hot)人名；(塞)霍特；(法)奥特
example: Wash your hands thoroughly with hot soapy water before handling any food.
translation: 在拿吃的之前，用热肥皂水把手好好地洗干净。

meaning: n. 旅馆，饭店；客栈; vt. 使…在饭店下榻; vi. 进行旅馆式办公
example: The hotel is set plumb in the middle of the high street.
translation: 宾馆正好坐落在商街的中段。

meaning: n. 小时；钟头；课时；…点钟
example: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
translation: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

meaning: n. 住宅；家庭；机构；议会；某种用途的建筑物; v. 覆盖；给…房子住；把…储藏在房内
example: The house seemed muted, hushed as if it had been deserted.
translation: 房子里似乎悄然无声，安静得好像已经没人在住一样。

meaning: n. 家庭主妇
example: She seemed less like a poetess than a distracted housewife.
translation: 她似乎不像个女诗人，更像一个心烦意乱的家庭主妇。

meaning: n. 家务事
example: I discovered an addiction to housework which I had never felt before.
translation: 我发现自己迷上了做家务，之前我从没有这种感觉。

meaning: adv. 如何；多少；多么; n. 方法；方式; conj. 如何
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样（接副词或形容词）；然而；可是; conj. 无论以何种方式; 不管怎样
example: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

meaning: v. 咆哮；怒吼；狂吠; n. 嗥叫；怒号；嚎哭
example: Traditionalists may howl, but in today's world, cultural relativism rules.
translation: 传统卫道士们也许会叫嚣反对，但在当今世界，文化相对论确实是占据着统治地位。

meaning: v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有，坚持; n. 拥抱；紧抱；固执
example: bear hug
translation: 粗鲁或紧紧得拥抱；[摔跤]熊抱；[金融]接管策略

meaning: adj. 巨大的；庞大的；无限的; n. (Huge)人名；(英)休奇
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: adj. 人的；人类的; n. 人；人类
example: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

meaning: adj. 诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的
example: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
translation: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

meaning: n. 幽默（等于humor）；诙谐; v. 迁就；使满足
example: There is a wry sense of humour in his work.
translation: 他的作品带有一种讽刺意味的幽默。

meaning: n. 一百；许多; adj. 一百的；许多的; num. 百；百个
example: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

meaning: n. 饿，饥饿；渴望; v. 渴望；挨饿
example: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.
translation: 他们把搞到手的肉拿来充饥。

meaning: adj. 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的
example: Come on now. You know you must be hungry.
translation: 好，来吧，你肯定已经饿了。

meaning: v. 打猎；搜索; n. 狩猎；搜寻
example: The couple had helped in the hunt for the toddlers.
translation: 这对夫妇曾帮着搜寻那些幼童。

meaning: n. 猎人；猎犬；搜寻者
example: The governors were joined by Mr Hunter and his management team.
translation: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

meaning: abbr. 飓风（hurricane）
n. 飓风，暴风
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: n. 匆忙，急忙; v. 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理
example: Dave was in a hurry to get back to work.
translation: 戴夫急于回到工作岗位。

meaning: v. 节约地使用（或管理）; n. 丈夫
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: n. [化学] 氢
example: Hydrogen is used extensively in industry for the production of ammonia.
translation: 氢气在工业上广泛用于制氨。

meaning: pron. 我; n. 碘元素；英语字母I
example: For more information concerning the club contact I. Coldwell.
translation: 咨询俱乐部详情，请与I.科德维尔联系。

meaning: n. 冰；冰淇淋；矜持；（俚）钻石; v. 冰镇；结冰; adj. 冰的
example: His mother's voice was one he knew; ice cold and deadly.
translation: 母亲的声音是他很熟悉的：冰冷、无情。

meaning: n. 冰岛（欧洲岛名，在大西洋北部，近北极圈）
example: Pack ice around Iceland was becoming a threat to navigation.
translation: 冰岛周围的浮冰群曾一度对船只航行构成威胁。

meaning: n. 想法；主意；概念
example: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
translation: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

meaning: n. 鉴定，识别；认同；身份证明
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: n. 身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式
example: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
translation: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

meaning: n. 成语，习语；土话
example: It was an old building in the local idiom.
translation: 这是一座具有当地特色的古建筑.

meaning: conj. （表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如; n. 条件；设想
example: If you wait, all that happens is that you get older.
translation: 如果你等待，发生的只有变老。

meaning: v. 驳回诉讼；忽视；不理睬
example: The movie industry had chosen to ignore the encroaching competition of television.
translation: 电影业故意无视电视业的侵犯性竞争。

meaning: adj. 生病的；坏的；邪恶的；不吉利的; adv. 不利地；恶劣地；几乎不; n. 疾病；不幸
example: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

meaning: adj. [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的; n. 非法移民，非法劳工
example: By-laws are to make it illegal to smoke in public.
translation: 地方法规将规定在公共场合抽烟为非法。

meaning: n. 病；疾病
example: Attitudes to mental illness have shifted in recent years.
translation: 最近几年对精神病的态度已有所改变。

meaning: v. 想像；猜想；臆断
example: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

meaning: adj. 立即的；直接的；最接近的
example: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

meaning: adv. 立即，立刻；直接地; conj. 一…就
example: Many areas in the country'sinterior are unable to report Aids cases immediately.
translation: 该国内地的很多地区无法即时报告艾滋病病例。

meaning: n. 外来移民；移居
example: He spent 25 years campaigning against racist and unjust immigration laws.
translation: 他用了25年的时间与带有种族歧视色彩和没有公正可言的移民法作斗争。

meaning: n. 进口，进口货；输入；意思，含义；重要性; v. 输入，进口；含…的意思
example: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent.
translation: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。

meaning: n. 价值；重要；重大；傲慢
example: My great-grandfather was a person of some importance here.
translation: 我曾祖父曾是这儿的头面人物。

meaning: adj. 重要的，重大的；有地位的；有权力的
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: adj. 不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的; n. 不可能；不可能的事
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: v. 盖印；强征；传送；给予某人深刻印象; n. 印象，印记；特征，痕迹
example: A style consultant will demonstrate how to dress to impress.
translation: 时尚顾问将示范如何穿着以给人留下深刻印象。

meaning: n. 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想；曝光（衡量广告被显示的次数。打开一个带有该广告的网页，则该广告的impression 次数增加一次）
example: My visit to India in 1986 left an indelible impression on me.
translation: 1986年的印度之行给我留下了难忘的印象。

meaning: v. 改善，增进；提高…的价值
example: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
translation: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

meaning: prep. 按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内; adv. 进入；当选；（服装等）时髦；在屋里; adj. 在里面的；时髦的; n. 执政者；门路；知情者
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n. 英寸；身高；少许; v. 使缓慢地移动
example: We are prepared to fight for every inch of territory.
translation: 我们时刻准备着为每一寸领土而战。

meaning: n. 事件，事变；插曲; adj. [光] 入射的；附带的；易发生的，伴随而来的
example: A member of the security forces was killed in a sniping incident.
translation: 有一名安全部队成员在一场狙击战中被打死。

meaning: v. 包含，包括
example: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
translation: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

meaning: n. 收入，收益；所得
example: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up.
translation: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

meaning: adj. 错误的，不正确的；不适当的；不真实的
example: Receding gums can be the result of disease or simply incorrect brushing.
translation: 牙龈萎缩可能是疾病导致的，也可能仅仅是错误的刷牙方式引起的。

meaning: n. 增加，增长；提高; v. 增加，增大；繁殖
example: He introduced radio to the school to increase the children's awareness.
translation: 他在学校开通广播，以提高孩子们的警觉性。

meaning: adv. 的确；实在；真正地；甚至; int. 真的（表示惊讶、怀疑、讽刺等）
n. 独立性，自立性；自主
example: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
translation: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

meaning: adj. 独立的；单独的；无党派的；不受约束的; n. 独立自主者；无党派者
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: n. 印度（南亚国家）
example: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

meaning: adj. 印度的；印第安人的；印第安语的; n. 印度人；印第安人；印第安语
example: Sri Lankans share a common ancestry with their Indian brethren.
translation: 斯里兰卡人和他们的印度兄弟有共同的祖先。

meaning: v. 表明；指出；预示；象征
example: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
translation: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

meaning: n. 产业；工业；勤勉
example: We are becoming one of the market leaders in the fashion industry.
translation: 我们正在成为时装业的领军者之一。

meaning: n. 影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事; v. 影响；改变
example: I fell under the influence of a history master.
translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

meaning: v. 通知；告诉；报告
example: Teachers inform me that Tracey's behaviour has improved no end.
translation: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

meaning: n. 信息，资料；知识；情报；通知
example: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

meaning: adj. 最初的；字首的; v. 用姓名的首字母签名; n. 词首大写字母
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: v. 伤害，损害
example: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
translation: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

meaning: v. 签署；涂墨水于; n. 墨水，墨汁；油墨
example: printing ink
translation: 印刷用油墨

meaning: n. 内地；内陆; adj. 内陆的；内地的；国内的; adv. 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: n. 客栈；旅馆; vi. 住旅馆
example: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
translation: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总有种宾至如归的感觉。

meaning: adj. 无辜的；无罪的；无知的; n. 天真的人；笨蛋
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n. 昆虫；卑鄙的人
example: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
translation: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

meaning: v. 插入；嵌入; n. 插入物；管芯；镶块；[机械]刀片
example: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
translation: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

meaning: n. 里面；内部；内情；内脏; adj. 里面的；内部的；秘密的; adv. 在里面; prep. 少于；在…之内
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: v. 坚持，强调
example: They insist on tastier chocolate than the anaemic British stuff.
translation: 他们坚持要比淡而无味的英国货味道更好的巧克力。

meaning: v. 检查；视察；检阅
example: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
translation: 他们有权进来查表。

meaning: v. 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: adj. 立即的；紧急的；紧迫的; n. 瞬间；立即；片刻
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: adv. 代替；反而；相反
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: v. 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）; n. 学会，协会；学院
example: The Institute of Export now fears that 100,000 jobs will go.
translation: 现在出口协会担心将失去10万个工作机会。

meaning: n. 制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗
example: Congress as an institution scores low in public opinion polls.
translation: 作为一个公共机构，国会在公众民意调查中得分很低。

meaning: v. 指导；通知；命令；教授
example: We should instruct the passengers what customs regulations are.
translation: 我们应该向乘客说明海关规则是什么.

meaning: n. 指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明
example: This technique brings life to instruction and eases assimilation of knowledge.
translation: 这一方法给教学带来了活力，也使知识的吸收变得容易了。

meaning: n. 仪器；工具；乐器；手段；器械
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: n. 保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金
example: Police investigating a £10 million car insurance fiddle arrested 16 people yesterday.
translation: 调查涉及1,000万英镑的汽车保险诈骗案的警察昨天逮捕了16人。

meaning: v. 确保，保证；给…保险
example: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
translation: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

meaning: n. 智力；情报工作；情报机关；理解力；才智，智慧；天分
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: n. 意图；目的；意向；愈合
example: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
translation: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

meaning: n. 兴趣，爱好；利息；趣味；同行; v. 使……感兴趣；引起……的关心；使……参与
example: We have the interest of 500,000 customers to think of.
translation: 我们得为50万名顾客的利益着想。

meaning: adj. 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: n. 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票; adj. 国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的
example: International investors have become jittery about the country's economy.
translation: 国际投资者已对该国的经济状况感到紧张不安。

meaning: n. 因特网
example: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
translation: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

meaning: n. 解释者；口译者；注释器
example: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.
translation: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。

meaning: v. 中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍; n. 中断
example: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
translation: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

meaning: n. 间隔；间距；幕间休息
example: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

meaning: n. 接见，采访；面试，面谈; v. 采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: prep. 到…里；深入…之中；成为…状况；进入到…之内; n. (Into)人名；(芬、英)因托
example: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
translation: 我尽量言简意赅。

meaning: v. 介绍；引进；提出；采用
example: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

meaning: n. 介绍；引进；采用；入门；传入
example: Millions of words have been written about the introduction of the euro.
translation: 有关采用欧元的文章已经有很多。

meaning: v. 发明；创造；虚构
example: His father had helped invent a whole new way of doing business.
translation: 他父亲帮助创造了一套全新的生意经。

meaning: n. 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能
example: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.
translation: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。

meaning: n. 发明家；[专利] 发明人；创造者
example: The royalties enabled the inventor to re-establish himself in business.
translation: 专利使用费让这位发明家得以再次立足于商界。

meaning: n. 邀请；引诱；请帖；邀请函
example: "I can't pass this up." She waved the invitation.
translation: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。

meaning: v. 邀请，招待；招致; n. 邀请
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: n. 爱尔兰
example: That programme will include live commentary on the England-Ireland game.
translation: 那个节目将包括英格兰与爱尔兰比赛的实况报道。

meaning: adj. 爱尔兰的；爱尔兰人的; n. 爱尔兰人；爱尔兰语；爱尔兰
example: "Kathleen" was, as its 1892 subtitle asserted, "An Irish Drama".
translation: 正如1892年剧本的副标题所强调的，《凯瑟琳》是一部“爱尔兰戏剧”。

meaning: n. 熨斗；烙铁；坚强; v. 熨；用铁铸成; adj. 铁的；残酷的；刚强的
example: The small churchyard was surrounded by a rusted wrought-iron fence.
translation: 不大的教堂墓地周边围着一圈生锈的熟铁栅栏。

meaning: v. 灌溉；冲洗；使清新
example: He also wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
translation: 他也想用这些水灌溉荒漠。

meaning: n. 灌溉；[临床] 冲洗；冲洗法
example: The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system.
translation: 就在一个重要的灌溉系统的北边，这些河流交汇在一起。

meaning: n. 岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物; adj. 岛的; vt. 孤立；使成岛状
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: pron. [指无生命的东西、动物、植物]它；这；那; abbr. 信息技术information technology
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: adj. 意大利的；意大利文化的；意大利语的; n. 意大利人；意大利语
example: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street.
translation: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

meaning: n. 意大利（欧洲南部国家）
example: The annual slaughter of wildlife in Italy is horrific.
translation: 在意大利，每年大量捕杀野生动物的现象令人震惊。

meaning: pron. 它的; n. (Its)人名；(俄)伊茨
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: pron. 它自己；它本身
example: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
translation: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

meaning: n. 羽绒滑雪衫；西装短外套；短上衣，夹克；土豆皮；书籍的护封；文件套，公文夹; v. 给…穿夹克；给…装护套；给…包上护封；〈口〉打
example: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?
translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

meaning: n. 果酱；拥挤；困境；扣篮; v. 使堵塞；挤进，使塞满；混杂；压碎
example: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.
translation: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。

meaning: n. 一月
example: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

meaning: n. 日本（东亚国家名）
example: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

meaning: adj. 日本（人）的；日语的; n. 日本人；日语
example: New Japanese cars averaged 13 km to the litre in 1981.
translation: 1981年，新型的日产汽车平均每升汽油能跑13千米。

meaning: n. 罐；广口瓶；震动；刺耳声; v. 冲突；不一致；震惊；发刺耳声
example: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

meaning: n. 颌；下巴；狭窄入口；唠叨; v. 教训；唠叨
example: His jaw was broken after he was hit on the head.
translation: 他的头部受重击之后下颌骨折了。

meaning: n. 爵士乐，爵士舞；喧闹; v. 奏爵士乐，跳爵士舞；游荡; adj. 爵士乐的；喧吵的
example: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.
translation: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。

meaning: n. 牛仔裤；工装裤
example: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

meaning: n. 吉普车
example: The two men leaped into the jeep and roared off.
translation: 两名男子跳上吉普车，疾驰而去。

meaning: n. 喷射，喷嘴；喷气式飞机；黑玉; adj. 墨黑的; v. 射出
example: As he talked, an airforce jet screamed over the town.
translation: 他谈话时，一架军用喷气式飞机在镇子上空呼啸而过。

meaning: n. 宝石；珠宝; v. 镶以宝石；饰以珠宝
example: Alan, you're a jewel.
translation: 艾伦，你真是出类拔萃呀。

meaning: n. 珠宝；珠宝类
example: I spend a lot on expensive jewelry and clothing.
translation: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。

meaning: n. 工作；职业; v. 承包；代客买卖
example: He was hand-picked for this job by the Admiral.
translation: 他是由海军上将精心挑选出来担任这项工作的。

meaning: v. 慢跑；轻推；蹒跚行进；使颠簸; n. 慢跑；轻推，轻撞
example: They set off at a jog up one street and down another.
translation: 他们开始沿着一条又一条的街道慢跑。

meaning: v. 参加；结合；连接; n. 结合；连接；接合点
example: I know you will join me in wishing them Godspeed.
translation: 我知道你会同我一起祝愿他们诸事顺遂的。

meaning: n. 玩笑，笑话；笑柄; v. 开…的玩笑
example: His friends say he was always quick to tell a joke.
translation: 他的朋友们说，以前他讲笑话总是张嘴就来。

meaning: n. 新闻工作者；报人；记日志者
example: A journalist all his life, he's now brought out a book.
translation: 他当了一辈子新闻记者，如今已出了一本书。

meaning: n. 旅行；行程; v. 旅行
example: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
translation: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

meaning: n. 欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴; v. 欣喜，欢喜
example: It was a joy to see. It really made my day.
translation: 这太有趣了，真的把我高兴坏了。

meaning: v. 判断；审判; n. 法官；裁判员
example: judge of
translation: 判断；评价

meaning: n. 意见；判断力；[法] 审判；评价
example: A tide of emotion rose and clouded his judgement.
translation: 心头涌起一阵强烈的感情，模糊了他的判断力。

meaning: n. （水果）汁，液；果汁
example: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

meaning: adj. 多汁的；利润多的；生动的
example: It provided some juicy gossip for a few days.
translation: 这制造了一些非常八卦的流言蜚语，足够说上几天的。

meaning: n. 跳跃；暴涨；惊跳; v. 跳跃；使跳跃；跳过；突升
example: His team-mates opened hotel windows, shouting "Jump!" and somewhat less printable banter.
translation: 他的队友打开了酒店的窗户，大叫着“跳！”，还开了一些上不了台面的玩笑。

meaning: n. 六月；琼（人名，来源于拉丁语，含义是“年轻气盛的六月”）
example: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
translation: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

meaning: n. 丛林，密林；危险地带; adj. 丛林的；蛮荒的
example: "Orchards would take the place of the jungle," he rhapsodized.
translation: “要让这片丛林成为果园，”他无比兴奋地说。

meaning: adj. 年少的；后进的；下级的; n. 年少者，晚辈；地位较低者；大学三年级学生
