meaning: n. 照片，图画；影片；景色；化身; v. 画；想像；描写
example: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
translation: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

meaning: n. 馅饼；饼图；爱说话的人; vt. 使杂乱
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: n. 块；件；篇；硬币; v. 修补；接合；凑合
example: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
translation: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

meaning: n. 猪；猪肉; v. 生小猪；像猪一样过活
example: I'm afraid I made a pig of myself at dinner.
translation: 恐怕我晚餐时吃得太多了。

meaning: n. 堆；大量；建筑群; v. 累积；打桩于
example: On the table beside an empty plate was a pile of books.
translation: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

meaning: n. 药丸；弹丸，子弹；口服避孕药; v. 把…制成丸剂；使服用药丸；抢劫，掠夺（古语）
example: The pill is the most efficient method of birth control.
translation: 服用避孕药是最有效的避孕方法。

meaning: n. 枕头; v. 垫；枕于…；使…靠在
example: I have a pillow with my name embroidered on it.
translation: 我有一个绣着我名字的枕头。

meaning: n. 飞行员；领航员; adj. 试点的; v. 驾驶；领航；试用
example: The minutes towards departure ticked by, until finally the pilot arrived.
translation: 离出发的时间越来越近，最后飞行员终于到了。

meaning: n. 大头针，别针，针；栓；琐碎物; v. 钉住；压住；将……用针别住
example: She'd do anything for a bit of pin money.
translation: 为了挣点外快，她什么都肯做。

meaning: v. 渴望，痛苦；憔悴; n. [林] 松树；凤梨，菠萝; adj. 松木的；似松的
example: Make sure your pet won't pine while you're away.
translation: 要确保不在家时宠物不会想你。

meaning: n. [园艺] 菠萝；[园艺] 凤梨; adj. 凤梨科的
example: It'sa drink made by steeping pineapple rind in water.
translation: 这是用菠萝皮泡在水里做的饮料。

meaning: n. 粉红色；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物; v. 扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤; adj. 粉红的；比较激进的；石竹科的；脸色发红的
example: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
translation: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

meaning: n. 品脱；一品脱的量；一品脱牛奶或啤酒
example: Give Roger another pint, Imogen, and I'll have the same again.
translation: 再给罗杰来一杯，伊莫金，我也再来一份同样的。

meaning: n. 先锋；拓荒者; v. 开辟；倡导；提倡
example: She was a suffragette and a birth control pioneer.
translation: 她参加争取妇女选举权的运动，也是节育倡导者。

meaning: n. 管；烟斗；笛; v. 吹笛；尖叫
example: Just pipe down and I'll tell you what I want.
translation: 别说了，我来告诉你我想要什么。

meaning: n. 怜悯，同情；遗憾; v. 对……表示怜悯；对……感到同情
example: She summoned up all her pity for him, to smother her self-pity.
translation: 她抑制着心中的自怜，将满腔的怜悯之情都倾注在了他的身上。

meaning: n. 地方；住所；座位; v. 放置；任命；寄予
example: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
translation: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

meaning: adj. 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的; n. 平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西; adv. 清楚地；平易地
example: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: n. 计划；平面图; v. 计划；设计；打算
example: The plan is good; the problem is it doesn't go far enough.
translation: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。

meaning: n. 飞机；平面；程度，水平; v. 刨；乘飞机旅行；翱翔; adj. 平的；平面的
example: The plane has been kept in service far longer than originally intended.
translation: 这架飞机已经超期服役很长时间了。

meaning: n. 行星
example: The blue whale is the largest living thing on the planet.
translation: 蓝鲸是地球上体型最大的生物。

meaning: n. 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼; v. 种植；培养；栽培；安置
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: adj. 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的; n. 塑料制品；整形；可塑体
example: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

meaning: n. 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片; v. 电镀；给…装甲
example: Garnish the plate with whipped cream rosettes and fresh fruits.
translation: 用玫瑰花形的掼奶油和新鲜的水果作配菜点缀盘子。

meaning: n. 平台；月台，站台；坛；讲台
example: PLATFORM is an alliance of more than 80 rail-user groups.
translation: PLATFORM公司是80多个铁路用户组的联盟。

meaning: v. 游戏；扮演；演奏；播放；同…比赛; n. 游戏；比赛；剧本
example: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
translation: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

meaning: n. 运动员，比赛者；游戏者，做游戏的人；演奏者，表演者；演员；播放器
example: As a player he was unselfish, a true team man.
translation: 作为一名选手，他毫无私念，真正把自己摆在团队中。

meaning: n. 运动场，操场；游乐场
example: There was a sandpit, a seesaw and a swing in the playground.
translation: 游乐场上有一处沙坑、一块跷跷板和一个秋千架。

meaning: n. 玩伴；游伴
example: He wandered hither and thither looking for a playmate.
translation: 他逛来逛去找玩伴.

meaning: n. 游戏室；娱乐室
example: Those wine bottles are out of place in the children's playroom.
translation: 那些酒瓶不适合放在小孩子们的游戏间里.

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的，舒适的；讨人喜欢的，和蔼可亲的; n. (Pleasant)人名；(英)普莱曾特
example: Lloyd George was most anxious to be agreeable and pleasant.
translation: 劳埃德·乔治极力想表现得平易近人、和蔼亲切。

meaning: v. 使喜欢；使高兴，使满意; int. 请（礼貌用语）
example: "Please understand this," she began, a tremble in her voice.
translation: “请理解这一点，”她开始说道，声音有些发颤。

meaning: adj. 高兴的；喜欢的；乐意做某事; v. 满意；愿意（please的过去分词形式）
example: I'm always pleased to try out a new variety.
translation: 我一直乐于尝试新产品。

meaning: n. 快乐；希望；娱乐；令人高兴的事; vt. 使高兴；使满意; vi. 高兴；寻欢作乐
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: n. 丰富，大量；充足; adj. 足够的，很多的; adv. 足够
example: There were plenty of servants to wait on her.
translation: 有很多仆人服侍她。

meaning: n. 情节；图；阴谋; v. 密谋；绘图；划分；标绘
example: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
translation: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

meaning: n. 插头；塞子；栓; v. 塞住；用插头将与电源接通
example: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
translation: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

meaning: n. 正号，加号；好处；附加额; adj. 正的；附加的; prep. 加，加上
example: There are only 35 staff to serve 30,000-plus customers.
translation: 只有35名员工，却要为3万多顾客服务。

meaning: abbr. （拉）下午（Post Meridiem，等于afternoon）；调相（Phase Modulation）
example: They appeared on the dot of 9.50 pm as always.
translation: 他们和往常一样在晚上9点50分准时出现。

meaning: n. 口袋；钱；容器; v. 隐藏；忍受；将…放入衣袋; adj. 小型的，袖珍的；金钱上的
example: He spends most of his pocket money on PlayStation games.
translation: 他大部分零花钱都用来买PS游戏了。

meaning: n. 诗
example: At my brother's high school graduation the students recited a poem.
translation: 在我弟弟的高中毕业典礼上，学生们朗诵了一首诗。

meaning: n. 诗人
example: The concept of the Rose continued to inform the poet's work.
translation: 玫瑰的概念持续贯穿于诗人的作品中。

meaning: n. 要点；得分；标点；[机] 尖端; v. 指向；弄尖；加标点于
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: v. 污染；使中毒，放毒于；败坏；阻碍; n. 毒药，毒物；酒；有毒害的事物；[助剂] 抑制剂; adj. 有毒的
example: Markov died after being struck by a poison dart.
translation: 马尔科夫身中毒镖而亡。

meaning: adj. 有毒的；恶毒的；讨厌的
example: Poisonous smoke had got into the water supply.
translation: 毒烟已经进入供水系统。

meaning: n. 杆；极点；电极; v. 用竿支撑
example: She is a pole dancer at London's famous Spearmint Rhino club.
translation: 她是伦敦著名的“薄荷犀牛”夜总会的钢管舞舞者。

meaning: n. 警察，警方；治安; v. 监督；管辖；维持治安；为…配备警察; adj. 警察的；有关警察的
example: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

meaning: n. 警察，警员；[分化] 淀帚（橡皮头玻璃搅棒）
example: The two policemen were joined by another policeman also carrying a pistol.
translation: 另一名持枪警察和那两名警察会合了。

meaning: n. 政策，方针；保险单
example: It was not the policy of the government to repatriate genuine refugees.
translation: 遣返真正的难民回国并非政府的政策。

meaning: n. 磨光，擦亮；擦亮剂；优雅，精良; v. 擦亮，变光滑; adj. 波兰的
example: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
translation: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

meaning: adj. 有礼貌的，客气的；文雅的；上流的；优雅的
example: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
translation: 他话不多，很有礼貌，为人谦和。

meaning: adj. 政治的；党派的
example: It was time now to show more political realism.
translation: 现在是拿出更多政治务实精神的时候了。

meaning: n. 政治家，政客
example: He is widely regarded as Hungary's most skilful politician.
translation: 他是公认的匈牙利最有手腕的政治家。

meaning: n. 政治，政治学；政治活动；政纲
example: He closed down the business and went into politics.
translation: 他关闭公司投身政治。

meaning: v. 污染；玷污；败坏
example: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest.
translation: 采矿会污染湖水，毁掉森林。

meaning: n. 污染
example: Randolph's work was exclusively concerned with the effects of pollution on health.
translation: 伦道夫的著作专门论述污染对健康的影响。

meaning: vt. 筑成池塘; vi. 筑成池塘; n. 池塘
example: Tourist numbers from across the pond have dropped dramatically.
translation: 来自大西洋彼岸的游客数量已急剧减少。

meaning: n. 联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金; v. 联营，合伙经营
example: She was standing by a pool, about to dive in.
translation: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。

meaning: adj. 贫穷的；可怜的；贫乏的；卑鄙的; n. (Poor)人名；(英、伊朗)普尔
example: Conditions for the poor in Los Angeles have not improved.
translation: 洛杉矶穷人的境况仍未得到改善。

meaning: abbr. 卖点广告（Point of Purchase）
example: The radio had fed him a diet of pop songs.
translation: 他从广播里听到的都是千篇一律的流行歌曲。

meaning: n. 爆米花，爆玉米花
example: a paper cone full of popcorn
translation: 装满爆玉米花的锥形纸筒

meaning: adj. 流行的，通俗的；受欢迎的；大众的；普及的
example: The military government has been unable to win popular support.
translation: 军政府一直未能赢得广泛的支持。

meaning: n. 人口；[生物] 种群，[生物] 群体；全体居民
example: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

meaning: n. 猪肉; vt. 与女子性交
example: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
translation: 在火上熏制猪腿。

meaning: n. 粥，糊；麦片粥; vt. 服刑
example: Their room was bare of furniture and they lived off porridge.
translation: 他们家徒四壁，靠喝粥度日。

meaning: n. 港口，口岸；（计算机的）端口；左舷；舱门; v. 转向左舷
example: He asked for a glass of port after dinner.
translation: 晚饭后，他要了一杯波尔图葡萄酒。

meaning: adj. 手提的，便携式的；轻便的; n. 手提式打字机
example: A small-screen portable TV can be a good investment.
translation: 小屏幕的便携式电视机很值得买。

meaning: n. 门房；服务员；行李搬运工；守门人
example: A porter relieved her of the three large cases.
translation: 一个行李搬运工替她扛了3个大包。

meaning: n. 位置，方位；职位，工作；姿态；站位; v. 安置；把……放在适当位置
example: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
translation: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

meaning: v. 控制；使掌握；持有；迷住；拥有，具备
example: This figure has long been held to possess miraculous power.
translation: 这个数字长时间以来都被认为拥有神奇的力量。

meaning: n. 拥有；财产；领地；自制；着迷
example: How had this com-promising picture come into the possession of the press?
translation: 这张令人难堪的照片是怎么落到媒体手中的？

meaning: n. 可能性；可能发生的事物
example: There is the possibility that hypothermia can go unrecognized.
translation: 人们有可能察觉不到体温的过低。

meaning: adj. 可能的；合理的；合适的; n. 可能性；合适的人；可能的事物
example: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
translation: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

meaning: adv. 可能地；也许；大概
example: Do you think that he could possibly be right?
translation: 你觉得他有可能是对的吗？

meaning: n. 岗位；邮件；标杆; v. 张贴；公布；邮递；布置
example: post office
translation: n. 邮局

meaning: n. 邮资，邮费
example: Send a cheque for £18.99 plus £2 for postage and packing.
translation: 请寄上18.99英镑的支票，外加2英镑的邮资和包装费。

meaning: n. 邮箱
example: I stuck the stamp on and ran to the postbox.
translation: 我贴上邮票,然后向邮箱跑去.

meaning: n. 明信片
example: For more details about these products, send a postcard marked HB/FF.
translation: 要了解这些产品的详细信息，请寄来标明HB/FF字样的明信片。

meaning: n. （英）邮政编码；邮区号
example: Mark the frame with your postcode.
translation: 在这一格里写上你的邮政编码。

meaning: n. 海报，广告；招贴
example: The current national poster child is a tiny, freckle-faced redhead.
translation: 现在的那个全国广告代言人个头不高，红头发，脸上有雀斑。

meaning: n. 邮递员；邮差
example: I remembered a particular story about a postman who was a murderer.
translation: 我记得有个故事，讲的是一个邮递员杀人的事情。

meaning: v. 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面
example: I had to postpone ideas of a career and stay at home.
translation: 我不得不暂缓就业打算，呆在家里。

meaning: n. 壶；盆；罐; v. 把…装罐；射击；节略
example: You will need a pot of broth for poaching.
translation: 你需要一锅汤来煮。

meaning: n. [作物] 土豆，[作物] 马铃薯
example: The potato cakes should be crisp outside and meltingly soft inside.
translation: 土豆饼应该外面酥脆,里面嫩软.

meaning: n. 潜能；可能性；[电] 电势; adj. 潜在的；可能的；势的
example: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
translation: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

meaning: n. 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所; v. 捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留
example: The one thousand pound bomb was triggered by a wire.
translation: 那颗重达1,000磅的炸弹是由一根导线引爆的。

meaning: n. 倾泻；流出；骤雨; v. 灌，注；倒；倾泻；倾吐
example: Stir the sauce and pour it over the top.
translation: 搅拌调味汁，把它浇在上面。

meaning: n. 粉；粉末；[化工][军] 火药；尘土; v. 使成粉末；撒粉；搽粉于
example: Unless these questions are solved, the region will remain a powder keg.
translation: 除非这些问题得到解决，否则该地区会一直是个火药桶。

meaning: n. 力量，能力；电力，功率；政权，势力；[数] 幂; v. 激励；供以动力；使…有力量; adj. 借影响有权势人物以操纵权力的
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: adj. 强大的；强有力的; adv. 很；非常
example: The government wilted in the face of such powerful pressure.
translation: 政府面对如此大的压力，失去了信心。

meaning: adj. 实际的；实用性的
example: After half an hour's commis-eration, we turned to more practical matters.
translation: 惺惺相惜了半个小时后，我们转而讨论一些更为实际的问题。

meaning: n. 实践；练习；惯例; v. 练习；实习；实行
example: His hands were rough and calloused, from years of karate practice.
translation: 由于多年练习空手道，他的双手粗糙不平，布满老茧。

meaning: n. 大草原；牧场
example: Andrew traversed the prairie on horseback.
translation: 安德鲁骑马穿越大草原.

meaning: n. 赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜; v. 赞美，歌颂；表扬
example: The team also won praise for sportsmanship and fair play.
translation: 该队还因其良好的体育精神及公平竞争精神而受到了表扬。

meaning: v. 祈祷；恳求；央求; n. (Pray)人名；(匈)普劳伊；(英)普雷
example: We have a beautiful city and we pray it stays that way.
translation: 我们的城市很美丽，但愿它能保持下去。

meaning: n. 祈祷，祷告；恳求；祈祷文
example: The Colonel bowed his head and whispered a prayer of thanksgiving.
translation: 这位上校低头轻声做感恩祈祷。

meaning: adj. 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的; n. (Precious)人名；(英)普雷舍斯，普雷舍丝(女名)
example: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

meaning: adj. 精确的；明确的；严格的
example: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.
translation: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。

meaning: v. 预报，预言；预知
example: The test can accurately predict what a bigger explosion would do.
translation: 该试验能准确地预测一次更大爆炸的威力。

meaning: v. 更喜欢；宁愿；提出；提升
example: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

meaning: n. 偏爱，倾向；优先权
example: The Pentagon will give preference to companies which do business electronically.
translation: 美国国防部将会优先考虑那些能够进行电子商务的公司。

meaning: adj. 怀孕的；富有意义的
example: The number of women who become pregnant after adopting children is legion.
translation: 领养小孩后怀孕的妇女比比皆是。

meaning: n. 偏见；侵害; v. 损害；使有偏见
example: Rowe does a very clever riff on the nature of prejudice.
translation: 罗就偏见的本质讲了一番很精辟的话。

meaning: adj. 第一的；最初的; n. 总理，首相
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: n. 预备；准备
example: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
translation: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

meaning: v. 准备；使适合；装备；起草
example: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

meaning: n. 药方；指示；惯例; adj. 凭处方方可购买的
example: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
translation: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

meaning: v. 提出；介绍；呈现；赠送; adj. 现在的；出席的; n. 现在；礼物；瞄准
example: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
translation: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

meaning: n. 展示；描述，陈述；介绍；赠送
example: The ideas in the show's presentation were good, but failed in execution.
translation: 那场展览陈述的想法很好，但是没能实现。

meaning: v. 保存；保护；维持；腌；禁猎; n. 保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品
example: After the Norman Conquest the forest became a royal hunting preserve.
translation: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

meaning: n. 总统；董事长；校长；主席
example: The President's speeches are regularly reproduced verbatim in the state-run newspapers.
translation: 总统的讲话通常会被一字不差地刊登在国有报纸上。

meaning: v. 压；按；逼迫；紧抱; n. 压；按；新闻；出版社；[印刷] 印刷机
example: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
translation: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

meaning: n. 压力；压迫，[物] 压强; v. 迫使；密封；使……增压
example: The government wilted in the face of such powerful pressure.
translation: 政府面对如此大的压力，失去了信心。

meaning: v. 假装，伪装，佯装; adj. 假装的
example: The children pretend to be different animals dancing to the music.
translation: 孩子们扮成不同的动物，随着音乐起舞。

meaning: adj. 漂亮的；可爱的；优美的; adv. 相当地；颇; n. 有吸引力的事物（尤指饰品）；漂亮的人
example: She's going to be fine. She always was pretty strong.
translation: 她会好的。她一直都很强壮。

meaning: v. 预防，防止；阻止
example: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

meaning: n. 预览；试映；事先查看; v. 预览；预演；事先查看
example: They attended a sneak preview of the winter fashion collection.
translation: 他们参观了一次对内的冬季时装预展.

meaning: n. 价格；价值；代价; v. 给……定价；问……的价格
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: n. 自豪；骄傲；自尊心; v. 使得意，以…自豪
example: He wrote the word "pride" in huge letters on the blackboard.
translation: 他在黑板上写了一个大大的单词pride。

meaning: adj. 主要的；初级的；基本的; n. 原色；最主要者
example: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.
translation: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。

meaning: adj. 原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的; n. 原始人
example: Duffy's primitive guitar playing is well below par.
translation: 达菲粗糙的吉他演奏技巧远不够水平。

meaning: n. 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉
example: Observance of the law is a matter of principle for us.
translation: 守法是我们的一个原则问题。

meaning: n. 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记; v. 印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样
example: Many of their books have been in print for nearly 40 years.
translation: 他们的很多书都印行将近40年了。

meaning: n. [计] 打印机；印刷工；印花工
example: computer consumables such as disks and printer cartridges
translation: 如磁盘、打印机墨盒之类的电脑耗材

meaning: n. 印刷；印刷术
example: The American edition of "Cloud Street" is already in its third printing.
translation: 美国版的《云街》已经是第三次印刷了。

meaning: n. 监狱；监禁；拘留所; vt. 监禁，关押
example: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
translation: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

meaning: n. 囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告
example: His men made a sortie to Guazatan and took a prisoner.
translation: 他的士兵袭击了瓜扎坦，擒获了一名俘虏。

meaning: adj. 私人的；私有的；私下的; n. 列兵；二等兵
example: Like their children, parents are often defensive about their private lives.
translation: 就像子女一样，父母也常常很注重保护他们的私生活。

meaning: n. 特权；优待; v. 给与…特权；特免
example: Pironi was the son of privilege and wealth, and it showed.
translation: 皮罗尼出身于有钱有势的豪门，这看得出来。

meaning: n. 奖品；奖赏；战利品; v. 珍视；捕获；估价; adj. 获奖的
example: Each month the total prize kitty is £13.5 million.
translation: 每个月的彩池奖金总额达1,350万英镑。

meaning: adj. 很可能的；可信的; n. 很可能的事；大有希望的候选者
example: The Socialists united behind their probable presidential candidate, Michel Rocard.
translation: 社会党人团结在他们很有希望当选的总统候选人米歇尔·罗卡尔周围。

meaning: n. 难题；引起麻烦的人; adj. 成问题的；难处理的
example: The plan is good; the problem is it doesn't go far enough.
translation: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。

meaning: n. 程序，手续；步骤
example: British Parliamentary procedure is perplexing at the best of times.
translation: 即使在最好情况下，英国议会的程序也很费解。

meaning: v. 处理；加工; n. 过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移; adj. 经过特殊加工（或处理）的
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: v. 生产；引起；创作；生育，繁殖; n. 农产品，产品
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: n. 产品；结果；[数] 乘积；作品
example: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.
translation: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

meaning: n. 成果；产品；生产；作品
example: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
translation: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

meaning: n. 职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白
example: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
translation: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

meaning: n. 利润；利益; v. 获利；有益
example: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
translation: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

meaning: n. 计划，规划；节目；程序; v. 编程序；制作节目
example: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
translation: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

meaning: n. 进步，发展；前进; v. 前进，进步；进行
example: His remedial teacher sees signs of progress in his reading and writing.
translation: 他的辅导教师发现了他在阅读和写作方面进步的迹象。

meaning: v. 阻止，禁止
example: In most of the residence halls we visited, rules prohibit disorderly conduct.
translation: 在我们走访的学生宿舍里，大多明令禁止胡作非为。

meaning: v. 设计；计划；表达；投射; n. 工程；计划；事业
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: n. 许诺，允诺；希望; v. 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望
example: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: v. 促进；提升；推销；发扬
example: They have begun dialogues to promote better understanding between both communities.
translation: 双方已经开始了对话，以增进两个社群间的彼此了解。

meaning: v. 发音；宣判；断言
example: Men feel perfectly free to pronounce on the way women should look.
translation: 男人随心所欲地对女性美的标准发表看法。

meaning: n. 发音；读法
example: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
translation: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

meaning: adj. 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的; adv. 完全地; n. (Proper)人名；(英、德)普罗珀
example: He denied that he'd failed to keep a proper lookout that night.
translation: 他否认当晚守望不力。

meaning: adv. 适当地；正确地；恰当地
example: There needs to be a properly informed public debate.
translation: 有必要让公众在充分知情的状况下展开辩论。

meaning: v. 保护，防卫；警戒
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: n. 保护；防卫；护照
example: For added protection choose a lipstick with a sun screen.
translation: 选择防晒护唇膏来增强保护。

meaning: adj. 自豪的；得意的；自负的; n. (Proud)人名；(英)普劳德
example: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
translation: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

meaning: v. 证明；检验；显示
example: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced, person.
translation: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

meaning: v. 提供；规定；准备；装备
example: Poland provide the opposition for the Scots' last warm-up match at home.
translation: 苏格兰队在国内最后一场热身赛的对手是波兰队。

meaning: n. 省；领域；职权
example: Most of those who left the province to work abroad were unskilled.
translation: 那些离开该省出国打工的人大部分都未经专门训练。

meaning: n. 酒馆；客栈
example: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
translation: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

meaning: adj. 公众的；政府的；公用的；公立的; n. 公众；社会；公共场所
example: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

meaning: adv. 公然地；以公众名义
example: They issue a fixed number of shares that trade publicly.
translation: 他们发行一定数量的可公开交易的股票。

meaning: v. 出版；发表；公布
example: My object was to publish a scholarly work on Peter Mourne.
translation: 我的目标是出版一本关于彼得·莫恩的学术著作。

meaning: v. 拉；拔；拖; n. 拉，拉绳；拉力，牵引力；拖
example: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
translation: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

meaning: n. [电子] 脉冲；脉搏; v. 使跳动
example: There was no breathing or pulse and he was lifeless.
translation: 没有呼吸，也没有脉搏，他已经死了。

meaning: v. 打气；用抽水机抽…; n. 泵，抽水机；打气筒
example: They find it difficult to pump themselves up for the games.
translation: 他们感到要为自己加油打气，自信满满地去打比赛并不容易。

meaning: adj. 准时的，守时的；精确的
example: She has been reliable and punctual.
translation: 她一直可靠守时。

meaning: v. 不时打断；强调；加标点于
example: He did not bother to punctuate the telegraph message.
translation: 他没有费心在电文中加标点.

meaning: n. 标点；标点符号
example: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: v. 惩罚；严厉对待；贪婪地吃喝
example: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
translation: 现行雇佣法要变，要奖勤罚懒。

meaning: n. 惩罚；严厉对待，虐待
example: Punishment cannot be discussed in isolation from social theory.
translation: 不能脱离社会理论孤立地讨论惩罚。

meaning: n. 学生；[解剖] 瞳孔；未成年人
example: After his education, Goldschmidt became a pupil of the composer Franz Schreker.
translation: 学业结束后，戈尔德施米特成了作曲家弗朗兹·施雷克尔的学生。

meaning: n. 购买；紧握；起重装置; v. 购买；赢得
example: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
translation: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

meaning: adj. 纯的；纯粹的；纯洁的；清白的；纯理论的; n. (Pure)人名；(俄)普雷
example: Somehow she'd always been a child in his mind, pure and virginal.
translation: 不知何故，她在他心里一直是个天真无邪的孩子。

meaning: adj. 紫色的；帝王的；华而不实的; n. 紫色；紫袍; v. 变成紫色
example: "Get the guy in the purple shirt." — "All right, my man."
translation: “把那个穿紫衬衫的家伙叫过来。”——“好的，老兄。”

meaning: n. 目的；用途；意志; v. 决心；企图；打算
example: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

meaning: n. (女士)手提袋；(国家、家庭、团体等的) 财力; v. （嘴巴）皱起，使缩拢；撅嘴
example: She looked at me and then reached in her purse for cigarettes.
translation: 她看看我，接着伸手去包里拿香烟。

meaning: v. 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服; n. 推，决心；大规模攻势；矢志的追求
example: I saw her push the boulder down on you.
translation: 我看见她将巨石推下砸向你。

meaning: v. 放；表达；移动；安置；赋予; n. 掷；笨蛋；投击；怪人; adj. 固定不动的
example: A changing world has put pressures on the corporation.
translation: 日新月异的世界使这家公司感到了压力。

meaning: v. 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出; n. 谜；难题；迷惑
example: A rather neat option allows you to design your own fiendish puzzle.
translation: 只要干净利落地做一个选择，你就能自己设计出难以解开的谜题。

meaning: adj. 困惑的；茫然的；搞糊涂的
example: jigsaw puzzle
translation: n. 七巧板；智力拼图玩具

meaning: n. 金字塔；角锥体; v. 渐增；上涨；成金字塔状
example: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

meaning: v. 震动；颤抖; n. 地震；颤抖
example: Most of the wreckage from the 1985 quake has been cleared.
translation: 1985年地震遗留的废墟大部分已经被清理干净。

meaning: n. 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格
example: That time with him is my qualification to write this book.
translation: 我和他曾经相处过一段时间，所以才能写出这本书。

meaning: n. 质量，[统计] 品质；特性；才能; adj. 优质的；高品质的；<英俚>棒极了
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: n. 量，数量；大量；总量
example: quantity of
translation: 数量；流量

meaning: v. 吵架；争论；挑剔; n. 吵架；反目；怨言；争吵的原因；方头凿
example: They could quarrel quite legitimately with some of my choices.
translation: 他们大有理由不同意我的一些选择。

meaning: n. 四分之一；地区；季度；一刻钟；两角五分；节; v. 住宿；驻扎; num. 四分之一
example: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce.
translation: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

meaning: n. 女王，王后；（纸牌中的）皇后；（蜜蜂等的）蜂王; v. 使…成为女王或王后
example: Queen Mary started the fashion for blue and white china in England.
translation: 玛丽女王开启了青花瓷在英格兰的流行风尚。

meaning: n. 问题，疑问；询问；疑问句; v. 询问；怀疑；审问
example: This brings us to the second question I asked.
translation: 这就将我们带到了我所提的第二个问题。

meaning: n. 问卷；调查表
example: Answer the questionnaire overleaf.
translation: 请回答背面的问卷。

meaning: n. 队列；长队；辫子; v. 排队；排队等候
example: queue up
translation: v. 排队等候

meaning: n. 核心；伤口的嫩肉; adj. 快的；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的; adv. 迅速地，快
example: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
translation: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

meaning: adj. 安静的；安定的；不动的；温顺的; n. 安静；和平; v. 使平息；安慰
example: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

meaning: n. 被子；棉被; v. 东拼西凑地编；加软衬料后缝制
example: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.
translation: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。

meaning: v. 离开；放弃；停止；使…解除; n. 离开；[计] 退出; adj. 摆脱了…的；已经了结的
example: Well, parenthetically, I was trying to quit smoking at the time.
translation: 嗯，插一句，我那时正在努力戒烟。

meaning: adv. 很；相当；完全
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: n. 考查；恶作剧；课堂测验; v. 挖苦；张望；对…进行测验
example: Below are printed the answers to the Brain of Soccer 1993 quiz.
translation: 以下所印的是1993年“脑力足球”小测验的答案。

meaning: n. 兔子，野兔; v. 让…见鬼去吧
example: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
translation: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

meaning: n. 属，种；种族，人种；家庭，门第; v. 使参加比赛；和…竞赛；使急走，使全速行进
example: Before the race, he is fine. But afterwards he is worn out.
translation: 赛前他状态很好，赛后就筋疲力尽了。

meaning: adj. 种族的；人种的
example: Marseilles has proved to be a better racial melting pot than Lyons.
translation: 事实证明，与里昂相比，马赛是一个更好的种族大熔炉。

meaning: n. 辐射；发光；放射物
n. 收音机；无线电广播设备; v. 用无线电进行通信
adj. [核] 放射性的；有辐射的
example: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
translation: 废料被安全储存起来，直到其不再有辐射性。

meaning: n. [化学] 镭（88号元素符号Ra）
example: Radium can be used to treat cancer.
translation: 镭可以用来治疗癌症.

meaning: n. 破布；碎屑; v. 戏弄；责骂
example: He was wiping his hands on an oily rag.
translation: 他正在用一块满是油污的破布擦手。

meaning: n. 铁轨；扶手；横杆；围栏; v. 抱怨；责骂
example: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.
translation: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。

meaning: n. （英）铁路；轨道；铁道部门; vi. 乘火车旅行
example: Dozens of miles of railway track have been torn up.
translation: 好几十英里的铁轨被毁坏了。

meaning: n. 雨；下雨；雨天；雨季; v. 下雨；降雨
example: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
translation: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

meaning: n. 彩虹；五彩缤纷的排列；幻想; adj. 五彩缤纷的；彩虹状的; vt. 使呈彩虹状；如彩虹般装饰; vi. 呈彩虹状
example: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
translation: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾上照出了一道彩虹。

meaning: n. （美）雨衣
example: He wore a belted raincoat that accentuated his portly middle.
translation: 他穿着一件系腰带的雨衣，使他发福的腰身更加显眼。

meaning: n. 降雨；降雨量
example: Victoria Falls has had above average levels of rainfall this year.
translation: 维多利亚瀑布今年的降雨量超过了平均水平。

meaning: adj. 下雨的；多雨的; n. (Rainy)人名；(英)雷尼
example: They walked along the promenade on a rainy night.
translation: 他们在一个雨夜沿着海滨道散步。

meaning: v. 提高；筹集；养育；升起; n. 高地；上升；加薪
example: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.
translation: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。

meaning: adj. [数] 随机的；任意的；胡乱的; n. 随意; adv. 胡乱地
example: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.
translation: 3个人被从一辆面包车中发射的乱弹打死了。

meaning: n. 范围；幅度；排；山脉; v. （在内）变动；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到
example: The company manufactures a range of innovative light-weight cycles.
translation: 这家公司生产一系列的新型轻便自行车。

meaning: n. 排；等级；军衔；队列; adj. 讨厌的；恶臭的；繁茂的; v. 排列；把…分等
example: Dense smoke swirled and billowed, its rank fumes choking her.
translation: 滚滚浓烟盘旋翻腾，恶臭味呛得她喘不过气来。

meaning: adj. 迅速的，急促的；飞快的；险峻的; n. 急流；高速交通工具，高速交通网
example: The company made a rapid-fire series of settlements with 25 States.
translation: 公司同25个州进行了一连串迅速的结算。

meaning: adj. 稀有的；稀薄的；半熟的; adv. 非常；极其; vi. 用后腿站起；渴望
example: It remained an exceptionally rare book until it was reprinted in 1918.
translation: 在1918年再版之前，这本书一直非常罕见。

meaning: n. 鼠；卑鄙小人，叛徒; v. 捕鼠；背叛，告密
example: smell a rat
translation: 感到不妙；感到有可疑之处

meaning: n. 比率，率；速度；价格；等级; v. 认为；估价；责骂
example: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

meaning: adv. 宁可，宁愿；相当; int. 当然啦（回答问题时用）; n. (Rather)人名；(英)拉瑟
example: Rather taken aback by such forwardness, I slammed down the phone.
translation: 如此无礼的言语让我火冒三丈，我砰的一下把电话挂了。

meaning: adj. 生的；未加工的；阴冷的；刺痛的；擦掉皮的；无经验的；（在艺术等方面）不成熟的; n. 擦伤处; vt. 擦伤
example: raw material
translation: 原料

meaning: v. 剃，用剃刀刮; n. 剃刀
example: The camp is surrounded by razor-wire fences and guarded by military police.
translation: 营地周围架着尖利的铁丝网，且有宪兵看守。

meaning: v. 达到；延伸；伸出手；传开; n. 范围；延伸；河段；横风行驶
v. 反应；影响；反抗；起反作用
example: There'dbe no telling how John would react to such news as this.
translation: 还不知道约翰听到这样的消息会作何反应。

meaning: v. 阅读；读懂，理解; n. 阅读；读物; adj. 有学问的
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: n. 阅读，朗读；读物；读数; adj. 阅读的; v. 阅读（read的ing形式）
example: His remedial teacher sees signs of progress in his reading and writing.
translation: 他的辅导教师发现了他在阅读和写作方面进步的迹象。

meaning: adj. 准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的; n. 现款；预备好的状态; adv. 迅速地；预先; v. 使准备好
example: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
translation: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

meaning: adj. 实际的；真实的；实在的; adv. 真正地；确实地; n. 现实；实数
example: Michael Fish is my favourite. He's a hoot, a real character.
translation: 我最喜欢迈克尔·菲什。他滑稽逗趣，是个实实在在的人物。

meaning: n. 现实；实际；真实
example: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

meaning: v. 实现；认识到；了解；将某物卖得，把(证券等)变成现钱；变卖
example: I didn't realize how heavy that shopping was going to be.
translation: 我没想到买的东西会有多沉。

meaning: n. 理由；理性；动机; v. 推论；劝说
example: I really don't see any reason for changing it.
translation: 我真的不明白为什么要改变它。

meaning: adj. 合理的，公道的；通情达理的
example: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
translation: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

meaning: v. 重建；改造，重新组装；复原
example: How can I rebuild my life without my husband?
translation: 失去丈夫后我怎么才能重新开始生活？

meaning: n. 收到；收据；收入; v. 收到
example: I'm going to make out a receipt for you.
translation: 我开一张收据给你。

meaning: v. 收到；接待；接纳
example: Children at school receive coloured stars for work well done.
translation: 学校里的孩子表现得好会得到彩色星星。

meaning: n. 接收器；接受者；收信机；收款员，接待者
example: The receiver and the quarterback are going to trade positions.
translation: 接球手与四分卫将会对换位置。

meaning: adj. 最近的；近代的
example: Specialists see various reasons for the recent surge in inflation.
translation: 专家们认为目前通货膨胀加剧有多种原因。

meaning: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应
example: Mr Mandela was given a tumultuous reception in Washington.
translation: 曼德拉先生在华盛顿受到热情的款待。

meaning: n. 接待员；传达员
example: The receptionist recognized him at once.
translation: 接待员一眼就认出他了。

meaning: n. 食谱；[临床] 处方；秘诀；烹饪法
example: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used.
translation: 每种菜谱都具体规定了所用鸡蛋的大小。

meaning: v. 背诵；叙述；列举
example: All he could do was recite a list of Government failings.
translation: 他能做的只是列举政府的种种不是。

meaning: v. 认出；承认，认可；识别
example: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
translation: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

meaning: v. 推荐，介绍；劝告；使受欢迎；托付
example: I've just seen a play that I can highly recommend.
translation: 我刚看了一场话剧，我强烈推荐。

meaning: v. 记录，记载；标明；将录音; n. 档案，履历；唱片；最高纪录; adj. 创纪录的
example: Exports in June rose 1.5% to a record $30.91 billion.
translation: 6月份的出口额上升了1.5%，创下309.1亿美元的历史最高纪录。

meaning: n. 录音机；记录器；记录员；八孔直笛
example: Two out of every three Britons already own a video recorder.
translation: 每3个英国人中就有两个已经有了录像机。

meaning: v. 恢复；弥补；重新获得; n. 还原至预备姿势
example: Legal action is being taken to try to recover the money.
translation: 正在进行诉讼以收回那笔钱。

meaning: n. 娱乐；消遣；休养
example: There are plans to enlarge the recreation area.
translation: 已经有了扩大娱乐场地的计划。

meaning: n. 矩形；长方形
example: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
translation: 设长方形的宽是x米.

meaning: v. 使再循环；使…重新利用; n. 再生；再循环；重复利用
example: The objective would be to recycle 98 per cent of domestic waste.
translation: 目标是对98%的生活垃圾进行回收利用。

meaning: n. 红色，红颜料；赤字; adj. 红色的；红肿的，充血的
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
translation: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

meaning: v. 使改方向；重新寄送; adj. 再直接的; n. 再直接询问
v. 减少；降低；使处于；把…分解
example: The job losses will reduce the total workforce to 7,000.
translation: 职位减少后，在职工人总数将减至7,000人。

meaning: v. 参考；涉及；提到；查阅
example: He could refer the matter to the high court.
translation: 他可以将此事交由高等法院裁决。

meaning: n. 裁判员；调解人；介绍人; v. 仲裁；担任裁判
example: He is clearly too partisan to be a referee.
translation: 他倾向性过于明显，当不了裁判。

meaning: n. 参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书; v. 引用
example: Read these notes carefully and keep them for future reference.
translation: 仔细阅读这些注释并将其保留下来以备将来之用。

meaning: v. 反映；反射，照出；表达；显示;反省
example: Does such an attitudinal change reflect real experiences in daily life?
translation: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实遭遇？

meaning: n. 改革，改良；改正; v. 改革，革新；重新组成; adj. 改革的；改革教会的
example: The government wanted to reform the institutions, to shake up the country.
translation: 政府想要实施机构改革，整顿国家。

meaning: v. 更新；使……恢复；使……清新；消除……的疲劳
example: They had stopped by a spring to refresh themselves.
translation: 他们曾在一处泉边停歇休息。

meaning: n. 点心；[食品] 茶点；小吃
example: light refreshments
translation: 点心和饮料

meaning: n. 冰箱，冷藏库
example: He went to the refrigerator and removed a bottle of wine.
translation: 他走到冰箱处拿出一瓶酒。

meaning: n. 拒绝；优先取舍权；推却；取舍权
example: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home.
translation: 他们引证了亚历克斯拒绝回到婚后的家中一事。

meaning: n. 垃圾；废物; v. 拒绝；不愿；抵制
example: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
translation: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

meaning: n. 注意；尊重；问候；凝视; v. 注重，考虑；看待；尊敬；把…看作；与…有关
example: with regard to
translation: adv. 关于；至于

meaning: adj. 不管的；不顾的；不注意的; adv. 不顾后果地；不管怎样，无论如何；不惜费用地
example: It takes in anybody regardless of religion, colour, or creed.
translation: 任何人，不论宗教、肤色或信仰，都可以加入。

meaning: n. 致意，问候; v. 视为，注意（regard的第三人称单数）
example: with regards to
translation: 关于；至于

meaning: v. 登记；注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出; n. 登记；注册；记录；寄存器；登记簿
example: He checked the register. There was money in the till.
translation: 他查看了一下收银机的抽屉，里面有钱。

meaning: n. 遗憾；抱歉；悲叹; v. 后悔；惋惜；哀悼
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: adj. 定期的；有规律的；合格的；整齐的；普通的; n. 常客；正式队员；中坚分子; adv. 定期地；经常地
example: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly.
translation: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

meaning: n. 管理；规则；校准; adj. 规定的；平常的
example: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.
translation: 结果证明对鲑鱼饲养行业的管理不够完善。

meaning: v. 拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃; n. 被弃之物或人；次品
example: We reject any suggestion that the law needs amending.
translation: 对于任何暗示该法律需要修改的观点我们都拒绝接受。

meaning: v. 叙述；使…有联系
example: Other recommendations relate to the details of how such data is stored.
translation: 其他建议涉及此类信息储存方面的一些细节。

meaning: n. 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系
example: Watercolour still seems somehow to be the poor relation of oil painting.
translation: 水彩画似乎仍比油画略逊一筹。

meaning: n. 关系；关联
example: A good relationship involves concern and sensitivity for each other's feelings.
translation: 一段美满的恋情需要彼此关心并体恤对方的情感。

meaning: adj. 相对的；有关系的；成比例的; n. 亲戚；相关物；[语] 关系词；亲缘植物
example: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
translation: 雇主可以要求出具书面证明，证实员工的亲人确实病了。

meaning: v. 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养
example: Massage is used to relax muscles, relieve stress and improve the circulation.
translation: 按摩可以使肌肉放松，缓解压力和促进血液循环。

meaning: v. 转播；接替; n. [电] 继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马
example: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.
translation: 英国要在接力赛中战胜美国，前景看上去并不那么乐观。

meaning: adj. 相关的；切题的；中肯的；有重大关系的；有意义的，目的明确的
example: We are trying to make politics more relevant to younger people.
translation: 我们试图使政治活动更加贴近年轻人。

meaning: adj. 可靠的；可信赖的; n. 可靠的人
example: Broadcast news was accurate and reliable but deadly dull.
translation: 新闻广播准确可靠但却非常枯燥。

meaning: n. 救济；减轻，解除；安慰；浮雕
example: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n. 宗教；宗教信仰
adj. 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的；修道的; n. 修道士；尼姑
example: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

meaning: v. 依靠；信赖
example: He can rely on my support when the crunch comes.
translation: 关键时刻，他可以依靠我的支持。

meaning: v. 保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存; n. 遗迹；剩余物，残骸
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: n. 注意；言辞; v. 评论；觉察
example: I didn't mean any offence. It was a flippant, off-the-cuff remark.
translation: 我本无意冒犯，那不过是句脱口而出的冒失话。

meaning: v. 记得；牢记；纪念；代…问好
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: v. 提醒；使想起
example: remind of
translation: 提醒；使记起；使回想起

meaning: adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的; n. 远程
example: Statistically our chances of being the victims of violent crime are remote.
translation: 从统计数据来看，我们成为暴力犯罪受害者的可能性微乎其微。

meaning: v. 移动，迁移；开除；调动; n. 移动；距离；搬家
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n. 租金; v. 出租；租用；租借
example: They actually moved down from upstairs because the rent's that expensive.
translation: 他们确实从楼上搬到了楼下，因为房租太贵了。

meaning: v. 修理；修复; n. 修理，修补；修补部位
example: If you are not happy about a repair, go back and complain.
translation: 如果你对修理效果不满意，可以再找他们投诉。

meaning: n. 修理；[会计] 修理费；备件；修理工作（repair的复数形式）; v. 修理；恢复（repair的三单形式）；弥补；纠正
example: maintenance and repair
translation: 保养和修理

meaning: v. 重复；复制；背诵; n. 重复；副本
example: Nearly 60% of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
translation: 我们近60%的订单来自于回头客和熟人介绍。

meaning: v. 取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处
example: Who do you suppose will replace her on the show?
translation: 你觉得谁会代替她参加这场演出？

meaning: v. 回答；[法] 答辩；回击; n. 回答；[法] 答辩
example: He said in reply that the question was unfair.
translation: 他回答说这个问题不公平。

meaning: n. 报告；报道；成绩单; v. 报告；报导；使报到
example: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
translation: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

meaning: n. 记者
example: She was a TV reporter and worked long hours.
translation: 她是个电视台记者，总是工作到很晚。

meaning: v. 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送
example: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.
translation: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。

meaning: adj. 典型的，有代表性的；代议制的; n. 代表；典型；众议员
example: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
translation: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

meaning: n. 共和国；共和政体
example: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

meaning: n. 名声，名誉；声望
example: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
translation: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

meaning: n. 请求；需要; v. 要求，请求
example: request for
translation: 要求；对…有请求

meaning: v. 需要；要求；命令
example: Today's complex buildings require close teamwork between the architect and the builders.
translation: 如今的建筑结构复杂，需要建筑师和施工人员密切协作。

meaning: n. 要求；必要条件；必需品
example: The requirement for work permits violates the spirit of the 1950 treaty.
translation: 对工作许可证的要求违反了1950年条约的精神。

meaning: v. 营救；援救; n. 营救；援救；解救
example: Lights clipped onto life jackets improve the chances of rescue.
translation: 别在救生衣上的灯提高了获救可能性。

meaning: n. 研究；调查; v. 研究；调查
example: Research and technology are said to be chronically underfunded.
translation: 据说为研究和技术方面提供的经费严重不足。

meaning: v. 类似，像
example: Did it resemble the earth when this was destitute of an atmosphere?
translation: 它同地球上还没有大气的时候一样 吗 ?

meaning: n. 预约，预订；保留
example: After three days, the strikers' demands were met almost without reservation.
translation: 3天以后，罢工人员的要求几乎全部得到了满足。

meaning: n. 储备，储存；自然保护区；预备队；缄默；[金融] 储备金; v. 储备；保留；预约
v. 辞职；放弃；委托；使听从; n. 辞去职务
example: He was under pressure to resign and was about to be sidelined.
translation: 他承受着被迫辞职的压力，很快就要被排挤出去了。

meaning: v. 抵抗，抗拒；忍耐; n. [助剂] 抗蚀剂；防染剂
example: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
translation: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

meaning: n. 尊敬，尊重；方面；敬意; v. 尊敬，尊重；遵守
example: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
translation: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

meaning: v. 回答；作出反应；承担责任; n. 应答；唱和
example: Some cases of arthritis respond to a gluten-free diet.
translation: 无麸质饮食对一些关节炎患者有疗效。

meaning: n. 责任，职责；义务
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: v. 使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于; n. 休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

meaning: n. 餐馆；[经] 饭店
example: He insisted we stop at a small restaurant just outside of Atlanta.
translation: 他坚持让我们在亚特兰大市外不远的一家小餐馆歇歇脚。

meaning: v. 限制；约束；限定
example: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
translation: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。

meaning: n. 限制；约束；束缚
n. 结果；成绩；答案；比赛结果; v. 结果；导致；产生
example: The result reflects a modest rightward shift in opinion.
translation: 结果显示舆论出现一定程度的右倾。

meaning: v. 复述；再讲；重述
example: Lucilla often asks her sisters to retell the story.
translation: 露西拉经常要姐姐们把这个故事反复讲给她听。

meaning: v. 退休；撤退；退却; n. 退休；退隐；退兵信号
example: If they prove ineffective they should be demoted or asked to retire.
translation: 如果事实证明他们已无力胜任，应该将他们降级或让他们退休。

meaning: v. 返回；报答; n. 返回；归还；回球; adj. 报答的；回程的；返回的
example: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
translation: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

meaning: n. 重新使用，再用; v. 再使用
example: Copper, brass and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.
translation: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以进行再利用。

meaning: n. 回顾；复习；评论；检讨；检阅; v. 回顾；检查；复审
example: The White House quickly announced that the policy is under review.
translation: 白宫很快宣布该项政策正在审核中。

meaning: n. 评论者，评论家
example: The reviewer mercilessly took apart the young writer's first novel.
translation: 评论家把这位年轻作者的第一部小说抨击得一无是处.

meaning: n. [印刷] 修正；复习；修订本
example: She was doing some last-minute revision for her exams.
translation: 她在为考试进行最后的复习。

meaning: n. 革命；旋转；运行；循环
example: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
translation: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

meaning: n. [劳经] 报酬；报答；酬谢; v. [劳经] 奖励；奖赏
example: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
translation: 现行雇佣法要变，要奖勤罚懒。

meaning: n. 重绕；倒带器; v. 倒回；重绕
example: Press the rewind button.
translation: 按下倒带键。

meaning: v. 改写；重写; n. 重写或改写的文稿；改写的作品
example: Kournikova is poised to rewrite the tennis history books.
translation: 库尔尼科娃决心改写网球史。

meaning: n. 韵律；韵脚；韵文；押韵词; v. 使押韵；用韵诗表达；把…写作诗
example: All of the poems are written in traditional metres and rhyme schemes.
translation: 所有的诗都按传统的韵律和韵脚而作。

meaning: n. 稻；米饭; v. 把…捣成米糊状
example: Under these laws, he said, Mr. Rice's assets could have been frozen.
translation: 他说根据这些法规，赖斯先生的资产可能已经被冻结了。

meaning: adj. 富有的；肥沃的；昂贵的; n. (Rich)人名；(丹)里克；(捷)里赫；(英、西)里奇；(葡、法)里什
example: He hoped to strike it rich by investing in ginseng.
translation: 他希望通过投资人参发大财。

meaning: v. 使摆脱；使去掉; n. (Rid)人名；(英)里德
example: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption.
translation: 这些提议试图使这个国家摆脱政治腐败。

meaning: v. 解谜；给出谜；充满于; n. 谜语；粗筛；谜一般的人、东西、事情等
example: He was on a caravanning holiday.
translation: 他驾房车外出游玩去了。

meaning: v. 骑马；乘车；依靠；漂浮; n. 骑；乘坐；交通工具；可供骑行的路；（乘坐汽车等的）旅行；乘骑；（乘车或骑车的）短途旅程；供乘骑的游乐设施
example: If you want a cheap ride, take a minicab.
translation: 要想出行便宜，就坐小型出租车吧。

meaning: adj. 可笑的；荒谬的
example: The deal seems so attractive it would be ridiculous to say no.
translation: 这笔交易看上去太诱人了，要是拒绝它简直是笑话。

meaning: adj. 正确的；直接的；右方的; v. 复正；恢复平稳; n. 正确；右边；正义; adv. 正确地；恰当地；彻底地
example: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
translation: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

meaning: adj. 严格的；僵硬的，死板的；坚硬的；精确的
example: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

meaning: v. 按铃；敲钟；回响；成环形; n. 戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物
example: If you'd like more information, ring the Hotline on 414 3929.
translation: 如果想了解更多信息，请拨打热线电话4143929。

meaning: adj. 熟的，成熟的；时机成熟的; vt. 搜查；调查; vi. 进行搜查; n. (Ripe)人名；(意、瑞典)里佩
example: The conditions are ripe for the spread of disease.
translation: 这种疾病传播的条件已经成熟。

meaning: v. 使成熟
example: This helps to ripen new growth and makes it flower profusely.
translation: 这有助于新生发植株的成熟，令其开出繁茂的花朵。

meaning: v. 上升；增强；起立；高耸; n. 上升；高地；增加；出现
example: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
translation: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

meaning: n. 风险；危险；冒险; v. 冒…的危险
example: I'm a blood donor; I can't risk any contagion.
translation: 我是献血者，我不能冒任何接触传染的危险。

meaning: n. 河，江
example: The river widens considerably as it begins to turn east.
translation: 河流转向东流时河道大幅度变宽。

meaning: n. 公路，马路；道路；手段; vt. （狗）沿臭迹追逐（猎物）; adj. （美）巡回的
example: on the road
translation: 在旅途中；到处奔走

meaning: v. 烤，焙；烘，烘烤；暴露于某种热力下以得温暖; adj. 烘烤的；烤过的; n. 烤肉；烘烤
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: v. 抢劫；使…丧失；非法剥夺
example: They rob us, they infringe our rights, they kill us.
translation: 他们劫掠我们，侵犯我们的权利，对我们实施杀戮。

meaning: n. 机器人；遥控设备，自动机械；机械般工作的人
example: They have docked a robot module alongside the orbiting space station.
translation: 他们已经将一个自动操作舱与沿轨道运行的空间站并行对接上了。

meaning: n. 岩石；摇滚乐；暗礁; v. 摇动；使摇晃
example: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
translation: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

meaning: v. 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加; n. 火箭
example: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
translation: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

meaning: n. 角色；任务
example: The Prime Minister has promised that Israel will play a constructive role.
translation: 首相承诺以色列将发挥积极的作用。

meaning: v. 卷；滚动，转动；辗; n. 卷，卷形物；名单；摇晃
example: The brothers usually roll into their studio around midday.
translation: 兄弟几个总是要到正午前后才姗姗来到工作室。

meaning: n. [机] 滚筒；[机] 滚轴；辊子；滚转机
example: A boy of about ten came up on roller-skates.
translation: 一个10岁左右、脚蹬旱冰鞋的男孩滑了过来。

meaning: n. 屋顶；最高处，顶部；最高限度; v. 给…盖屋顶，覆盖
example: There is a wide veranda under the overhang of the roof.
translation: 悬吊的屋顶下是一条宽阔的游廊。

meaning: n. 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人; v. 为…提供住处；租房，合住；投宿，住宿；留…住宿
example: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
translation: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

meaning: n. 公鸡；狂妄自负的人
example: The rooster chased me across the dirt floor of the barn.
translation: 公鸡追着我跑过谷仓的泥土地面。

meaning: n. 根；根源；词根；祖先; v. 生根；根除
example: Her ankle caught on a root, and she almost lost her balance.
translation: 她的脚踝被树根绊了一下，差点摔倒。

meaning: n. 绳，绳索; v. 捆，绑
example: They skip rope and play catch, waiting for the bell.
translation: 他们又是跳绳，又是玩接球，等着上课铃声响起。

meaning: n. 玫瑰；粉红色；蔷薇（花）；粉红色的葡萄酒; adj. 玫瑰花的；玫瑰色的；粉红色的；带有玫瑰香味的; vt. 使成玫瑰色，使（面颊）发红；使有玫瑰香味; vi. 起义( rise的过去式)；升起；（数量）增加；休会
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.

translation: 15岁的丹尼从地方当局的收容所逃跑了。

meaning: n.  生物； 动物
example: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
translation: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

meaning: adj.  好交际的， 外向的； 即将离职的
example: She arrived to receive the sash of office from the outgoing president.
translation: 她走上前去从即将离职的总统手中接过了就职腰带。

meaning: adj.  无滋味的
n&vt.  伤害， 损伤
example: Nudism, the council decided, was doing the resort more harm than good.
translation: 委员会认定在休闲胜地的裸体行为弊大于利。

meaning: n.  乐器； 工具， 器械
example: An instrument called a trocar makes a puncture in the abdominal wall.
translation: 一种叫做套管针的工具在腹壁上刺了一个孔。

meaning: adj. 中间的，中等的; n.   媒介
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: vt.  移动， 拿走； 去除
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: n.  智慧
example: They might be wise to stop advertising on television.
translation: 他们不妨停止在电视上做广告，这样做可能是明智之举。

meaning: n.  饥饿； 饿死
example: The animals were left to starve to death.
translation: 那些动物只能等着饿死。

meaning: adv.  任何地方都不； 无处
example: These rootless young people have nowhere else to go.
translation: 这些漂泊不定的年轻人没有其他地方可去。

meaning: n.  心理学
example: Abraham Maslow described psychology as "the science of being."
translation: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛形容心理学是“存在的科学”。

meaning: v.  摔跤， 格斗； 斟酌
example: The wrestler tripped up his opponent.
translation: 那个摔跤运动员把对手绊倒在地.

meaning: n.  金银财宝， 财富
example: Hon Treasurer: D Shrimpton
translation: 名誉司库：D.施林普顿

meaning: v.    相乘； 增加
example: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12.
translation: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。

meaning: vi. 生活，居住; adj.  活的； 直播的; vt. 过着，经历
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: n.  赞成； 认可； 批准
example: A reformed party would have to win the approval of the people.
translation: 一个革新的政党需要赢得人民的认可。

meaning: n.  [C] 胜利
example: victory over
translation: 战胜

meaning: adj.  活动的， 可移动的
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
translation: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

meaning: v.  表演， 表现； 履行
example: He can perform an astonishing variety of acts, including mime and juggling.
translation: 他能表演好几种令人惊叹的把戏，包括哑剧和玩杂耍。

meaning: n.  进展， 演变， 进化
example: the evolution of the human species
translation: 人类的进化

meaning: vt.  暴露； 揭露
example: When Myra told Karp she'd expose his past, he blew up.
translation: 当迈拉告诉卡普她会把他的过去全抖搂出去时，卡普大为光火。

meaning: v.  集中， 聚集
example: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
translation: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

meaning: n&v.  欢呼， 喝彩
example: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
translation: 士兵对上校报以震天的欢呼声。

meaning: prep.  与， 伴随； 有， 以
example: This is the weapon that he used to defend himself withal.
translation: 这就是他用来自卫的武器.

meaning: adv.  在那里; int. 那！你瞧！
example: He lives in Beijing or thereabout ( s ).
translation: 他住北京一带.

meaning: v. 许可，允许; n.  许可证， 执照
example: He can let the court's decision stand and permit the execution.
translation: 他有权维持法庭判决，批准死刑生效。

meaning: adv. 好，充分地; adj. 健康的; int. 好吧; n.  井
example: as well
translation: 也；同样地；还不如

meaning: adj.  合适的， 适宜的
example: There are problems in recruiting suitably qualified scientific officers for NHS laboratories.
translation: 很难为国民医疗保健系统的实验室招募到资历合适的高级科研人员。

meaning: n.  人员， 职员
example: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
translation: 我在人事档案里找到了你的地址。

meaning: adj.  没有希望的； 不可救药的
example: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless.
translation: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。

meaning: n.  高速公路
example: Governor Deukmejian called for an inquiry into the freeway's collapse.
translation: 德克梅吉恩州长要求对高速公路塌陷事件进行调查.

meaning: n.  喷泉； 源泉
example: Snape wrote a receipt with a gold fountain pen.
translation: 斯内普用金笔开了一张收据。

meaning: v. 堆积，积累; n.  堆
example: On the table beside an empty plate was a pile of books.
translation: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

meaning: n.  海峡； 频道； 通道
example: The series goes out at 10.30pm, Fridays, on Channel 4.
translation: 这部连续剧每周五晚上10点30分在第4频道播出。

meaning: adj.  晒黑的， 晒伤的
example: She designed a huge sunburst window.
translation: 她设计了一个巨大的旭日东升形窗户。

meaning: v. 聚焦，集中; n.  中心， 焦点
example: In the background, in soft focus, we see his smiling wife.
translation: 在背景部分，我们可以看到他妻子面带微笑的蒙影像。

meaning: adj.  整个的， 全部的
example: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.
translation: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。

meaning: v.  接近， 靠近; n. 方式，方法
example: We have a very communicative approach to teaching languages.
translation: 我们在语言教学中非常强调交际教学法。

meaning: n.  手腕， 腕关节
example: He has to wear a security wristband and be under constant supervision.
translation: 他必须戴着监控手环并且实时监控.

meaning: n.  实验
example: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
translation: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

meaning: adj.  猛烈的， 激烈的
example: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months.
translation: 这一地区3个月以来不断发生激战。

meaning: n.   预订； 预约
example: After three days, the strikers' demands were met almost without reservation.
translation: 3天以后，罢工人员的要求几乎全部得到了满足。

meaning: n. 电子邮件; vt.  给…发电子邮件
example: e-mail address
translation: 电子邮件地址

meaning: vt. 恨，讨厌，不喜欢; n.  怨恨
example: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
translation: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

meaning: v.  阻塞， 阻挡; n. 大块；街区
example: A block up the street I found a parking lot.
translation: 沿着街道往北过了一个街区，我找到了一个停车场。

meaning: v.   写
example: She has a first-class brain and is a damned good writer.
translation: 她头脑相当灵光，是个非常棒的作家。

meaning: n.  宠物， 爱畜
example: They would sell the meat off as pet food.
translation: 他们将把肉当作宠物食品卖掉。

meaning: v. 流动; n.  流， 流动
example: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
translation: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

meaning: n. 顺序；命令; vt.  命令； 点菜； 订货
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: n.  工资， 报酬
example: A wager is a fool's argument.
translation: 傻瓜一争论就打赌.

meaning: n.  时期， 时代
example: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

meaning: adj. 音乐的，爱好音乐的; n.  音乐剧
example: London's musical life might become as exciting as Berlin's.
translation: 伦敦的音乐生活可能会变得像柏林的一样令人兴奋。

meaning: n.  团体； 公司， 企业
example: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
translation: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

meaning: adj.  远的， 遥远的
example: From somewhere distant he heard the clatter of a typewriter.
translation: 他听见从远处什么地方传来打字机的嗒嗒声。

meaning: v.   懂得， 理解
example: Understandability: User's effort for recognizing the logical concept and its applicability.
translation: 易懂性: 用户通晓逻辑概念花费的人力和软件的适用性.

meaning: v.  解雇； 解散
example: The Prime Minister has the power to dismiss and appoint senior ministers.
translation: 首相有权任免高级部长。

meaning: n.  智力， 聪明
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: v.  改革， 革新; n. 改革；改善
example: The government wanted to reform the institutions, to shake up the country.
translation: 政府想要实施机构改革，整顿国家。

meaning: adv.  曾经； 无论何时
example: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

meaning: adv. 甚至，更加，还要; adj.  平坦的
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n.  限制
adj.  疯狂的
example: "That's crazy," I said. "Isn't it just?" he said.
translation: “那简直是疯了，”我说。“谁说不是呢？”他说。

meaning: n.  剃须刀
example: The camp is surrounded by razor-wire fences and guarded by military police.
translation: 营地周围架着尖利的铁丝网，且有宪兵看守。

meaning: v. 指导，训练; n.  教练； 马车； 长途车
example: head coach
translation: 主教练；总教练

meaning: n.  冠军， 优胜者
example: The heavyweight champion will be given a shot at Holyfield's world title.
translation: 这名重量级拳击冠军将尝试挑战霍利菲尔德的世界冠军头衔。

meaning: v. 等待; n.  等待， 等候
example: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

meaning: n.  电路
example: He was just starting to become known on the cabaret circuit.
translation: 他在卡巴莱歌舞表演圈中刚刚开始有点名气。

meaning: n.   品脱； 一品脱啤酒
example: Give Roger another pint, Imogen, and I'll have the same again.
translation: 再给罗杰来一杯，伊莫金，我也再来一份同样的。

meaning: vi.  要紧， 有重大关系; n. 事情，物质；原因
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: adj. 立即的；速食的; n.  瞬间
example: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
translation: 与此同时，他猛地推开了车门。

meaning: n.  个性化
n.  电动剃须刀
example: electric shaver
translation: 电动刮胡刀；电动剃须刀

meaning: n.  顶部； 上面
example: on top
translation: 在上面；领先；成功

meaning: adj.  本土的， 本国的
example: We were forbidden, under pain of imprisonment, to use our native language.
translation: 我们被禁止使用母语，违者将被关进监狱。

meaning: adv.  也； 又； 太； 很
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: v.  帮助构成完成时态; vt. 有，使，令
example: You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest. And if you do, if you stay positive, then you have a shot at a silver lining.
translation: 你需要尽你所能，最大限度地去努力。只要你这么做，只要你能保持乐观，你就会看见乌云背后的幸福线。

meaning: n.  暴力； 强烈
example: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police.
translation: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

meaning: v.  烤
example: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

meaning: adj.  精力旺盛的
example: We look for applicants who are numerate, computer-literate and energetic self-starters.
translation: 我们对求职者的要求是具备运算能力，熟练使用电脑，精力充沛而且工作积极主动。

meaning: n.  结果， 后果
example: as a consequence
translation: 因此，结果

meaning: n.  加衬芯床罩
example: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.
translation: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。

meaning: adj.  著名的， 出名的
example: The chalky soil around Saumur produces the famous Anjou wines.
translation: 索米尔周围的白垩质土壤出产著名的安茹葡萄酒。

meaning: vt. 询问; n.  问题
example: This brings us to the second question I asked.
translation: 这就将我们带到了我所提的第二个问题。

meaning: n.  醋
example: fruit vinegar
translation: 果醋；水果醋

meaning: n.  精神， 灵魂
n.  总理， 首相
example: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
translation: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

meaning: v.  生产， 制造
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: adj.  过敏的
example: Soya milk can cause allergic reactions in some children.
translation: 有些孩子会对豆浆过敏。

meaning: v. 哄骗，欺骗，骗取; n.  骗子； 诈骗
example: I know it sounds unbelievable but I never wanted to cheat.
translation: 我知道听上去难以置信，但我从不想撒谎。

meaning: n.  框架， 结构
example: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
translation: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

meaning: v. 当做，看待; n.  关心， 注意； 致意
example: with regard to
translation: adv. 关于；至于

meaning: n.  轶事； 趣事
example: He departed from the text to tell an anecdote.
translation: 他偏离课文讲起了一则轶事.

meaning: vt.  禁止， 阻止
example: In most of the residence halls we visited, rules prohibit disorderly conduct.
translation: 在我们走访的学生宿舍里，大多明令禁止胡作非为。

meaning: adv.  几乎， 差不多
example: The representatives almost came to blows at a meeting.
translation: 代表们在一次会议上差点动起手来。

meaning: n.  男乘务员
example: Please show your ticket to the stewardess when you board the plane.
translation: 登机时请向空中小姐出示机票.

meaning: n.  燃料
example: His comments are bound to add fuel to the debate.
translation: 他的话必将为争论推波助澜。

meaning: n. 方式；举止；
example: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
translation: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

meaning: prep.  在…上面
example: A cold is an infection of the upper respiratory tract.
translation: 感冒是上呼吸道的感染。

meaning: vt.   预见， 预知
example: We do not foresee any problems.
translation: 我们预料不会出任何问题。

meaning: adj.  有害的； 致伤的
example: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
translation: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

meaning: v.  结合； 结交
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: v.  祈祷， 祈求
example: We have a beautiful city and we pray it stays that way.
translation: 我们的城市很美丽，但愿它能保持下去。

meaning: v.   醒来， 叫醒
example: And I want to thank Wakefield for being such an outstanding host.
translation: 我还要感谢韦克菲尔德高中出色的组织安排.

meaning: vt. 钉住，别住; n.  别针； 胸针
example: She'd do anything for a bit of pin money.
translation: 为了挣点外快，她什么都肯做。

meaning: adj. 学术的；院校的; n.  大学教师； 学者
example: Henry generally stayed ahead of the others in the academic subjects.
translation: 亨利的文化课成绩通常都优于其他学生。

meaning: conj.  是否
example: The finest edge is made with the blunt whetstone.
translation: 最好(锋利的)刀口是由钝的磨刀石磨成的.

meaning: vi.  起作用； 行使职责; n. 功能，作用，职责；函数
example: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the agency's mission.
translation: 要完成该机构的使命，他的作用至关重要。

meaning: vt.  举起； 提高， 使升高； 饲养， 养育
example: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.
translation: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。

meaning: n.  勺， 匙， 调羹
example: greasy spoon
translation: 低级小饭馆；经济小吃店

meaning: adv.  完全， 十分
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: n.  大腿；  一圈
example: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meaning: n.  矿物质， 矿物
example: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
translation: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

meaning: n.  代表
example: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
translation: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

meaning: n.  恐怖； 可怕的人
example: Anything to terrorise the civilian population.
translation: 任何让平民恐惧的事情都会发生.

meaning: prep.  在…下方， 在…下面
example: The doctor worked busily beneath the blinding lights of the delivery room.
translation: 这位医生在产房刺目的灯光下忙碌着。

meaning: pron.  每人， 人人
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: v.   放， 搁； 产
example: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
translation: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

meaning: v.   交换
example: interest rate swap
translation: 利率互换；利率掉期

meaning: v.   孵蛋
example: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
translation: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

meaning: vt&n.  原谅， 宽恕； 对不起
example: It's enough to make you wet yourself, if you'll pardon the expression.
translation: 这足以吓得你尿裤子了，请原谅我这么说。

meaning: n.  充足， 大量， 丰富
example: There were plenty of servants to wait on her.
translation: 有很多仆人服侍她。

meaning: v.  发出滴答声; n. 钟表的滴答声；记号
example: tick off
translation: 列举；用记号标出

meaning: n.  [C] 基础； 根据； 原则
example: Any action on the basis of such fragmentary evidence would be foolish.
translation: 基于如此不完整的证据采取的任何行动都是愚蠢的。

meaning: n.  冒险； 奇遇
example: They'rewritten as adventure stories. They're not intended to be deep.
translation: 它们是作为历险故事来写的，并没打算追求深刻。

meaning: n.  条件， 状况
example: He was concerned with the enhancement of the human condition.
translation: 他关心人类生存环境的改善。

meaning: v.  改进， 更新

example: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

meaning: n.  方法， 手段
example: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
translation: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

meaning: n.  链， 链条
example: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
translation: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

meaning: n&v.  渴望， 期望
example: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
translation: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

meaning: vi. 幸存，生还; vt.  比…活得长
example: Rafferty was the sole survivor from the successful Ireland team of 1988.
translation: 拉弗蒂是1988年红极一时的爱尔兰队硕果仅存的球员。

meaning: adj.  开始的， 最初的
example: They learnt a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
translation: 他们从最初的市场测试中了解了许多信息。

meaning: adj.  泥泞的，多泥的
example: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
translation: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

meaning: adj.  一致的， 连贯的
example: consistent with
translation: 符合；与…一致

meaning: n.  剑， 刀
example: double-edged sword
translation: 双刃剑（指对双方皆不利的局面，或敌我不分的计谋）；双面刃

meaning: n.  手指甲
example: I have the fingernail clippers.
translation: 我有指甲钳.

meaning: adj.  永久的， 持久的
example: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
translation: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

meaning: vi.  聊天， 闲谈; n. 聊天，闲谈
example: You can chat to other people who are online.
translation: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

meaning: v.  去取来， 去请来
example: The painting is expected to fetch between two and three million pounds.
translation: 预计这幅画将售得两三百万英镑。

meaning: n.  同伴， 伙伴
example: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.
translation: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。

meaning: n.  选择， 抉择
example: Helen's choice of lipstick was a good match for her skin-tone.
translation: 海伦选择的唇膏很适合她的肤色。

meaning: n&vi.  旅行
example: The president traveled by rail to his home town.
translation: 总统坐火车回到了他的家乡。

meaning: n.  文明， 文化
example: I think we can date the decline of Western Civilization quite precisely.
translation: 我认为我们可以相当准确地确定西方文明开始衰落的年代。

meaning: adv. 以前; conj.  在…之前; prep. 在…以前，在…前面
example: The Koran recommends fasting as a penance before pilgrimages.
translation: 《古兰经》劝告人们在朝圣前斋戒，以作为一种补赎。

meaning: n.  小说； 虚构， 杜撰
example: Fiction takes up a large slice of the publishing market.
translation: 小说在出版市场上占了很大的份额。

meaning: adj.  友好的
example: The spokesman said the tone of the letter was very friendly.
translation: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。

meaning: n.  所有， 拥有； 财产， 所有物
example: How had this com-promising picture come into the possession of the press?
translation: 这张令人难堪的照片是怎么落到媒体手中的？

meaning: v.   告诉， 吩咐； 辨别， 知道
example: The murderer was given away by a few tellable bloodstains on his car seat.
translation: 谋杀犯是因汽车座位上留下的几滴血迹露出马脚而被揭发出来.

meaning: vt.  取代， 代替； 把…放回原处
example: Who do you suppose will replace her on the show?
translation: 你觉得谁会代替她参加这场演出？

meaning: n.  约会
example: make an appointment
translation: 约会，预约

meaning: n.  [C] 胃， 胃部
example: Henry got a stomachache and asked to be excused.
translation: 亨利肚子疼请求离开一下.

meaning: vt. 经历，体验; n.  经验； 经历
example: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
translation: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

meaning: vi.  听， 仔细听， 留神听
example: When I asked him to stop, he would not listen.
translation: 我叫他停下，可他不听。

meaning: n&v.   打， 撞； 击中
example: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
translation: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

meaning: adj. 主要的；成年的; n.  主修专业
example: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
translation: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

meaning: v.  打扰， 打断
example: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
translation: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

meaning: v. 打赢；跳动；敲打; n.   节拍
example: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
translation: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

meaning: adj.  遍及全球的， 世界各地的
example: The slow-worm is in fact not a snake but a legless lizard.
translation: 蛇蜥其实不是蛇，而是无脚的蜥蜴。

meaning: v. 承担；忍受; n.  熊
n.  事， 事情
example: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
translation: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

meaning: vt.  考虑； 认为
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: n.  家务劳动
example: I discovered an addiction to housework which I had never felt before.
translation: 我发现自己迷上了做家务，之前我从没有这种感觉。

meaning: adj. 潜在的，可能的; n.  潜力
example: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
translation: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

meaning: adj.  通常的， 习惯的
example: Possibly we are accustomed, biologically speaking, to this background radiation.
translation: 从生物机理上说，我们可能已经习惯了这种本底辐射。

meaning: n.  组， 群
example: I thought I'd enrol you with an art group at the school.
translation: 我想我会吸收你参加学校的一个艺术团。

meaning: n.  〈总称〉 珠宝， 首饰
example: I spend a lot on expensive jewelry and clothing.
translation: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。

meaning: vt.  获得， 得到
example: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
translation: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

meaning: n.  休息厅， 休息室
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: n.  英式橄榄球
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: vt.  抵抗； 挡开
example: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
translation: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

meaning: n.  版式， 格式
example: A new format would alienate its ageing readership without attracting young readers.
translation: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

meaning: n&v.  牺牲， 奉献
example: He was willing to make any sacrifice for peace.
translation: 他愿意为和平作出任何牺牲。

meaning: adj. 特殊的；个别的
example: We are taught to construe these terms in a particular way.
translation: 我们被教导要以特定的方式理解这些词语。

meaning: adj.  违法的， 不合规定的
example: By-laws are to make it illegal to smoke in public.
translation: 地方法规将规定在公共场合抽烟为非法。

meaning: n&vi.  暂停， 停止
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: vt.  祝贺， 恭贺
example: He was generous enough to congratulate his successor on his decision.
translation: 他十分大度地祝贺他的继任者做出了决定。

meaning: adj.  粗心的； 漫不经心的
example: They could not afford to spoil those maps by careless colouring.
translation: 若是上色的时候不小心弄坏了那些地图，他们可承担不起。

meaning: adj.  平方的； 方形的; n. 广场；正方形
example: square oneself
translation: 摆好架势；道歉

meaning: n.  彩虹； 幻想
example: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
translation: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾上照出了一道彩虹。

meaning: adv.  两次； 两倍
example: twice a week
translation: 每周两次

meaning: adj.  充足的， 丰富的
example: The equivalent of two tablespoons of polyunsaturated oils is ample each day.
translation: 每天相当于两大汤匙多重不饱和油的量就足够了。

meaning: n.  高度； 高处
example: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
translation: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

meaning: n&vt.  要求， 请求
example: request for
translation: 要求；对…有请求

meaning: vt.  分类
example: It is necessary initially to classify the headaches into certain types.
translation: 首先，必须将头痛分为几个类型。

meaning: v.  分离， 分别; n. 部分；角色
example: These days work plays an important part in a single woman's life.
translation: 现在，工作在单身女性的生活中起着重要作用。

meaning: n.  百分之…
example: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
translation: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: v. 指，指向; n.  点； 要点， 观点； 分数
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: v.  划桨； 戏水; n. 桨状物；蹼
example: We might be able to push ourselves across with the paddle.
translation: 我们也许可以用桨把自己推过去。

meaning: adj.  大体的， 总的； 一般的； 普遍的
example: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
translation: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

meaning: vi.  趋向， 往往是; vt. 照管，护理
example: tend to be
translation: 倾向于；趋向于

meaning: vt.  使惊恐， 吓唬
example: Fairground rides are intended to frighten the life out of you.
translation: 露天游乐场的飞车就是想把人吓丢了魂儿。

meaning: n.  缓解； 轻松
example: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

meaning: n&vt.  联合抵制
example: Opposition leaders had called for a boycott of the vote.
translation: 反对党领袖已号召人们拒绝投票。

meaning: n.  尺寸， 尺度
example: There was undeniably a strong theoretical dimension to his thinking.
translation: 不可否认，他的思想很有理论深度。

meaning: n. 公园；停车场; vt.  停放
example: The car park was absolutely packed solid with people.
translation: 停车场被人挤得水泄不通。

meaning: adj.  难以置信的
example: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
translation: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

meaning: vt. 加工，处理; n.  程序； 方法
example: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
translation: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

meaning: vt.  应受， 值得
example: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
translation: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

meaning: v.  捐赠； 订阅
example: I have been a subscriber to Railway Magazine for many years.
translation: 我订阅《铁路杂志》已有很多年了。

meaning: adj.  清晰的； 明亮的； 清楚的
example: It was clear Cohen didn't understand what Millard was driving at.
translation: 看得出科恩并不明白米勒德想说什么。

meaning: n.  厨师
example: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
translation: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

meaning: adj.  选择性的， 二者择一的
example: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
translation: 关节炎的新疗法可能是止痛药之外的另一种选择。

meaning: v.  突然扩大， 使猛增
example: zoom in
translation: v. 放大

meaning: n.  同事
example: He was fired from his job after roughing up a colleague.
translation: 他因为对一位同事动粗而被开除了。

meaning: n.  钻石， 金刚石； 菱形
example: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
translation: 钻石切割靠的是工匠的技艺。

meaning: pron.  某人； 重要人物
example: Maybe if we could go someplace together, just you and I.
translation: 也许我们可以一起去某个地方，就我和你。

meaning: v. 建造; n.  构造
example: If you build more plastics into cars, the car lasts longer.
translation: 如果汽车采用更多塑料元件，寿命会更长一些。

meaning: v.   意味着， 意思是
example: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meaning: vi.  赞成； 满意; vt. 批准，通过
example: The council is considering whether to approve of the use of firearms.
translation: 政务委员会正在考虑是否要批准动用武器。

meaning: determiner. 两者都不（的），两者中无一（的）; adv. 也不
example: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
translation: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

meaning: vt.  挣得， 赚得
example: Ray will earn his keep on local farms while studying.
translation: 雷求学期间会在当地的农场干活赚取生活费。

meaning: adj.  高兴的， 乐意的
example: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

meaning: v.  咀嚼
example: He tends to chew things over too much in his mind.
translation: 他这个人就爱在心里反复琢磨事儿。

meaning: n.  步行者， 行人
example: The lorry driver escaped unhurt, but a pedestrian was injured.
translation: 卡车司机安然脱险，但有一位行人受了伤。

meaning: v. 赶快；急忙; n.  匆忙， 仓促
example: Dave was in a hurry to get back to work.
translation: 戴夫急于回到工作岗位。

meaning: v.  总计有； 认为; n. 账目；描述
example: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.
translation: 你必须将该处房产的资本增值考虑在内。

meaning: vt.  忍受， 容忍
example: In 1741 Catherine the Great issued an edict of toleration for Buddhism.
translation: 1741年，叶卡捷琳娜大帝颁布法令，允许佛教的存在。

meaning: adj.  放射性的
example: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
translation: 废料被安全储存起来，直到其不再有辐射性。

meaning: vt.  在…下面划线； 强调
adj.  清白的， 无罪的； 纯真的
example: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
translation: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

meaning: n.  筷子
example: He's not very skilful with his chopsticks [ at using chopsticks ] .
translation: 他用 筷子 不大熟练.

meaning: n.  字母表
example: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first.
translation: 如果把所有的元音列在前面，字母表可能会更为合理一些。

meaning: adj.  暧昧的； 不明确的
example: The manifesto is long-winded, repetitious and often ambiguous or poorly drafted.
translation: 这份声明冗长繁复，多处存在歧义或行文拙劣。

meaning: v&n.  推进， 前进
example: It is a good idea to place your order well in advance.
translation: 早早就提前下单是个好主意。

meaning: n.  [C] 旅行， 旅程
example: on a trip
translation: 在旅途中

meaning: adj.  植物学的， 植物的
example: His discovery was hailed as the botanical find of the century.
translation: 他的发现被誉为本世纪植物学的最重大发现。

meaning: vt.  欣赏； 感激
example: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
translation: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

meaning: v.  录制， 记录; n.  记录； 唱片
example: Exports in June rose 1.5% to a record $30.91 billion.
translation: 6月份的出口额上升了1.5%，创下309.1亿美元的历史最高纪录。

meaning: adj.  不同的， 多种多样的
example: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

meaning: n.  立方体， 立方
example: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly.
translation: 她吸了块冰块到嘴里，嘎嘣嘎嘣地大声嚼着。

meaning: adj.  严格的， 严密的
example: strict control
translation: 严格控制

meaning: v.  跳跃； 惊起； 猛扑; n. [C]跳跃
example: His team-mates opened hotel windows, shouting "Jump!" and somewhat less printable banter.
translation: 他的队友打开了酒店的窗户，大叫着“跳！”，还开了一些上不了台面的玩笑。

meaning: n.  知识， 学问
example: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
translation: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

meaning: v.   发生， 碰巧
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: v.  传递； 经过
example: They will not allow your more way-out ideas to pass unchallenged.
translation: 他们不会放过你这些古怪的念头的。

meaning: adj. 过去的，最近的; prep.  经过； 晚于; n. 过去，往事
example: I must have driven past that place thousands of times.
translation: 我得有上千次开车经过那里。

meaning: n.  节日
example: The Jamaica Festival is planning a series of workshops and business seminars.
translation: 牙买加节正在筹划一系列研习班和商务研讨会。

meaning: vt. 使震惊; n.  震动， 冲击
example: She was taken to hospital, apparently amnesiac and shocked.
translation: 她被送往医院，好像是受了惊吓出现了失忆。

meaning: adj.  高兴的， 快乐的
example: "You must come to Tinsley's graduation party." — "I'd be delighted."
translation: “你一定要来参加廷斯利的毕业聚会。”——“我很乐意。”

meaning: n.  薄煎饼
example: I started with the Viennese speciality frittatensuppe, or pancake soup.
translation: 我吃的第一道菜是维也纳特色菜鸡蛋饼汤，也叫炒饼汤。

meaning: adj.  积极的， 主动的
example: In April 1944 he was killed on active service.
translation: 1944年4月他在战时服役中阵亡。

meaning: n.  钞票； 账单； 法案， 议案
example: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

meaning: pron.  不论哪个
n.  法庭， 法院； 球场
pron&conj.  谁的
n.  桶； 铲斗
example: They didn't exactly sell bucket-loads of records the first time around.
translation: 其实，他们第一次唱片卖得并不很多。

meaning: adj. 年长的，资深的；高年级的; n.  上级， 长辈； 高年级学生
example: He has said he will fire editorial employees without regard to seniority.
translation: 他说过不管资历如何，任何编辑人员他都有可能解雇。

meaning: adj.  柔软的， 灵活的
example: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
translation: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

meaning: adj.  相对的； 比较的; n. 亲属，亲戚
example: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
translation: 雇主可以要求出具书面证明，证实员工的亲人确实病了。

meaning: n.  态度； 看法
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: n.  器官
example: The patient'simmune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
translation: 病人的免疫系统会对移植器官产生异质排斥反应。

meaning: adj. 平均的；普通的; n.  平均数
