translation: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

meaning: v. 目击，作证; n.  证人， 目击者
example: Mr. De Witt was the first to recover the power of speech.
translation: 最先恢复说话本能的是德韦特先生.

meaning: adj.  惯例的， 传统的； 常规的
example: He hates the wheeling and dealing associated with conventional political life.
translation: 他对传统政治生活中的权术钻营深恶痛绝。

meaning: n.  规则， 规章
example: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.
translation: 结果证明对鲑鱼饲养行业的管理不够完善。

meaning: adj.  预期的； 约定的
example: Council members are due to have informal discussions later on today.
translation: 委员会成员定于今日晚些时候进行非正式讨论。

meaning: v.   成熟
example: This helps to ripen new growth and makes it flower profusely.
translation: 这有助于新生发植株的成熟，令其开出繁茂的花朵。

meaning: v.  迷惑， 困扰; n. 难题；谜
example: A rather neat option allows you to design your own fiendish puzzle.
translation: 只要干净利落地做一个选择，你就能自己设计出难以解开的谜题。

meaning: adj.  明显的， 显然的
example: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
translation: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

meaning: n. 住处；工作场所
example: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
translation: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

meaning: adj.  真的， 可信的
example: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.
translation: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。

meaning: n.  插座， 插孔； 孔， 穴
example: eye socket
translation: 眼窝；眼眶

meaning: n.  饼干
example: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
translation: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。

meaning: n.  栅栏， 篱笆
example: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
translation: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

meaning: n.  胸部； 胸怀
example: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
translation: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

meaning: n.  怜悯
example: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

meaning: vt.  使烦恼， 使生气； 骚扰
example: As the years went by his nastiness began to annoy his readers.
translation: 年深日久，他恶毒的文字开始让读者生厌。

meaning: v.  通知， 告诉
example: Teachers inform me that Tracey's behaviour has improved no end.
translation: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

meaning: vi.  依靠， 指望； 取决于
example: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
translation: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

meaning: v.   犯  ， 干
example: He should not commit American troops without the full consent of Congress.
translation: 没有国会的完全同意，他不应该调遣美国军队。

meaning: adv. 大约；到处，周围; prep.  关于； 在附近， 在周围
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: v. 尖叫，尖声喊叫; n.  尖叫
example: She is not SCREAMER or MOANER - She is VOCALLY APPRECIATIVE.
translation: 她并不乱叫或发牢骚,只是用声音表示喜怒.

meaning: n.  悲伤， 悲痛
example: Roy told his sorrowful tale with simple words anybody could understand.
translation: 罗伊用简单的、人人都能理解的语言讲述了他那个伤感的故事。

meaning: n&v.  治疗， 医好
example: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
translation: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

meaning: n.  危险
example: Subconsciously I had known that I would not be in personal danger.
translation: 我潜意识里已经知道我不会有人身危险。

meaning: v&n.  碰撞； 坠毁
example: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.
translation: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。

meaning: n. 盖子；罩；封面; vt.  覆盖； 掩盖； 包括； 报道
example: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.
translation: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。

meaning: adj.  坚固的； 坚定的; n. 公司，企业
example: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

meaning: n.  字符； 性格
example: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.
translation: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。

meaning: vt.  反射， 反映
example: Does such an attitudinal change reflect real experiences in daily life?
translation: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实遭遇？

meaning: n.  贡献； 捐款
example: His contribution is immeasurable.
translation: 他居功至伟。

meaning: adv.  在上面; adj. 上面的，上述的；上文的; prep. 在…上面，在…上方；多于，大于
example: That big high-rise above us is where Brian lives.
translation: 我们上面的那座摩天大楼就是布赖恩住的地方。

meaning: n. 火，火灾; vt.  点火； 射击； 解雇
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: v. 黏住；坚持; n.  木棒， 木棍
example: They watched the stickball game the kids were having.
translation: 他们在看小孩子们玩儿童棒球.

meaning: n.   运行轨道
example: The planet is probably in orbit around a small star.
translation: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。

meaning: n.  乐队； 带子； 镶边
example: My underskirt had ridden up into a thick band around my hips.
translation: 我的衬裙已经蹿到臀部，厚厚地卷成一圈。

meaning: n.  高， 高度
example: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.
translation: 突然上升的高度让她晕头转向，她抓得紧紧的。

meaning: v.  喷洒; n. 水雾，喷雾
example: spray drying
translation: 喷雾干燥

meaning: v.  区分， 辨别
example: It is common to distinguish between personal and social ethics.
translation: 个人道德准则和社会道德准则常常不一致。

meaning: adj.  外部的
example: There is room for infill between the new outer suburbs.
translation: 在新建的远郊住宅区之间还有空地可以盖房。

meaning: vt.  发明， 创造
example: His father had helped invent a whole new way of doing business.
translation: 他父亲帮助创造了一套全新的生意经。

meaning: adj.  流利的， 流畅的
example: He is a fluent speaker of Hebrew.
translation: 他说一口流利的希伯来语。

meaning: adj.  极好的
example: Wonderfully melodic and tuneful, his songs have made me weep.
translation: 他的歌旋律优美、悦耳动听，让我潸然泪下。

meaning: n.  [C] 缺点， 短处
example: Fame can be a shortcut to love and money.
translation: 有了名气就容易收获爱情和金钱。

meaning: n.   理发
example: Now politics is all about the right haircut and a sharp suit.
translation: 现在政界讲究的无非是合适的发型和时髦的衣着。

meaning: v.  嚎叫， 嚎哭
example: Traditionalists may howl, but in today's world, cultural relativism rules.
translation: 传统卫道士们也许会叫嚣反对，但在当今世界，文化相对论确实是占据着统治地位。

meaning: pron.  某事； 某物
example: I told you, man! It'll be sometime after eight o'clock.
translation: 老兄，我告诉过你了，时间是八点以后。

meaning: n. 利益，好处; vt.  使受益
example: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements.
translation: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。

meaning: v.  淹没， 泛滥; n. 洪水
example: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
translation: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

meaning: n.  质量； 品质
example: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

meaning: n.  计划， 意图， 目的
example: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
translation: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

meaning: n.  岗；  亭或小隔间
example: Booth was a revivalist intent on his Christian vocation.
translation: 布思是一个坚定不移地奉行其基督徒天职的宗教复兴运动者。

meaning: adj.  无礼的， 粗鲁的， 粗暴的
example: Rude taxi drivers clocked up a total of 239 offences in 1990.
translation: 1990年，出租车司机鲁莽驾驶导致的违章事件总共达239起。

meaning: adj.  热心的， 热情的
example: Bob Dole seemed less than enthusiastic about the proposed move.
translation: 鲍勃·多尔似乎对提议的这项行动不太感兴趣。

meaning: n.  症状
n.  葬礼
example: Most of those attending the funeral stood silently showing little emotion.
translation: 出席葬礼的人大多都面无表情地静静站着。

meaning: adj.  唯一的， 独特的
example: Bead-work, applique and embroidery add a uniquely feminine touch.
translation: 珠饰、嵌花和刺绣可增添一种独特的女人味。

meaning: prep.  除…之外
example: He hadn't eaten a thing except for one forkful of salad.
translation: 除了一餐叉色拉，他什么都没吃。

meaning: n.   部门
example: The Ministry desperately tried to hush up the whole affair.
translation: 部里拼命想隐瞒整个事件。

meaning: adj.  宗教的； 虔诚的
example: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

meaning: n.  掩蔽； 隐蔽处
example: The shelterbelt kept the sand in check.
translation: 防护林带挡住了风沙.

meaning: n.  事实， 现实
v.  检查， 诊察
example: I'll start with some generalities and then examine a few specific examples.
translation: 我首先进行概述，然后会分析几个实例。

meaning: v.   细看； 浏览； 扫描
example: His government began to unravel because of a banking scandal.
translation: 他的政府由于一起金融丑闻而开始瓦解。

meaning: adj.  基础的， 基本的
example: Amnesty says there are fundamental flaws in their military justice system.
translation: 国际特赦组织称他们的军事司法体系存在着根本性的缺陷。

meaning: n.  联合； 联盟； 结交， 交往； 协会
example: The support of our members is of great importance to the Association.
translation: 会员的支持对于我们协会来说非常重要。

meaning: vt.  相信； 认为
example: I believe he is most painfully anxious about Diana.
translation: 我相信他肯定非常担心黛安娜。

meaning: v.  记得； 纪念
example: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
translation: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

meaning: n. 大纲，轮廓；要点，概要; vt.  描绘轮廓； 略述
example: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.
translation: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。

meaning: v.  褪色； 使消退； 枯萎
conj.  如果不， 除非
example: In spite of the treatment he received his loyalty was unlessened.
translation: 他虽然受到那种待遇,他的忠仁却始终如一.

meaning: v&n.  扫视， 匆匆一看
example: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
translation: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

meaning: adj.  自由的， 空闲的； 免费的
example: I wasn't expecting you to do it for free.
translation: 我并没有指望你白干。

meaning: n.  平等， 同等， 均等
example: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
translation: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

meaning: v.  混合， 搅拌
example: Stewart has developed a tendency to mix it verbally with the opposition.
translation: 斯图尔特现在变得只要和别人意见不合，就准备大吵一架。

meaning: aux. 应该，应当；大概; vi. 应该，应当；大概
example: The money to build the power station ought to have been sufficient.
translation: 建设电站的资金本该足够了。

meaning: n.  听写
example: She is transcribing, from his dictation, the diaries of Simon Forman.
translation: 她正根据他的口述记录西蒙·福曼的日记。

meaning: n.  蜡笔； 蜡笔画
example: The mother sponged crayon marks off.
translation: 母亲用湿海绵擦去了痕迹.

meaning: vt. 尊敬，给予荣誉; n.  荣誉， 光荣
example: I impressed on him what a huge honour he was being offered.
translation: 我让他铭记他当时被授予了多么大的荣誉。

meaning: vt.  烦扰， 打扰
example: Mr Brooke is undoubtedly in a spot of bother.
translation: 布鲁克先生肯定遇到了点小麻烦。

meaning: n.  表情； 表达法， 表达方式
example: gene expression
translation: [化]基因表达；基因表现

meaning: adj.  中部的， 中间的， 中级的; n. 中间，当中
example: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
translation: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

meaning: n.  幼年时代， 童年
example: His parents' obsession with keeping up appearances haunted his childhood.
translation: 父母过于爱面子的做法在他儿时一直困扰着他。

meaning: conj&adv.  虽然， 可是， 尽管
example: I thought I'd enrol you with an art group at the school.
translation: 我想我会吸收你参加学校的一个艺术团。

meaning: adj.  彻底的
n&v.  呼吁， 请求
example: Its new title was meant to give the party greater public appeal.
translation: 新的党名意在使该党对公众具有更强的吸引力。

meaning: adj.  日常的
example: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics.
translation: 1/5的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。

meaning: v. 保持，停止，阻止; n.  逗留
example: He's not a fast horse but he's certainly a stayer.
translation: 这匹马跑得不快,但很有耐力.

meaning: vi.  出现； 看来， 似乎
example: He was bailed to appear before local magistrates on 5 November.
translation: 他获得保释，将于11月5日在地方法庭出庭受审。

meaning: n. 脸；面容；表情；面子；正面; vt.  面向； 面对， 朝； 正视； 面临
example: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
translation: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

meaning: vt.  放弃
example: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

meaning: n. 祝贺，恭贺
example: This is not a matter for self-congratulation.
translation: 你不应该为此事沾沾自喜。

meaning: v.  鼓舞， 激励； 启示
example: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

meaning: adj.  害怕的， 恐惧的
example: She was afraid in a way that was quite new to her.
translation: 她感到从未有过的害怕。

meaning: vi.  进展； 进行; n.  进步， 上进
example: His remedial teacher sees signs of progress in his reading and writing.
translation: 他的辅导教师发现了他在阅读和写作方面进步的迹象。

meaning: n.  几何学
example: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
translation: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

meaning: vt.  邀请； 招待
example: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
translation: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

meaning: adj. 公开的；开着的; v.  打开； 公开
example: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

meaning: vt.  奉献； 致力； 专心
example: Faculty members devote most of their time to scholarly research.
translation: 全院教师大部分时间都用来从事学术研究。

meaning: n.  代理商
example: The agent spied for East Germany for more than twenty years.
translation: 该特工人员为东德做了20多年的间谍。

meaning: vt.  对待， 看待； 治疗
example: treat with
translation: 处理；应付

meaning: n.  流产； 堕胎
example: There are many people who still find the act of abortion abhorrent.
translation: 仍有很多人对堕胎行为表示厌恶。

meaning: n.  主教
example: Bishop Daly said he was devastated by news of the Cardinal's death.
translation: 戴利主教说他听到红衣主教去世的消息后感到极为震惊和难过。

meaning: n.  痛苦，苦难
example: Suffice to say, it was more than a couple of years ago!
translation: 我只想说，那是几年前的事了！

meaning: adv.  后来
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: n.  名誉， 名声
example: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
translation: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

meaning: n.  项目， 工程
example: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
translation: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

meaning: adv.  在里面， 在内部; prep. 在…里面，在…之内
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: n.  独立
example: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
translation: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

meaning: n.  演示， 演出； 呈现， 展示
example: The ideas in the show's presentation were good, but failed in execution.
translation: 那场展览陈述的想法很好，但是没能实现。

meaning: conj.  无论何时
example: or whenever
translation: [口语] 或任何时候

meaning: n.  朝代， 王朝
example: The Seljuk dynasty of Syria was founded in 1094.
translation: 叙利亚的塞尔柱王朝始建于1094年。

meaning: v. 〔狗〕吠叫; n. 狗叫声，吠声
example: He started to hack away at the tree bark.
translation: 他开始砍树皮。

meaning: adj.  贪婪的
example: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.
translation: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。

meaning: adj.  笨拙的； 难使用的
example: Unfortunately, Grandma always seems to awaken at awkward moments.
translation: 不幸的是，奶奶好像总是醒来的不是时候。

meaning: adj.  赤裸的; vt. 使赤裸；露出
example: They would have liked bare wooden floors throughout the house.
translation: 他们本想在整个房间的木地板上都不铺地毯的。

meaning: v. 毁坏；毁灭
example: She wasn't going to let her plans go to ruin.
translation: 她不会让她的计划破产的。

meaning: n.  羊肉
example: He likes to eat mutton which was seasoned with garlic.
translation: 他喜欢吃用大蒜调味的羊肉.

meaning: v.  庆祝
example: The banks have had precious little to celebrate recently.
translation: 银行最近没几件值得庆贺的事。

meaning: adj.  令人钦佩的； 极好的
example: He was an admirable chairman.
translation: 他是一位令人钦佩的主席。

meaning: v.  使人高兴， 令人满意; int. 请
example: "Please understand this," she began, a tremble in her voice.
translation: “请理解这一点，”她开始说道，声音有些发颤。

meaning: vi.  看， 瞧； 看起来； 注意; n. [C]看，瞧
example: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
translation: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

meaning: adj&adv.  近海的， 向海的
example: When they hit the rocks, they were just 500 yards offshore.
translation: 他们触礁时离海岸仅有500码。

meaning: n.  两星期
example: in a fortnight's time
translation: 在两周的时间内

meaning: n.  伤疤
example: The scarab image was used for recording historical events.
translation: 圣甲虫像用于记录历史性事件.

meaning: adj.  多山的
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: adj.  尘土般的； 尘土多的

meaning: n.  恩惠； 好感； 帮助

meaning: adv. 在周围；在附近；大约；掉头; prep.  在…周围； 绕着

meaning: vt.  污染

meaning: v.  失望

translation: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

meaning: v.   腐烂， 腐败

translation: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

meaning: n.  建造， 建设； 建筑物

translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: v.  预言； 预报

translation: 该试验能准确地预测一次更大爆炸的威力。

meaning: v.  划船; n. 排，行

translation: 就在她离开之前，我们大吵了一架。

meaning: adj.  普遍的， 全体的

translation: 他在国外工作期间把自己的房子租了出去。

meaning: n.  国境， 边界； 前线
example: A "frontier-free" Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.
translation: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。

meaning: adj.  主观的

translation: 我们的初步结果显示，人们的确在主观上感觉演讲表达得更清晰明了了。

meaning: adv.  故意地

translation: 看起来似乎是有人蓄意纵火。

meaning: n.  海草， 海藻

meaning: n.  抽屉

translation: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。

meaning: n.  运输； 传送器; vt.  运输， 传送

translation: 确定了运输性试验内容并建立了评价指标体系.

meaning: n.  申请； 申请书
example: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

meaning: adj.  冻结的； 极冷的

translation: 春天严寒的天气降低了母鸡的产蛋能力。

translation: 他不通语法和乱用标点是出了名的。

meaning: n.  英亩； 田地
example: The 77,000-acre estate contains five of the highest peaks in Scotland.
translation: 7.7万英亩的私人土地上有5座苏格兰最高的山峰。

translation: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。

meaning: prep&conj.  直到…为止， 在…以前
adj.  单调无味的； 阴暗的； 迟钝的

translation: 证据被当庭呆板地宣读了一遍。

meaning: adj.  笨拙的
example: The action seemed a clumsy attempt to topple the Janata Dal government.
translation: 这一试图推翻人民党政府的行动似乎缺乏策略。

meaning: v.  说服， 劝说; n. 理由，原因

translation: 我真的不明白为什么要改变它。

meaning: n.  思考， 思想； 念头

translation: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

meaning: v. 响；打电话; n.  电话铃声； 环形物

translation: 如果想了解更多信息，请拨打热线电话4143929。

meaning: n. 喜爱，爱好，口味; v. 有…的味道
example: The decor is tasteful and restrained.
translation: 装饰风格素雅简约。

meaning: adv.  任何地方
example: I didn't see that my career as a film-maker was going anywhere.
translation: 我发现我作为电影制片人的职业没有什么发展前途。

meaning: v.  讨价还价; n. 便宜货，廉价货
example: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash.
translation: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。

meaning: n.  辨认， 鉴定； 身份证明
example: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
translation: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

meaning: v. 阻塞; n.  果酱； 阻塞

translation: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。

meaning: adj.  一年一次的， 每年的

translation: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

meaning: int.  干杯
example: Her dancing brought loud cheers, wolf whistles and applause.
translation: 她的舞蹈赢来震耳的欢呼声、口哨声和掌声。

meaning: v.  沸腾， 烧开； 煮

translation: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

meaning: n. 胶底运动鞋
example: I have a sneaking suspicion that they are going to succeed.
translation: 我隐隐觉得他们恐怕要成功了。

meaning: n.  闪电
example: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
translation: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

meaning: vi. 余下，留下; v.  保持， 仍是
example: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
translation: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

example: Neil's ability to utter banalities never ceased to amaze me.
translation: 每次我都很惊讶，尼尔怎么能讲出这么索然无味的东西。

translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

meaning: n.  信封

translation: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meaning: n&v.  存 ； 堆积

meaning: adj.  味道好的

meaning: n.  望远镜

translation: 任何借助望远镜瞄准器的像样射手都可以随意把我们逐个干掉。

meaning: adj.  熟练的； 技艺精湛的； 灵巧的

translation: 作者将这些片断巧妙地结合成一个连贯的整体.

translation: 也许我吃得太多了，所以昏昏欲睡。

meaning: pron.  另一个; adj. 另一；别的

translation: 她伸手又从衣橱里取出一件运动服。

translation: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

meaning: vt.  获得； 学到
example: Perhaps we did acquire a somewhat fuddy-duddy image in the later years.
translation: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。

meaning: adj.  值得的； 价值…

translation: 一架直升机在瓦列霍爆炸起火并坠毁。

meaning: adv&conj.  那儿； 何处

translation: 我不知道国界线会划在哪里; 你住在哪里?

meaning: adj.  残疾的

translation: 这家健身房健全和残障人士都可使用。

meaning: n.  西瓜

translation: 在19世纪人们大规模使用水力来发电.

meaning: v.  以…装备， 武装起来; n. 手臂；支架

translation: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: n.  毒药

translation: 他是一个满脸皱纹、头发灰白的小个子男人。

translation: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。

translation: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！

translation: 聚合物及类似材料的价格会下降。

meaning: adj. 镇静的，沉着的; v.  镇静， 沉着
example: Officials hoped admitting fewer foreigners would calm the situation.
translation: 官员们希望通过减少外国人入境的数量来使局势平定下来。

meaning: adj.  令人厌烦的
example: He was criticised for being boring, strait-laced and narrow-minded.
translation: 他被指无趣乏味，古板守旧，心胸狭窄。

translation: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

meaning: v.  吸， 吮

translation: 有关家庭的公共政策使自由主义者陷入了进退两难的境地。

translation: 让儿童改掉吃零食的习惯有时十分困难.

translation: 他此次访问旨在增进两国间的关系。

translation: 政府部门如今已经签署了那项法案，没有挽回的余地。

translation: 因被控舞弊，在托德先生的坚持下重新进行了投票。

translation: 迎接挑战；满足要求

meaning: n.  研究， 调查

translation: 据说为研究和技术方面提供的经费严重不足。

meaning: n&v.  讨论， 辩论

translation: 有必要让公众在充分知情的状况下展开辩论。

meaning: n.  看法； 景色

meaning: determiner. 〔两者中的〕任何一个; adv. 也(不)

translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

translation: 看到一张张忍饥挨饿的孩子们的照片，许多人赶忙捐钱。

meaning: adj.  有帮助的， 有益的

translation: 手头上有合适的设备将会帮上大忙。

translation: 灯光照在满是灰尘的墙上，反射回苍白的冷光。

meaning: v&n.  担忧， 烦恼
example: Too much time is spent worrying over that which one can't change.
translation: 太多的时间花在了担心那些我们无力改变的事情上。

meaning: n.  联盟， 社团
example: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

meaning: adj.  个人的， 私人的
example: My personal life has had to take second place to my career.
translation: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。

meaning: adj.  生气的， 愤怒的
example: They get angry if they think they are being treated disrespectfully.
translation: 他们要是觉得受到了怠慢，就会大动肝火。

meaning: adj.  以前的， 从前的；  前者
example: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
translation: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

meaning: v. 惊恐，恐慌; n.  惊慌， 恐慌
example: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

meaning: v.  折叠； 合拢； 包围
example: But as other shops fold, the march of the superstores continues.
translation: 但在其他商店纷纷关门倒闭之时，大型超市的强劲扩张势头却依旧不减。

meaning: n.  女乘务员， 空中小姐
example: Under his stewardship, the UN's repute has risen immeas-urably.
translation: 在他的管理下，联合国的声望得到了极大提升。

meaning: adv.  像…一样; conj. 当…时；正如；因为；尽管; prep. 作为，以…身份
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: n&v.  拖延
example: How much delay should we build into the plan?
translation: 我们应该为这个计划预留多少富余的时间？

meaning: prep.  在…； 以…
example: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
translation: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning: adj. 化学的; n.  化学制品
example: Some of the companies illegally sent the wherewithal for making chemical weapons.
translation: 有些公司非法为制造化学武器提供所需的资金和设备等。

meaning: n.  拐弯处， 拐角处
example: He was caricatured as a turnip.
translation: 在漫画里他被画成了一棵大头菜。

meaning: n.  和平； 安宁
example: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
translation: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

meaning: vt. 种植；播种; n.  植物
example: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

meaning: adj.  民间的
example: The folk-song world was another of his abiding interests.
translation: 民歌是他的另一个始终不渝的爱好。

meaning: n.  询问
example: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
translation: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

meaning: v.  驾驶， 开； 驱赶
example: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless.
translation: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。

meaning: v.   伤害
example: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
translation: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

meaning: v. 处理; n.  量， 数额； 交易
vt.  滥用; n.  辱骂， 粗话
example: West was wilfully blind to the abuse that took place.
translation: 韦斯特对发生的虐待行为故意视而不见。

meaning: vi.  证明是， 结果是， 原来是; vt. 证明，证实
example: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced, person.
translation: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

meaning: n.  祖国
example: The exiles had been cut off from all contact with their homeland.
translation: 流亡者被切断了与家乡的所有联系。

meaning: vt.  影响
example: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
translation: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。

meaning: adj.  聋的
example: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears.
translation: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。

meaning: vt.  钦佩； 羡慕
example: I had to admire David's vow that he would leave the programme.
translation: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。

meaning: n.  病毒
example: influenza virus
translation: 流感病毒

meaning: vt.  使快乐， 逗乐
example: Their antics never fail to amuse.
translation: 他们滑稽的举止总是让人发笑。

meaning: v.   看见， 看到； 领会
example: Same faction players in stealth are seeable by any other player of that faction.
translation: 潜行玩家对同阵营的其它玩家可见.

meaning: n&v.  搜寻， 搜查
example: He's not a real searcher after truth.
translation: 他不是一个真正探求真理的人。

meaning: adj.  配备了家具的
example: be furnished with
translation: 提供，备有

meaning: n.  责任
example: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
translation: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

meaning: adj.  突然的
example: Family values are suddenly the name of the game.
translation: 家庭价值观突然变得重要起来。

meaning: v.  欺骗； 做蠢事； 游手好闲; n. 傻子，蠢人，白痴
example: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
translation: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

meaning: adj.  国内的； 平民的； 民事的
example: The strike has taken on overtones of a civil rights campaign.
translation: 罢工带上了民权运动的意味。

meaning: prep.  靠近； 到…时； 被； 由； 以…的标准
example: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
translation: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

meaning: pron&conj.  谁
example: He was free to marry whomever he chose.
translation: 他看上了谁就可以和谁结婚。

meaning: vt.  指出， 显示
example: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
translation: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

meaning: vt. 设置，调整；树立；摆放；日落; n.  一套； 设备
example: Old Tone Bao's daughter - in - law examined their fine seta of eggs.
translation: 四大娘看自家的五张“布子”.

meaning: v. 收费；指控；索价；充电; n.  费用， 价钱
example: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
translation: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

meaning: vt.  包含； 包括
example: Our range of herbal teas contain no preservatives, colourings or artificial flavourings.
translation: 我们这一系列的药草茶不含防腐剂、色素以及人工调味品。

meaning: adj.  突出的， 显著的； 杰出的
example: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

meaning: v.  乱丢杂物
example: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.
translation: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。

meaning: adv. 椭圆
example: Congress is waiting to see how the Oval Office will react.
translation: 国会正观望总统方面的反应。

meaning: n.  程序， 手续
example: British Parliamentary procedure is perplexing at the best of times.
translation: 即使在最好情况下，英国议会的程序也很费解。

meaning: adj.  熟悉的
example: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
translation: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

meaning: n.  传记
example: He has written a speculative biography of Christopher Marlowe.
translation: 他写了一篇关于克里斯托弗·马洛的推测性传记。

meaning: v.  呼吸
example: Breathe out and ease your knees in toward your chest.
translation: 呼气，膝部放松向胸部靠拢。

meaning: n.  申请人
example: Not every applicant had a degree.
translation: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。

meaning: n.  战斗； 战役
example: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
translation: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

meaning: adj.  可怕的； 引起敬畏的
example: Graf looked in awesome form as she cruised to an easy victory.
translation: 格拉芙轻松取胜，看上去状态极佳。

meaning: n.  搭档， 合作者
example: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you.
translation: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

meaning: adj.  有天赋的， 有才华的
example: He was witty, amusing and gifted with a sharp business brain.
translation: 他机智诙谐，具有敏锐的商业头脑。

meaning: n.  签证
example: The town has a desolate visage.
translation: 这个镇子呈现出一片荒凉.

meaning: n.  拉链
example: zipper pocket
translation: 拉链口袋

meaning: n.  北极
example: TV pictures showed the arctic conditions.
translation: 电视画面显示了严寒的环境。

meaning: adj.  不适宜的， 不相宜的
example: The judges agreed on his unfitness for the appointment.
translation: 评委们就他不适合那项任命的意见达成了一致.

meaning: n&v.  采访； 会见； 面试
example: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

meaning: v.  澄清， 阐明
example: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.
translation: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。

meaning: n.  美， 美丽； 美人
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: v.  请求， 乞求
example: We beg the Government on bended knees not to cut this budget.
translation: 我们恳求政府不要削减这项预算。

meaning: v.  惊吓， 威吓； 受惊
example: Then he took a poke at my hair, telling me I looked like a scarecrow!
translation: 然后他开始嘲笑我的头发, 说我看起来像个稻草人!

meaning: v.  用以构成疑问句及否定句; vt. 做，干
example: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
translation: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

meaning: v.  观察； 遵守
example: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
translation: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

meaning: adj.  幽默的
example: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
translation: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

meaning: n.  衣服， 外衣
example: She stood up and began to disrobe, folding each garment neatly.
translation: 她站起来开始脱衣服，并把每件衣服叠整齐。

meaning: adj.  罕见的， 稀有的
example: It remained an exceptionally rare book until it was reprinted in 1918.
translation: 在1918年再版之前，这本书一直非常罕见。

meaning: adj.  无用的
example: Uselessly, he checked the same pockets he'd checked before.
translation: 他把先前检查过的那些口袋又查了一遍，毫无收获。

meaning: pron.  哪一个； 哪一些
example: Fishing is from 6 am to dusk or 10.30pm, whichever is sooner.
translation: 钓鱼时间从上午6点到黄昏或是到晚上10点半，以较早者为准。

meaning: n.  不利条件； 弱点
example: Depression is the third thing that works to my patients' disadvantage.
translation: 抑郁是威胁我的病人健康的第三大杀手。

meaning: n.  垃圾
example: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
translation: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

meaning: n.  大陆
example: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
translation: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

meaning: adv.  在楼下， 到楼下
example: Sounds of voices and commotion could be heard downstairs now.
translation: 现在能听见楼下人声鼎沸。

meaning: n.  大理石
example: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

meaning: adv.  决不， 从来没有
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: n.  忧虑； 焦急
example: He has exhibited symptoms of anxiety and overwhelming worry.
translation: 他表现出焦躁不安和过度忧虑的症状。

meaning: n.  一块  ； 小的部分
example: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
translation: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

meaning: v.  适应； 调整， 调节
example: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
translation: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

meaning: v.  携带； 搬运； 背
example: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
translation: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

meaning: v.   突然发生； 爆炸
example: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
translation: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

meaning: adj.  西方的； 西部的
example: No westerner could fly in without a visa.
translation: 没有签证的西方人不能乘飞机入境。

meaning: n.  债务， 欠款
example: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
translation: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

meaning: adj.   小的； 少的
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: adv.  可是， 然而， 尽管如此； 无论如何
example: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

meaning: adv.  深深地； 在深处; adj. 深的；深厚的；沉睡的；渊博的
example: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
translation: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

meaning: n.   鹅
example: He said that what they were up to would cook Krasky's goose.
translation: 他说他们暗中进行的阴谋可能会使克拉斯基的计划流产。

meaning: vt.   原谅， 宽恕
example: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him.
translation: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

meaning: n.  起源； 由来
example: There are some areas of wetland which are of ancient origin.
translation: 有一些湿地在古代就形成了。

meaning: conj.  因为， 由于; prep. 为了；在…期间；对于
example: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
translation: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

meaning: adj.  错误的
example: You couldn't be more mistaken, Alex. You've utterly misread the situation.
translation: 亚历克斯，你真是大错特错，你对局势的判断根本不对。

meaning: adj.  满意的; n.  内容； 含量
example: There are reports of widespread dis-content in the capital.
translation: 有报道称首都弥漫着不满的情绪。

meaning: n.  行为， 事迹
example: The perpetrators of this evil deed must be brought to justice.
translation: 必须将参与这一恶行的凶手绳之以法。

meaning: n.  担子， 负担
example: I wouldn't call it a burden; I call it a responsibility.
translation: 我不觉得这是负担；我觉得它是一种责任。

meaning: n&v.  敬礼； 问候
example: As a second lieutenant, he had to salute damned near everybody.
translation: 身为少尉，他几乎是逢人便得敬礼。

meaning: adj.  随意的， 任意的
example: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.
translation: 3个人被从一辆面包车中发射的乱弹打死了。

meaning: adv.  可能， 或许
example: The horrors he experienced are imprinted, perhaps indelibly, in his brain.
translation: 他经历的恐怖事件在他脑海中刻下了深深的，或许是难以磨灭的印记。

meaning: vt. 密谋; n.  情节
example: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
translation: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

meaning: v.  估价； 认为; n. 比率；价格；速度
example: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

meaning: n.  技能， 技巧
example: Computers and electronics are growth industries and need skilled technicians.
translation: 计算机与电子行业属于蓬勃发展的产业，需要娴熟的技术人员。

meaning: n. 问题；疾病；麻烦; vt.  使苦恼； 使忧虑； 使麻烦
example: in trouble
translation: 在监禁中；处于不幸中；处困难中

meaning: adj.  不公平的， 不公正的
example: He vowed to wreak vengeance on his unfaithful, thieving wife.
translation: 他发誓要报复对自己不忠、爱偷东西的妻子。

meaning: v.  分， 划分； 除以
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: adj.  相反的; n. 反面
example: Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.
translation: 几个在场的人，包括温博格，所掌握的信息截然不同。

meaning: vi.  坐
example: sit down
translation: 坐下；扎营

meaning: adj.  数字的， 数码的
example: The BBC has just successfully demonstrated a new digital radio transmission system.
translation: 英国广播公司刚刚成功地演示了一套新的数字无线电传输系统。

meaning: adv. 越过; adj.  完了， 结束了; prep. 在…之上；超过
example: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
translation: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

meaning: adj.  闪耀的； 有才气的
example: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
translation: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

meaning: adj.  实际的； 适用的； 实用的； 应用的
example: After half an hour's commis-eration, we turned to more practical matters.
translation: 惺惺相惜了半个小时后，我们转而讨论一些更为实际的问题。

meaning: n.  杀虫剂
example: pesticide residues in fruit and vegetables
translation: 残留在水果和蔬菜中的杀虫剂

meaning: adj. 被束缚的；有义务的; v.  跳跃
example: They are bound to take time to readjust after a holiday.
translation: 他们肯定需要时间重新适应假期结束后的生活。

meaning: adj.  假的； 不正确的
example: I was wearing false eyelashes and a sweater two sizes too small.
translation: 我戴着假睫毛，穿着小了两号的毛衣。

meaning: v. 去，走；进行；进展； 变得， 变成
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: v.  取笑， 嘲弄
example: European teasel with white to pink flowers; naturalized in United States.
translation: 欧洲川续断,花白色粉色; 已经引入美国.

meaning: n.  叉； 餐叉
example: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

meaning: v.  形成， 组建; n. 表格；形式；结构
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: v.  出版， 发行
example: My object was to publish a scholarly work on Peter Mourne.
translation: 我的目标是出版一本关于彼得·莫恩的学术著作。

meaning: n.  角锥形； 金字塔
example: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

meaning: n.  支票
example: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
translation: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

meaning: vt.  避免， 躲开， 逃避
example: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
translation: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

meaning: v&n.  出价， 投标
example: He certainly wasn't going to bid $18 billion for this company.
translation: 他肯定不会出180亿美元来收购这家公司。

meaning: adj.  新鲜的； 不熟练的
example: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
translation: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

meaning: vt.  使惊讶
example: A matter of repeated occurrence like this will not astonish people.
translation: 这样司空见惯的事,不会使人吃惊.

meaning: v.   缩回， 撤回
example: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.

meaning: n&vt.  保留， 储备； 预订
adv.  以某种方式； 不知怎么地
example: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

meaning: n.  砖； 砖块
example: Each brick also varies slightly in tone, texture and size.
translation: 每块砖在色调、质地与大小上也都略有不同。

meaning: vi.  跳水
example: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
translation: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

meaning: v.  堆起来; n. 堆
example: Clothes were thrown in the luggage in an untidy heap.
translation: 衣服被乱糟糟地扔进旅行箱里。

meaning: n.  同情
example: Is there competition between sympatric jaguar Panthera onca and puma Puma concolor?
translation: 同域栖息的美洲虎和美洲狮存在竞争 吗 ?

meaning: v.   听见， 听说， 得知
example: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

meaning: n&v.   打仗， 打架； 争论
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: adj. 绕道的；不直接的; n.  转盘路
example: The turn is about two kilometres before the roundabout.
translation: 拐弯就在环岛前面约2公里处。

meaning: vt&n.  营救， 援救
example: Lights clipped onto life jackets improve the chances of rescue.
translation: 别在救生衣上的灯提高了获救可能性。

meaning: adj.  面部用的
example: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
translation: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

meaning: adv.  继续; prep. 在…上；在…时候；在…地方；关于
example: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
translation: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

meaning: n.  斑马
example: zebra crossing
translation: n. 斑马线

meaning: adj.  简洁的
example: A guide gives a brief talk on the history of the site.
translation: 导游简要地介绍了那个遗址的历史。

meaning: adj.  不幸的， 倒霉的
example: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered.
translation: 不幸的是，几乎不可能看到这些重大问题得到回复。

meaning: vi. 痊愈; vt.  恢复； 重新获得
example: Legal action is being taken to try to recover the money.
translation: 正在进行诉讼以收回那笔钱。

meaning: conj.  或者； 还是， 否则
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n.  机会； 可能性
example: They had met by chance at university and finished up getting married.
translation: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。

meaning: v.  决定； 测定； 确定
example: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
translation: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

meaning: n.  自然； 性质； 本性
example: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
translation: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。

meaning: adj.  社会的； 社交的； 群居的
example: We guarantee that you will find a community with which to socialise.
translation: 我们保证你们会找到自己的交际圈。

meaning: n.  轮， 车轮； 方向盘
adj.  有趣的
example: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
translation: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

meaning: n. 十字形的东西；十字架; vt.  越过； 穿过
example: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
translation: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

meaning: vt&n.   控制
example: The volume of scheduled flights is straining the air traffic control system.
translation: 定期航班的数量正让空中交通指挥系统不堪重负。

meaning: v. 钻；重复训练; n.  钻头；  训练
example: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
translation: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

meaning: n.  摩擦； 摩擦力
example: The friction of the sheets against his skin was torture.
translation: 被单摩擦着他的皮肤，简直像是酷刑。

meaning: n.  书记员； 办事员； 职员
example: A stupid medical clerk had slipped the wrong tab on his X-ray.
translation: 一个蠢笨的医护人员一不留神在他的X光片上贴错了标签。

meaning: n.  胡桃， 胡桃木
example: walnut kernel
translation: 核桃仁

meaning: vt.  答谢； 承认
example: You have to acknowledge that we live in a racist society.
translation: 你得承认我们生活在一个有种族偏见的社会中。

meaning: vt.   装备； 训练
example: Owners of restaurants would have to equip them to admit disabled people.
translation: 餐厅老板将必须在餐厅里配备能够接纳残疾人的设施。

meaning: n.  放射； 放射物； 放射疗法
n&vi.  争吵， 吵架
example: They could quarrel quite legitimately with some of my choices.
translation: 他们大有理由不同意我的一些选择。

meaning: adj.  基督教徒的; n. 基督教徒
example: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
translation: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

meaning: v.  搏动， 跳动; n. 脉搏；脉冲
example: There was no breathing or pulse and he was lifeless.
translation: 没有呼吸，也没有脉搏，他已经死了。

meaning: n.  枫树
example: Early settlers built frames of spruce, maple and pine.
translation: 早期的定居者用云杉木、枫木和松木建造屋架。

meaning: adj.  精神的； 心灵的
example: spiritual civilization
translation: 精神文明

meaning: adj.  值得做的
example: Candidates deemed vote-worthy will be rewarded with campaign funds.
translation: 被认为有望获胜的候选人将会获得竞选资金。

meaning: n.  民族， 国家
example: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.
translation: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。

meaning: adj.  较高的， 较上的
example: Dictionary order, case - insensitive, uppercase preference, for use with 1252 Character Set.
translation: 字典顺序, 不区分大小写, 大写字母优先, 用于1252字符集.

meaning: adj.  灿烂的， 辉煌的； 〈口语〉 极好的
example: Its historic buildings are being slowly and splendidly renovated.
translation: 此处的历史建筑正被缓慢且精心地修复着。

meaning: n.  [U] 适应， 适合； [C] 改编本
example: social adaptation
translation: 社会适应，适应能力

meaning: n.  利益； 代表
example: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meaning: adv.  在某处， 到某处
example: I was divorced somewhile ago.
translation: 不久前我离婚了.

meaning: n.   一场， 场景， 布景； 景色， 风景
example: on the scene
translation: 在场；出现；到场

meaning: vt.  损害， 伤害
example: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
translation: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

meaning: v.    结冰
example: A wage freeze was imposed on all staff earlier this month.
translation: 这个月早些时候，所有员工的工资都被冻结了。

meaning: adv.  向东
example: The crowd is heading eastward, believing that they can find gold there.
translation: 人群正在向东移去, 他们认为在那里可以找到黄金.

meaning: n.  地理学
example: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
translation: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

meaning: adj.  令人恐惧的， 恐怖的
example: They made sure that he died a horrible death.
translation: 他们让他死得很惨。

meaning: v.  加强， 增强
example: strengthen environmental protection
translation: 加强环境保护

meaning: n.  损伤； 受伤处
example: The victim suffered a dreadful injury and lost a lot of blood.
translation: 受害者受了重伤，大量失血。

meaning: n.  毕业文凭， 学位证书
example: a BTEC Higher National Diploma in Public Service Studies
translation: BTEC公共服务科高等国家证书

meaning: n.  商标， 牌子
example: But that doesn't mean this brand of politics is dead or dying.
translation: 但那并不意味着这种政治主张已经或正在消亡。

meaning: n.  暂停， 中止； 悬挂， 悬浮
example: The developing tendency of suspensive detention is to make it humanized.
translation: 未决羁押的人性化改造,是未决羁押工作的发展趋势.

meaning: n&v.  窒息
example: It's enough to make them choke with apoplectic rage.
translation: 足以气得让他们说不出话来。

meaning: n.  酒精， 酒
example: In 1985, he began to show signs of alcohol and drug dependency.
translation: 在1985年，他开始表现出酗酒嗜毒的迹象。

meaning: n.  高兴， 愉快
example: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

meaning: adj.  老的， 旧的
example: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
translation: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

meaning: n.  消遣， 娱乐
example: There are plans to enlarge the recreation area.
translation: 已经有了扩大娱乐场地的计划。

meaning: n.  津贴， 补贴
example: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
translation: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

meaning: n.  翻译员， 口译人员
example: He was an official interpreter to the government of Nepal.
translation: 他曾是尼泊尔政府的官方译员。

meaning: n.  飓风， 狂风
example: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
translation: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

meaning: adj.  轻便的， 便携的
example: A small-screen portable TV can be a good investment.
translation: 小屏幕的便携式电视机很值得买。

meaning: adv.  当时， 那时； 然后； 那么
example: Minor thenar - hitting is also called'side - hitting " or " cut - beating ".
translation: 小鱼际击法,又称“侧击法 ” 或 “ 切打法 ”.

meaning: adj.  古代的， 古老的
example: The journey ends in the ancient city of Marrakesh.
translation: 旅行的终点是马拉喀什古城。

meaning: v.  接受
example: He would have to accept it; there was no other way.
translation: 对此他将别无选择，只有接受。

meaning: n.  光荣， 荣誉
example: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.
translation: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。

meaning: n. 座位，座; vt.  使就座； 可容纳
example: Those electing to smoke will be seated at the rear.
translation: 那些想吸烟的人将坐在后排。

meaning: v.  游荡； 漫步； 流浪
example: The wanderer has to sleep rough.
translation: 这个流浪汉到处为家.

meaning: vt.  采用； 收养
example: Britain is free to adopt policies to bolster its economy.
translation: 英国可以自由制定政策以振兴经济。

meaning: v.  反对
example: It is illogical to oppose the repatriation of economic migrants.
translation: 反对把经济移民遣送归国是不合逻辑的。

meaning: adj. 负的; prep.  减去
example: The star's surface temperature is reckoned to be minus 75 degrees Celsius.
translation: 这颗恒星的表面温度估计在零下75摄氏度左右。

meaning: n.  肚子
example: The middle button of his uniform jacket was strained over his belly.
translation: 制服上装中间的纽扣在他的肚子上绷得紧紧的。

meaning: adj.  守旧的； 保守主义的； 谨慎的
example: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

meaning: n. 通道；机会，权利; vt.  进入； 存取
example: The home is situated within easy access of shops and other facilities.
translation: 房子位置便利，距离商店及其他设施都不远。

meaning: n.   会议
example: At a later news conference, he said differences should not be dramatized.
translation: 在后来的新闻发布会上，他说不应夸大分歧。

meaning: adj.  原始的， 远古的
example: Duffy's primitive guitar playing is well below par.
translation: 达菲粗糙的吉他演奏技巧远不够水平。

meaning: n.  活动
example: The military on both sides are involved in intense activity.
translation: 双方的武装力量都有密集动作。

meaning: n.  学生宿舍
example: The students have barricaded themselves into their dormitory building.
translation: 学生们把自己关在了宿舍楼里。

meaning: v.  战胜， 克服， 胜过
example: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
translation: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

meaning: v.  背诵
example: All he could do was recite a list of Government failings.
translation: 他能做的只是列举政府的种种不是。

meaning: v.   试图； 寻找， 寻求
example: I am a seeker after truth.
translation: 我追求真理。

meaning: v.  似乎， 好像
example: Whatever troubles arise, we'll have peace of mind amidst seeming chaos.
translation: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

meaning: n.  脚后跟
example: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
translation: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

meaning: n.  种种； 种类
example: variety of
translation: 各种各样的

meaning: v.  打扰， 扰乱
example: The pictures were sensationalist and could seriously disturb younger readers.
translation: 这些图片大肆渲染，会让一些比较年轻的读者们惶恐不安。

meaning: vt.  爱慕， 崇拜
example: I adore good books and the theatre.
translation: 我爱读好书，也喜欢看戏。

meaning: n.  [C] 讲课， 演讲
example: Chuck would lecture me, telling me to get a haircut.
translation: 查克就会数落我，让我去理一下发。

meaning: n.  平民， 老百姓
example: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission.
translation: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。

meaning: adv. 也，同样〔用于表示刚说过的情况也适用于某人或某物〕; conjunction. 因此，所以; n. 全音阶的第五音
example: There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun.
translation: 将会有充足的机会去放松、游泳和晒太阳。

meaning: vt. 用泵抽水；抽; n.  抽水机， 泵
example: They find it difficult to pump themselves up for the games.
translation: 他们感到要为自己加油打气，自信满满地去打比赛并不容易。

meaning: n.  小心， 谨慎
example: Television broadcasters were warned to exercise caution over depicting scenes of violence.
translation: 电视台受到警告，要求对暴力场面的描绘采取谨慎态度。

meaning: n.  [C] 钥匙； 答案； 键； 关键
example: The key issue was whether the four defendants acted dishonestly.
translation: 关键问题是4名被告是否存在欺诈行为。

meaning: n.  青少年， 十几岁的少年
example: I have never lost the weight I put on in my teens.
translation: 我十几岁时增加的体重一直没有减下去。

meaning: n.  饺子
example: He is a dumpling.
translation: 他是一个矮胖的人.

meaning: adj.  无声的， 沉默的
example: keep silent
translation: 保持沉默；缄默

meaning: n.  决定； 决议
example: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

meaning: adj.  入迷的， 上瘾的
example: I went through about four years of being addicted to video games.
translation: 我大约有4年时间沉迷在电子游戏中。

meaning: adj.  必需的， 必要的
example: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread.
translation: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

meaning: num&pron.  一个  ； 任何人
example: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
translation: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

meaning: n.  汽车间， 汽车库
example: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
translation: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

meaning: n.  羽毛球
example: Barnaby may be 15, but he's nippy and suited to badminton.
translation: 巴纳比可能15岁了，但他动作敏捷，适合打羽毛球。

meaning: vt.  确定； 批准
example: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.
translation: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。

meaning: adj.  单一的， 单个的
example: Singlechip are necessary for the development of basic skills.
translation: 是开发单片机必备的基本技巧.

meaning: v. 拉，拖; n.  拉力， 引力
example: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
translation: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

meaning: adj.  无条件的， 绝对的
example: The hostages were released unconditionally.
translation: 人质被无条件释放了。

meaning: n.  加仑
example: The price of petrol is coming down by four pence a gallon.
translation: 汽油的价格每加仑降了4便士。

meaning: vt.  指定， 任命
example: "Why didn't you appoint Ron twelve months ago?"—"Good question."
translation: “你为什么12个月前不任命罗恩呢？”——“问得好。”

meaning: v.  帮助， 协助
example: We are here to protect and assist the weak and infirm.
translation: 我们来这里保护、帮助年迈体弱者。

meaning: n.  馒头； 小甜面包
example: She had pale thin yellow hair she pulled back into a bun.
translation: 她把一头稀疏的浅黄色头发向后梳，挽成了个圆髻。

meaning: conj. 但是，可是; prep.  除了， 除…外
example: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
translation: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

meaning: n.  符号， 象征
example: status symbol
translation: 社会地位象征

meaning: adv.  真诚地
example: Nobody that I spoke to doubted his sincerity as a politician.
translation: 和我谈过话的人中没有一个怀疑他作为一个政治家的诚意。

meaning: adj.  商业的， 贸易的
example: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

meaning: v.   分开，  分离; adj.  单独的， 分开的
example: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

meaning: v.  宣布， 声明； 申报
example: declare oneself
translation: 显露身分；发表意见

meaning: adj.  合理的， 有道理的； 通情达理的， 合乎情理的
example: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
translation: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

meaning: n&vt.  不喜欢， 嫌恶
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
translation: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: adj.  情愿的， 乐意的
example: be willing to do
translation: 乐意做某事，愿意做

meaning: adj.  有空的； 可得到的， 可用的
example: They have only a vague idea of the amount of water available.
translation: 他们只是大概知道可用水的总量。

meaning: vt. 表达；表示; n.  快车
example: He ran a newspaper stand outside the American Express office.
translation: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。

meaning: vt.  提倡； 鼓吹
example: He is a keen advocate of park-and-ride schemes.
translation: 他是“停车再换乘”计划的热情拥护者。

meaning: adj.  令人惊异的
example: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
translation: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

meaning: n.  〈总称〉 行李
example: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared.
translation: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

meaning: n.  缺点； 障碍
example: The main drawback to it is the cost.
translation: 它的主要缺点是成本高。

meaning: adj.  有活力的； 动力的， 动力学的

example: The Labour government has to date resisted all supplications.
translation: 到目前为止工党政府回绝了所有的请愿求情。

meaning: adj.  有魔力的; n. 魔法，魔术
example: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age.
translation: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。

meaning: v. 穿衣，打扮; n.  女服， 连衣裙； 服装
example: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
translation: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

meaning: n.  [C] 争论， 辩论
example: argument list
translation: 变元表

meaning: n.   一节； 走廊； 通道
example: It's been 200 years since the passage of the Bill of Rights.
translation: 《人权法案》通过已经200年了。

meaning: adj.  理论的
example: Theoretically, the price is supposed to be marked on the shelf.
translation: 照理说，价格应该标在货架上。

meaning: adj.  足够的， 适当的
example: adequate for
translation: 胜任……的；对……是足够的；适合……的

meaning: n. 声，声音; v. 听起来；看起来；好像; adj. 明智的；合理的；正确的
adj. 自己的; vt.  拥有
example: Generosity is its own form of power.
translation: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

meaning: adj.  有希望的； 有前途的
example: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion.
translation: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。

meaning: n.  十二个； 许多
example: Ernest Brown lives about a dozen blocks from where the riots began.
translation: 欧内斯特·布朗住在离骚乱发生处几个街区远的地方。

meaning: v.  翻译
example: translate into
translation: 翻译成

meaning: n.  药， 药物； 毒品
example: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
translation: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

meaning: n.  栅栏， 挡板； 障碍
example: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
translation: 我意识到我不得不克服语言障碍。

meaning: adj. 平常的，普通的；明白的; n.  草原
example: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

meaning: modal verb. 应当，应该 〔用于提供或征求建议〕
example: Erik : I'm sorry too. I shoulda tried harder.
translation: 艾瑞克: 我也是. 我本该再努力些.

meaning: adv.  只， 仅仅; adj. 唯一的，仅有的
example: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
translation: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

meaning: vt.  创造； 造成
example: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
translation: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

meaning: n.  正义， 公正； 司法
example: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

meaning: n.  罪犯
example: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

meaning: v.   吹  ； 刮风; n. 击，打击
example: His resignation was a body blow to the team.
translation: 他的辞职是对该队的沉重打击。

meaning: adj.  好奇的； 奇异的
example: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
translation: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

meaning: adj.  自豪的， 骄傲的
example: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
translation: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

meaning: v.  喜欢， 喜爱; prep. 像，跟…一样; n. 爱好
example: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
translation: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

meaning: adj.  丑陋的， 难看的
example: ugly duckling
translation: 丑小鸭；小时难看长大后变得才貌出众的人

meaning: n.  地震
example: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

meaning: n.  税， 税款
example: income tax
translation: 所得税

meaning: prep.  向， 朝， 对于
adj.  乱七八糟的
example: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
translation: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

meaning: n.  大使馆
example: Embassy security personnel refused to admit him or his wife.
translation: 使馆保安人员不允许他和夫人进入。

meaning: adj.  长方形的; n. 长方形
example: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
translation: 设长方形的宽是x米.

meaning: adj.  易碎的， 脆的
example: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

meaning: n.  离开； 背离； 违反
example: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
translation: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

meaning: v. 快跑，猛撞; n.  快跑， 猛撞； 少量
example: The Prince was driving with great fire and dash.
translation: 王子潇洒威猛地驱车而行。

meaning: vt.   打发， 派遣； 送， 邮寄
example: The Tanabata Festival in Sendai is among the most famous in Japan.
translation: 仙台的七夕庆典是日本最有名的庆典之一.

meaning: adj.  具体的； 有形的
example: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
translation: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

meaning: n. 便条，笔记，注释; vt.  记录， 注意
example: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
translation: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

meaning: pron.  每人， 人人
example: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
translation: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

meaning: v. 航行，开航; n.  帆； 航行
example: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

meaning: n.  出租车； 驾驶室
example: The cab pulled up and the driver jumped out.
translation: 出租车减速停下，司机跳了出来。

meaning: n.  目的， 意图
example: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

meaning: n. 遗憾，懊悔；令人遗憾的事; vt.   遗憾； 后悔
example: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
translation: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

meaning: v.  画线于，  成行; n. 直线；排
example: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
translation: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

meaning: adj.  结实的， 矮胖的
v. 连接，联合; n.  链环， 链接
example: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds.
translation: 他认为7岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。

meaning: v.   逃走， 逃跑
example: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
translation: 难民开始三五成群地陆续逃离该国。

meaning: v.   哭泣， 流泪
example: weep for
translation: 为…而哭泣

meaning: n.  曲调， 调子
example: out of tune
translation: 走调；不协调；（对某事）没有兴趣

meaning: adj.  知道的， 意识到的
example: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off.
translation: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。

meaning: n.  罐头； 铁罐； 垃圾桶
example: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
translation: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

meaning: n.  安全
example: social security
translation: 社会保险，社会保障

meaning: n.  奖品， 奖励
example: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

meaning: adj.  准备就绪的
example: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
translation: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

meaning: n.  警报
example: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm.
translation: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。

meaning: n.  野草， 杂草
example: weed control
translation: 除草；杂草防除；野草控制

meaning: n.  草药
example: The herb has been used for centuries to curdle milk.
translation: 那种香草几个世纪以来都被用来制作酸乳。

meaning: adj.  不省人事的， 无意识的
example: Unconsciously, by force of habit, she plugged the coffee pot in.
translation: 下意识地，她习惯性地把咖啡壶的插头插上了。

meaning: n.  一场雨； 降雨量
example: Victoria Falls has had above average levels of rainfall this year.
translation: 维多利亚瀑布今年的降雨量超过了平均水平。

meaning: n. 成本；代价; vt.   花费； 使付出
example: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
translation: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

meaning: n.  意志； 遗嘱
example: Indeed, there is a succession here, from Mrs Stowe to Jewett and then to Willa Cather.
translation: 说真的, 我们在这里可以看到, 从斯托夫人到朱厄特,再到威拉·凯瑟是一脉相承的.

meaning: v.  满足， 使满意
example: His only experience of gardening so far proved immensely satisfying.
translation: 到目前为止他唯一的一次园艺经历非常令人满意。

meaning: v.  冒烟； 吸烟; n. 烟
example: like smoke
translation: [俚语]

meaning: v. 相配，相称; n.  比赛； 火柴
example: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

meaning: adj.  武断的； 任意的
example: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
translation: 看来这个队的队员完全是随意选定的。

meaning: n.  烹饪， 烹饪术
example: Elizabeth David enthuses about the taste, fragrance and character of Provencal cuisine.
translation: 伊丽莎白·戴维对普罗旺斯菜肴的色香味津津乐道。

meaning: n.  过错， 缺点， 毛病
example: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
translation: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

meaning: v.  跟随； 遵循； 仿效
example: "Wait there!" Kathryn rose. "No, on second thought, follow me."
translation: “在那儿等着！”凯瑟琳站起身来，“不，我改主意了。跟我来。”

meaning: adj.  被动的； 消极的
example: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
translation: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

meaning: adj.  勤劳的， 辛勤工作的
n.  搬运者；  置物架
example: He had returned to England in an aircraft carrier no less.
translation: 他竟然坐航空母舰回的英格兰。

meaning: n.  尊严； 高贵
example: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
translation: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

meaning: n. 挑战；挑战性; vt.  挑战
example: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

meaning: n.  种类
example: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in.
translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

meaning: adj.  暖和舒服的； 舒适的
example: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
translation: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

meaning: v.  想要， 打算
example: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
translation: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

meaning: adj.  野生的
example: A pattern can include regular characters and wildcard characters.
translation: 模式可以包含常规字符和通配符.
